dṛṣṭo me paripūrṇārthaḥ kākutsthaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ | sahitaiḥ sāgarāntasthair balais tiṣṭhati rakṣitaḥ ||
kalpyante mattamātamgā yujyante rathavājinaḥ | dṛśyante turagārūḍhāḥ prāsahastāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||
vikramiṣyati rakṣaḥsu bhartā te sahalakṣmaṇaḥ | yathā śatruṣu śatrughno viṣṇunā saha vāsavaḥ ||
notsahaty amṛto moktum yuddhe tvām iti maithili | sāmātyasya nṛśaṃsasya niścayo hy eṣa vartate ||
dvandve yasya na tiṣṭhanti daivatāny api saṃyuge | sa kasmād rāvaṇo yuddhe bhayam āhārayiṣyati ||
tato ‘stam agamat sūryah saṃdhyayā pratirañjitaḥ | pūrṇacandrapradīpā ca kṣapā samabhivartate ||
ity ēvaṃ vādinaṃ vīram abhinandya ca rāghavaḥ lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmīsampannam idaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ pṛtanarkṣavanaukasām laṅkādvārāṇy upājagmur anye yoddhuṃ samantataḥ ||
arākṣasam imaṃ lōkaṃ kartāsmi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ . nacēc charaṇam abhyēṣi tām ādāya tu maithilīm ||
sa tān bāhudvayāsaktān ādāya patagān iva . prāsādaṃ śailasaṃkāśam utpapātāṅgadas tadā ||
rāghavaḥ saha sainyēna muditō nāma pupluvē . laṅkāṃ dadarśa guptāṃ vai sarvatō rākṣasair vṛtām ||
tēṣāṃ caturṇāṃ rāmas tu śirāṃsi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ . kruddhaś caturbhiś cicchēda ghōrair agniśikhōpamaiḥ ||
tatas tē rākṣasās tatra tasmiṃs tamasi dāruṇē rāmam ēvābhyavartanta saṃhṛṣṭāḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ||
rāmalakṣmaṇayōr ēva sarvadēhabhidaḥ śarān . bhṛśam āvēśayāmāsa rāvaṇiḥ samitiñjayaḥ ||
tān vānaravarān bhittvā śarair agniśikhōpamaiḥ nanāda balavāṃs tatra mahāsattvaḥ sa rāvaṇiḥ ||
sā tu cintayatē nityaṃ samāptavratam āgatam . kadā drakṣyāmi sītāṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ ca sarāghavam ||
tvaṃ nityaṃ suviṣaṇṇaṃ mām āśvāsayasi lakṣmaṇa . gatāsur nādya śaktō ‘si mām ārtam abhibhāṣitum ||
aṅgadēna kṛtaṃ karma maindēna dvividēna ca . yuddhaṃ kēsariṇā saṃkhyē ghōraṃ sampātinā kṛtam ||
athābravīd vānarendraḥ sugrīvaḥ putram aṅgadam nānimittam idaṃ manye bhavitavyaṃ bhayena tu ||
nirmalēna sudhautēna khaḍgēnāsya mahac chiraḥ jaghāna vajradaṅṣṭrasya vālisūnur mahābalaḥ ||
visarjayitvā sacivāṃs tatas tān gatēṣu rakṣaḥsu yathā niyōgam . vyadārayad vānarasāgaraughaṃ mahājhaṣaḥ pūrṇam ivārṇavaugham ।।
tataḥ sa tēnābhihatō vānarēṇa mahātmanā daśagrīvaḥ samādhūtō yathā bhūmicalē ‘calaḥ ।।
ēvam uktvā mahābāhū rāvaṇō rākṣasēśvaraḥ . saṃdhāya bāṇam astreṇa camūpatim atāḍayat ।।
asyaiś ca nētraiḥ śravaṇaiḥ papāta rudhiraṃ bahu . vighūrṇamānō niścēṣṭō rathōpastha upāviśat ।।
sō ‘sau vyasanam āpannaḥ kumbhakarṇam abōdhayat . tvatparākramabhītaś ca rājā samprati rāvaṇaḥ ।।
ētāvad uktvā vacanaṃ sarvē tē bhējirē diśaḥ . bhīmaṃ bhīmākṣam āyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarayūthapāḥ ।।
śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca sahasrāṇi ca vānarāḥ . prakīrṇāḥ śēratē bhūmau kumbhakarṇēna tāḍitāḥ ।।
variants.b_text: शतानिसप्तचाष्टौ च सहस्राणि च वानराः । प्रकीर्णाःशेरतेभूमौकुम्भकर्णेनपोधिताः ।।6.67.6।।

variants.a_text: rathinō vānarēndrāṇāṃ śaraiḥ kālāntakōpamaiḥ śirāṃsi nardatāṃ jahruḥ sahasā bhīmaniḥsvanā ।।
māṃsaśōṇitasaṃklēdāṃ kurvan bhūmiṃ sa rākṣasaḥ . cacāra harisainyēṣu kālāgnir iva mūrchitaḥ ।।
tyaja tad vānarānīkaṃ prākṛtaiḥ kiṃ kariṣyasi . sahasvaikaṃ nipātaṃ mē parvatasyāsya rākṣasa ।।
pīḍyamānas tad astraṃ tu viśēṣaṃ tat sa rākṣasaḥ . tataś cukōpa balavān sumitrānandavardhanaḥ ।।
yat tu vīryabalōtsāhais tōṣitō ‘haṃ raṇē tvayā . rāmam ēvaikam icchāmi hantuṃ yasmin hatē hatam ।।
śrutvā vinihataṃ saṃkhyē kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam . rāvaṇaḥ śōkasaṃtaptō mumōha ca papāta ca ।।
tad idaṃ mām anuprāptaṃ vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śubham . yad ajñānān mayā tasya na gṛhītaṃ mahātmanaḥ ।।
tē pādapaśilāḥ śailaiś cakrur vṛṣṭim anūpamām . bāṇaughair vāryamāṇāś ca harayō bhīmavikramāḥ ।।
vānarān vānarair ēva jaghnus tē nairṛtarṣabhāḥ rākṣasān rākṣasair ēva jaghnus tē vānarā api ।।
yāvad vikramituṃ buddhiṃ cakruḥ plavagapuṃgavāḥ . tāvad ētān atikramya nirbibhēda narāntakaḥ ।।
kruddhaḥ saumitrir utpatya tūṇād ākṣipya sāyakam . purastād atikāyasya vicakarṣa mahad dhanuḥ ।।
athainaṃ śaradhārābhir dhārābhir iva tōyadaḥ . abhyavarṣata saṃkruddhō lakṣmaṇō rāvaṇātmajam ।।
rāmasyārthē parākramya vānarās tyaktajīvitāḥ . nardantas tē ‘nivṛttās tu samarē saśilāyudhāḥ ।।
tasya vānaraśārdūla catasrō mūrdhni saṃbhavāḥ . drakṣyasyōṣadhayō dīptā dīpaynatīr diśō daśa ।।
tataḥ sragdāmasaṃnaddhaṃ dattapañcāṅgulaṃ śubham . ādadē parighaṃ dhīrō mahēndraśikharōpamam ।।
cukruśuś ca tadā saṃkhyē bhīmaṃ laṅkānivāsinaḥ nikumbhēnōdyataṃ dṛṣṭvā hanūmantaṃ mahābalam ।।
nirgataṃ makarākṣaṃ te dṛṣṭvā vānarapuṃgavāḥ āplutya sahasā sarve yoddhukāmā vyavasthitāḥ R_6,066.
devadānavagandharvāḥ kiṃnarāś ca mahoragāḥ antarikṣagatāḥ sarve draṣṭukāmās tad adbhutam R_6,066.
śastrāṇi śarapatrāṇi samidho 'tha vibhītakāḥ lohitāni ca vāsāṃsi sruvaṃ kārṣṇāyasaṃ tathā R_6,067.
sa tena saha sainyena saṃnikarṣaṃ mahāyaśāḥ śīghram āgamya rāmāya duḥkhito vākyam abravīt R_6,070.
tasyaite niśitās tīkṣṇāḥ patripatrāṅgavājinaḥ patatriṇa ivāsaumyāḥ śarāḥ pāsyanti śoṇitam R_6,071.
sa hi brahmāstravit prājño mahāmāyo mahābalaḥ karoty asaṃjñān saṃgrāme devān savaruṇān api R_6,072.
so 'bhivādya guroḥ pādau kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam nikumbhilām abhiyayau caityaṃ rāvaṇipālitam R_6,072.
śarair atimahāvegair vegavān rāvaṇātmajaḥ saumitrim indrajid yuddhe vivyādha śubhalakṣaṇam R_6,075.
bāṇajālaiḥ śarīrasthair avagāḍhais tarasvinau śuśubhāte mahāvīryau prarūḍhāv iva parvatau R_6,076.
viṣaṇṇavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṃ hariyūthapāḥ tataḥ paramasaṃhṛṣṭo lakṣmaṇaṃ cābhyapūjayan R_6,077.
atha vā tau naravyāghrau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau mannimittam anāryeṇa samare 'dya nipātitau R_6,080.
kathaṃ sarvaguṇair hīnā guṇavantaṃ mahaujasaṃ sumukhaṃ durmukhī rāmaṃ kāmayām āsa rākṣasī R_6,082.
rāmahastād daśagrīvaḥ śūro dattamahāvaraḥ idaṃ bhayaṃ mahāghoram samutpannaṃ na budhyate R_6,082.
pragṛhya vipulāṃ ghorāṃ mahīdharasamāṃ śilām cikṣepa ca mahātejās tad vadhāya harīśvaraḥ R_6,085.
visphārayitum ārebhe tataḥ sa dhanur uttamam mahāvegaṃ mahānādaṃ nirbhindann iva medinīm R_6,087.
tayoḥ śarapathaṃ prāpya rāvaṇo rājaputrayoḥ sa babhau ca yathā rāhuḥ samīpe śaśisūryayoḥ R_6,087.
śarāndhakāraṃ ākāśaṃ cakratuḥ prathamaṃ tadā gate 'staṃ tapane cāpi mahāmeghāv ivotthitau R_6,087.
taṃ vimokṣayituṃ vīraś cāpam āyamya lakṣmaṇaḥ rāvaṇaṃ śaktihastaṃ vai śaravarṣair avākirat R_6,088.
sa dadarśa tato rāmaḥ śaktyā bhinnaṃ mahāhave lakṣmaṇaṃ rudhirādigdhaṃ sapannagam ivācalam R_6,088.
yadi vadham icchasi rāvaṇasya saṃkhye | yadi ca kṛtāṃ hi tavecchasi pratijñām | yadi tava rājasutābhilāṣa ārya | kuru ca vaco mama śīgram adya vīra
variants.b_text: यदिवधमिच्छसिरावणस्यसङ्ख्येयदि च कृतांहितवेच्छसिप्रतिज्ञाम् । यदितवराजसुताभिलाषआर्यकुरु च वचोममशीघ्रमद्यवीर ।।6.102.49।।

variants.a_text: sahasrākṣeṇa kākutstha ratho ‘yaṃ vijayāya te | dattas tava mahāsattva śrīmāñ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
sa śaraiḥ śarajālāni vārayan samare sthitaḥ gabhastīn iva sūryasya pratijagrāha vīryavān R_6,092.
utsekenābhipannasya garhitasyāhitasya ca karmaṇaḥ prāpnuhīdānīṃ tasyādya sumahat phalam R_6,092.
kṣiptāś cāśu śarās tena śastrāṇi vividhāni ca maraṇārthāya vartante mṛtyukālo 'bhyavartata R_6,092.
kimarthaṃ mām avajñāya macchandam anavekṣya ca tvayā śatrusamakṣaṃ me ratho 'yam apavāhitaḥ R_6,093.
nāśayatyeṣa vai bhūtaṃ tam eva sṛjati prabhuḥ | pāyaty eṣa tapatyeṣa varṣatyeṣa gabhastibhiḥ
gṛdhrair anugatāś cāsya vamantyo jvalanaṃ mukhaiḥ | praṇedur mukham īkṣantyaḥ saṃrabdham aśivaṃ śivāḥ
tau tu tatra nimittāni dṛṣṭvā rāghavarāvaṇau | kṛtabuddhī sthirāmarṣau yuyudhāte abhītavat
kācid aṅke śiraḥ kṛtvā ruroda mukham īkṣatī | snāpayantī mukhaṃ bāṣpais tuṣārair iva paṅkajam
avadhyo devatānāṃ yas tathā dānavarakṣasām | hataḥ so ‘yaṃ raṇe śete mānuṣeṇa padātinā
tad gaccha tvānujāne ‘dya yatheṣṭaṃ janakātmaje | etā daśa diśo bhadre kāryam asti na me tvayā
yathā māṃ śuddhacaritāṃ duṣṭāṃ jānāti rāghavaḥ | tathā lokasya sākṣī māṃ sarvataḥ pātu pāvakaḥ
rudrāṇām aṣṭamo rudraḥ sādhyānāmapi pañcamaḥ | aśvinau cāpi karṇau te sūryācandrāmasau dṛśau
eṣa rājā daśaratho vimānasthaḥ pitā tava | kākutstha mānuṣe loke gurus tava mahāyaśāḥ
siddhārthāḥ khalu te rāma narā ye tvāṃ purīṃ gatam | rājye caivābhiṣiktaṃ ca drakṣyanti vasudhādhipam
na tvaṃ kāmaṃ samādheyā bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇaṃ prati | avaśyaṃ tu mayā vācyam eṣa te daivataṃ param
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā bhāryayā saha | arcitah sarvakāmais tvaṃ tato rāma gamiṣyasi
tatas tān pūjitān dṛṣṭvā ratnārthair hariyūthapān | āruroha tadā rāmas tad vimānam anuttamam
tatah sa puṣpakaṃ divyaṃ sugrīvaḥ saha vānaraiḥ | āruroha mudā yuktaḥ samātyaś ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
tam utkṣipya mahānādam ūrdhvabāhum adhomukham | nikhāte prakṣipanti sma nadantam iva kuñjaram
taṃ samutthāya kākutsthaś cirasyākṣipathaṃ gatam | aṅke bharatam āropya muditaḥ pariṣasvaje
tvam asmākaṃ caturṇāṃ vai bhrātā sugrīva pañcamaḥ | sauhārdāj jāyate mitram apakāro ‘rilakṣaṇam
iti te mantriṇaḥ sarve saṃdiśya ca purohitaḥ nagarān niryayus tūrṇaṃ rāmadarśanabuddhayaḥ
tac ca madbhavanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāśokavanikaṃ mahat | muktāvaidūryasaṅkīrṇaṃ sugrīvasya nivedaya
prayutaṃ rakṣasām atra paścimadvāram āśritam carmakhaḍgadharāḥ sarve tathā sarvāstrakovidāḥ
śataśo’tha sahasrāṇi madhyamaṃ skandham āśritāḥ yātudhānā durādharṣāḥ sāgrakoṭiś ca rakṣasām
yadā tu rāmasya salakṣmaṇasya | prasahya sītā khalu sā ihāhṛtā | sakṛt samīkṣyaiva suniścitam tadā | bhajeta cittaṃ yamuneva yāmunam ||
balāt kukkuṭavṛttena pravartasva mahābala | ākramyākramya sītām vai tām bhuṅksva ca ramasva ca ||
vadhas tu rāmasya mayā tvayā ca | prahasta sarvair api rākṣasair vā | katham bhaved arthaviśāradasya | mahārṇavam tartum ivāplavasya ||
ayam ca rājā vyasanābhibhūto | mitrair amitrapratimair bhavadbhiḥ | anvāsyate rākṣasanāśanārthe | tīkṣṇaḥ prakṛtyā hy asamīkṣyakārī ||
dhanāni ratnāni subhūṣaṇāni | vāsāṃsi divyāni maṇīṃśca citrān | sītāṃ ca rāmāya nivedya devīm | vasema rājann iha vītaśokāḥ ||
etat tu vacanam śrutvā sugrīvo laghuvikramaḥ | lakṣmaṇasya agrato rāmam saṃrabdham idam abravīt ||
arthānarthau viniścitya vyavasāyam bhajeta ha | guṇataḥ saṃgraham kuryād doṣatas tu visarjayet ||
vibhīṣaṇasya śūrasya yathārthaṃ kriyatāṃ vacaḥ | alaṃ kālātyayaṃ kṛtvā sāgarāsya niyujyatām || yatha sainyena gacchāma puriṃ rāvaṇapālitam ||
sa ca patralaghur bhūtvā haribhir darśite ‘bhaye | antarikṣe sthito bhūtvā punar vacanam abravīt ||
evam uktvā dhanuṣpāṇiḥ krodhavisphāritekṣaṇaḥ | babhūva rāmo durdharṣo yugāntāgnir iva jvalan ||
pṛthivī vāyur ākāśam āpo jyotiś ca rāghavaḥ | svabhāve saumya tiṣṭhanti śāśvatam mārgam āśritāḥ ||
nanāda ca tadā tatra vasudhā śalyapīḍitā | tasmād bāṇamukhāt toyam utpapāta rasātalāt ||
rākṣasam tu virūpākṣam mahāvīryaparākramam | madhyame asthāpayad gulme bahubhih saha rākṣasaiḥ ||
tapanēna gajaḥ sārdhaṃ rākṣasēna mahābalaḥ . nikumbhēna mahātējā nīlō ‘pi samayudhyata ||
tatas trijaṭayā sārdhaṃ puṣpakād avaruhya sā . aśōkavanikām ēva rākṣasībhiḥ pravēśitā ||
anyōnyasya na lajjantē na nirīkṣanti pṛṣṭhataḥ . viprakarṣanti cānyōnyaṃ patitaṃ laṅghayanti ca ||
rākṣasās tv abhisaṃkruddhā vānarān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ . vivyadhur ghōrasaṃkāśaiḥ kaṅkapatrair ajihmagaiḥ ||
vyāharanta mṛgā ghōrā rakṣasāṃ nidhanaṃ tadā . samāpatantō yōdhās tu prāskhalaṃs tatra dāruṇam ||
vyūḍhēnaiva sughōrēṇa pūrvadvārāt sa niryayau gajayūthanikāśēna balēna mahatā vṛtaḥ ||
sa tat tadā sūrya ivābhrajālaṃ praviśya rakṣōdhipatēr nivēśanam . dadarśa dūrē ‘grajam āsanasthaṃ svayambhuvaṃ śakra ivāsanastham ।।
sō ‘bhigamya gṛhaṃ bhrātuḥ kakṣyām abhivigāhya ca . dadarśōdvignam āsīnaṃ vimānē puṣpakē gurum ।।
vibhramāc cittamōhād vā balavīryāśrayēṇa vā . nābhipannam idānīṃ yad vyarthā tasya punaḥ kathā ।।
purarōdhasya mūlaṃ tu rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ . hatē tasmin hataṃ sarvaṃ taṃ vadhiṣyāmi saṃyugē ।।
palāyanēna cōddiṣṭāḥ prāṇān rakṣāmahē vayam . ēkēna bahavō bhagnā yaśōnāśaṃ gamiṣyati ।।
tan mēruśikharākārair dyōtamānam iva śriyā dvē śatē vānarāṇāṃ ca patamānam apātayat ।।
yē tu pūrvaṃ mahātmānaḥ kumbhakarṇēna pātitāḥ . tē svasthā vānaraśrēṣṭhāḥ sugrīvam upatasthirē ।।
kālajihvāprakāśābhir ya ēṣō ‘bhivirājatē . āvṛtō rathaśaktībhir vidyudbhir iva tōyadaḥ ।।
taṃ nikṛttaṃ śaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛttabhōgam ivōragam atikāyō bhṛśaṃ kruddhaḥ pañca bāṇān samādadhē ।।
te ‘tikāyaṃ samāsādya kavacē vajrabhūṣitē . bhagnāgraśalyāḥ sahasā pētur bāṇā mahītalē ।।
taṃ brahmaṇō ‘strēṇa niyujya cāpē śaraṃ sapuṅkhaṃ yamadūtakalpam . saumitrir indrārisutasya tasya sasarja bāṇaṃ yudhi vajrakalpam ।।
tān sarvān hi samādiśya rāvaṇō rākṣasādhipaḥ . manyuśalyaṃ vahan dīnaḥ pravivēśa svam ālayam ।।
variants.b_text: स तान् सर्वान् हिसन्दिश्यरावणोराक्षसाधिपः । मन्युशल्यंवहन् दीनःप्रविवेशस्वमालयम् ।।6.72.17।।

variants.a_text: bāṇaughair arditāś cāpi kharaputreṇa vānarāḥ saṃbhrāntamanasaḥ sarve dudruvur bhayapīḍitāḥ R_6,066.
tvam apratimakarmāṇam indraṃ jayasi saṃyuge kiṃ punar mānuṣau dṛṣṭvā na vadhiṣyasi saṃyuge R_6,067.
tam enaṃ māyinaṃ kṣudram antarhitarathaṃ balāt rākṣasaṃ nihaniṣyanti dṛṣṭvā vānarayūthapāḥ R_6,067.
sa paścimena dvāreṇa niryayau rākṣasair vṛtaḥ indrajit sumahāvīryaḥ paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ R_6,068.
dharmāt pracyutaśīlaṃ hi puruṣaṃ pāpaniścayam tyaktvā sukham avapnoti hastād aśīviṣaṃ yathā R_6,074.
tau bhāsayantāv ākāśaṃ dhanurbhyāṃ viśikhau cyutau mukhena mukham āhatya saṃnipetatur ojasā R_6,078.
prakṣīṇaṃ tu balaṃ dṛṣṭvā vadhyamānaṃ valīmukhaiḥ babhūvāsya vyathā yuddhe prekṣya daivaviparyayam R_6,085.
aprāptām eva tāṃ bāṇais tribhiś ciccheda lakṣmaṇaḥ athodatiṣṭhat saṃnādo vānarāṇāṃ mahāraṇe R_6,088.
mokṣitas te balaślāghin yasmād evaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ vimucya rākṣasaṃ śaktis tvayīyaṃ vinipātyate R_6,088.
acintayitvā tān bāṇān samāśliṣya ca lakṣmaṇam abravīc ca hanūmantaṃ sugrīvaṃ ca mahākapim R_6,088.
variants.b_text: अचिन्तयित्वातान्बाणान्समालशिष्य च लक्ष्मणम् ।।6.101.45।। अब्रवीच्चहनूमन्तंसुग्रीवं च महाकपिम् ।

variants.a_text: adya te maccharaiś chinnaṃ śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam kravyādā vyapakarṣantu vikīrṇaṃ raṇapāṃsuṣu R_6,092.
ity evaṃ sa vadan vīro rāmaḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ rākṣasendraṃ samīpasthaṃ śaravarṣair avākirat R_6,092.
tato drutaṃ rāvaṇavākyacoditaḥ pracodayām āsa hayān sa sārathiḥ sa rākṣasendrasya tato mahārathaḥ kṣaṇena rāmasya raṇāgrato 'bhavat R_6,093.
mārīcakumbhakarṇābhyāṃ vākyaṃ mama pitus tathā | na kṛtaṃ vīryamattena tasyedaṃ phalam īdṛśam
atilakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ mādhuryaguṇabhūṣaṇam | buddhyā hy aṣṭāṅgayā yuktaṃ tvam evārhasi bhāṣitum
pṛthakstrīṇāṃ pracāreṇa jātiṃ tvaṃ pariśaṅkase | parityajaināṃ śaṅkāṃ tu yadi te ‘haṃ parīkṣitā
tvayā tu nṛpaśārdūla roṣam evānuvartatā | laghuneva manuṣyeṇa strītvam eva puraskṛtam
tato hi durmanā rāmaḥ śrutvaivam vadatāṃ giraḥ | dadhyau muhūrtaṃ dharmātmā bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ
pralobhyamānā vividhaṃ tarjyamānā ca maithilī | nācintayata tad rakṣas tvadgatenāntarātmanā
kalyāṇī bata gātheyaṃ laukikī pratibhāti me | eti jīvantam ānando naraṃ varṣaśatād api
prahastam avadhīn nīlaḥ kumbhakarṇaṃ tu rāghavaḥ | lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇasutaṃ svayaṃ rāmas tu rāvaṇam ||
kuṭumbavṛddhiṃ dhanadhānyavṛddhiṃ | striyaśca mukhyāh sukham uttamaṃ ca | śrutvā śubhaṃ kāvyam idaṃ mahārthaṃ | prāpnoti sarvāṃ bhuvi cārthasiddhim
tato vinikṣipya balam sarvam nagaraguptaye | prahastaḥ pramukhe rājño niṣasāda jagāda ca ||
ayam hi suptaḥ ṣaṇmāsān kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ | sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ mukhyaḥ sa idānīṃ samutthitaḥ ||
evam uktas tadā rājā mahāpārśvena rāvaṇaḥ | tasya sampūjayan vākyam idam vacanam abravīt ||
pṛccyamāno viśanketa sahasā buddhimān vacaḥ | tatra mitram praduṣyeta mithyā pṛṣṭam sukhāgatam ||
na vayam tatkulīnāśca rājyakāṅkṣī ca rākṣasaḥ | paṇḍitā hi bhaviṣyanti tasmād grāhyo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
evam doṣo mahān atra prapannānām arakṣaṇe | asvargyam ca ayaśasyam ca balavīryavināśanam ||
vātāśca kaluṣā vānti kampate ca vasundharā | parvatāgrāṇi vepante patanti ca mahīruhāḥ ||
śukasya vacanam śrutvā rāvaṇo vākyam abravīt | roṣasamraktanayano nirdahann iva cakṣuṣā ||
vṛtaḥ koṭisahasreṇa harīṇām samavasthitaḥ | eṣaivāśaṃsate laṅkām svenānīkena marditum ||
uttīrya sāgaram rāmaḥ saha vānarasenayā | samniviṣṭaḥ samudrasya tīram āsādya dakṣiṇam ||
atha harivaranāthaḥ prāptasaṃgrāmakīrtir | niśicarapatimājau yojayitvā śrameṇa | gaganam ativiśālaṃ laṅghayitvārkasūnur | harigaṇabalamadhye rāmapārśvaṃ jagāma ||
rāvaṇas tu paraṃ cakrē krōdhaṃ prāsādadharṣaṇāt . vināśaṃ cātmanaḥ paśyan niḥśvāsaparamo ‘bhavat ||
punaḥ śaraśatēnātha kṣiprahastō niśācaraḥ . bibhēda samarē nīlaṃ nikumbhaḥ prajahāsa ca ||
indrajit tu tadānena nirjitō bhīmakarmaṇā . saṃyugē vāliputrēṇa krōdhaṃ cakrē sudāruṇam ||
yudhyamānam anālakṣayaṃ śakrō ‘pi tridaśēśvaraḥ . draṣṭum āsādituṃ vāpi na śaktaḥ kiṃ punar yuvām ||
tau tu krūrēṇa nihatau rakṣasā kāmarūpiṇā . asṛk susruvatus tīvraṃ jalaṃ prasravaṇāv iva ||
tatas salilam ādāya vidyayā parijapyaca sugrīvanētrē dharmātmā pramamārja vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
vimānēnāpi gatvā tu sītā trijaṭayā saha . dadarśa vānarāṇāṃ tu sarvaṃ sainyaṃ nipātitam ||
vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ tat tu saṃnivartya manōjavam . dīnā trijaṭayā sītā laṅkām ēva pravēśitā ||
kiṃ nu vakṣyāmi kausalyāṃ mātaraṃ kiṃ nu kaikayīm . katham ambāṃ sumitrāṃ ca putradarśanalālasām ||
tē bhīmavēgā harayō nardamānās tatas tataḥ . mamanthū rākṣasān vīrān nāmāni ca babhāṣire ||
pārśvēṣu dāritāḥ kēcit kēcid rāśīkṛtā drumaiḥ . śilābhiś cūrṇitāḥ kēcit kēcid dantair vidāritāḥ ||
tēṣu laṅkāṃ praviṣṭēṣu rākṣasēṣu mahābalāḥ . samētya harayaḥ sarvē hanūmantam apūjayan ||
sa śailajīmūtanikāśarūpair māṃsāśanaiḥ pāvakadīptanētraiḥ . babhau vṛtō rākṣasarājamukhyō bhūtair vṛtō rudra ivāsurēśaḥ ।।
ēkēna vānarēṇēyaṃ pūrvaṃ dagdhā mahāpurī . kumārō nihataś cākṣaḥ sānuyātraḥ sakuñjaraḥ ।।
tēṣu saṃbhakṣyamāṇēṣu prajā bhayanipīḍitāḥ . yānti sma śaraṇaṃ śakraṃ tam apy arthaṃ nyavēdayan ।।
sa kunbhakarṇaṃ kupitō mahēndrō jaghāna vajrēṇa śitēna vajrī . sa śakravajrābhihatō mahātmā cacāla kōpāc ca bhṛśaṃ nanāda ।।
ēvaṃ prajā yadi tv ēṣa bhakṣayiṣyati nityaśaḥ . acirēṇaiva kālēna śūnyō lōkō bhaviṣyati ।।
naitan manasi kartavyaṃ mayi jīvati pārthiva . tam ahaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi yat kṛtē paritapyatē ।।
sadṛśaṃ yat tu kale ‘smin kartuṃ snigdhēna bandhunā . śatrūṇāṃ kadanaṃ paśya kriyamāṇaṃ mayā raṇē ।।
niḥśrēyasaphalāv ēva dharmārthāv itarāvapi . adharmānarthayōḥ prāptaṃ phalaṃ ca pratyavāyikam ।।
saṃgaccha śūlam ādāya pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ . vānarān rājaputrau ca bhakṣyādityatējasau ।।
tad vānarānīkam atipracaṇḍaṃ diśō dravadbhinnam ivābhrajālam . sa kumbhakarṇaḥ samavēkṣya harṣān nanāda bhūyō ghanavad ghanābhaḥ ।।
tē tasya ghōraṃ ninadaṃ niśamya yathā ninādaṃ divi vāridasya . pētur dharaṇyāṃ bahavaḥ plavaṅgā nikṛttamūlā iva śālavṛkṣāḥ ।।
apūrayat tasya mukhaṃ śitāgrai rāmaḥ śarair hēmapinaddhapuṅkhaiḥ . saṃpūrṇavaktrō na śaśāka vaktuṃ cukūja kṛcchrēṇa mumūrcha cāpi ।।
ēvam ēva mahāvīryō hatō nas tātamadhyamaḥ . na tu satpuruṣā rājan vilapanti yathā bhavān ।।
samāsthāya mahātējā rathaṃ harirathōpamam . jagāma sahasā tatra yatra yuddham ariṃdamaḥ ।।
kim etad evaṃ suviniścitaṃ te yad rāghave nāsi kṛtānukampaḥ paśyādya madbāhubalābhibhūto vikīrṇam ātmānam atho nagendra ||
sarvē viśalyā virujāḥ kṣaṇēna haripravīrāś ca hatāś ca yē syuḥ . gandhēna tāsāṃ pravarauṣadhīnāṃ suptā niśāntēṣv iva saṃprabuddhāḥ ।।
udghuṣṭaṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ ca niḥsvanaṃ . diśō daśa samudraṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca vyanādayat ।।
variants.b_text: उद्घुष्टंवानराणां च राक्षसानां च निस्स्वनः । दिशोदशसमुद्रं च पृथिवींचान्वनादयत् ।।6.75.34।।

variants.a_text: vānarōdghuṣṭaghōṣaś ca rākṣasānāṃ ca niḥsvanaḥ . jyāśabdaś cāpi rāmasya trayaṃ vyāpa diśō daśa ।।
sa kumbhaṃ ca nikumbhaṃ ca kumbhakarṇātmajāv ubhau . prēṣayāmāsa saṃkruddhō rākṣasasair bahubhiḥ saha ।।
variants.b_text: स निकुम्भं च कुम्भं च कुम्भकर्णात्मजावुभौ । प्रेषयामाससङ्कृद्धोराक्षससैर्बहुभिस्सह ।।6.75.47।।

variants.a_text: varadānāt pitṛvyas tē sahatē dēvadānavān . kumbhakarṇas tu vīryēṇa sahatē ca surāsurān ।।
rākṣasā vānarāś cāpi na śēkuḥ spandituṃ bhayāt hanūmāṃs tu vivṛtyōras tasthau tasyāgratō balī ।।
diṣṭyāsi darśanaṃ rāma mama tvaṃ prāptavān iha kāṅkṣito 'si kṣudhārtasya siṃhasyevetaro mṛgaḥ R_6,066.
mohanārthaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ buddhiṃ kṛtvā sudurmatiḥ hantuṃ sītāṃ vyavasito vānarābhimukho yayau R_6,068.
sugrīvas tvaṃ ca rāmaś ca yannimittam ihāgatāḥ tāṃ vadhiṣyāmi vaidehīm adyaiva tava paśyataḥ R_6,068.
tasya ca vyasanābhāvād vyasanaṃ cāgate tvayi dharmo bhavaty adharmaś ca parasparavirodhitau R_6,070.
yasmād arthā vivardhante yeṣv adharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ kliśyante dharmaśīlāś ca tasmād etau nirarthakau R_6,070.
vadhyante pāpakarmāṇo yady adharmeṇa rāghava vadhakarmahato ‘dharmaḥ sa hataḥ kaṃ vadhiṣyati R_6,070.
rāghavas tu ripor jñātvā māyāvīryaṃ durātmanaḥ lakṣmaṇaṃ kīrtisaṃpannam idaṃ vacanam abravīt R_6,072.
ihopahāraṃ bhūtānāṃ balavān rāvaṇātajaḥ upahṛtya tataḥ paścāt saṃgrāmam abhivartate R_6,074.
atha rākṣasasiṃhasya kṛṣṇān kanakabhūṣaṇān śaraiś caturbhiḥ saumitrir vivyādha caturo hayān R_6,077.
praśāntapīḍābahulo vinaṣṭāriḥ praharṣavān babhūva lokaḥ patite rākṣasendrasute tadā R_6,078.
śuddhā āpo nabhaś caiva jahṛṣur devadānavāḥ ājagmuḥ patite tasmin sarvalokabhayāvahe R_6,078.
mayā varṣasahasrāṇi caritvā paramaṃ tapaḥ teṣu teṣv avakāśeṣu svayambhūḥ paritoṣitaḥ R_6,080.
rāvaṇasyāpanītena durvinītasya durmateḥ ayaṃ niṣṭānako ghoraḥ śokena samabhiplutaḥ R_6,082.
adya yuddhapracaṇḍānāṃ harīṇāṃ drumayodhinām muktenaikeṣuṇā yuddhe bhetsyāmi ca śataṃ śatam R_6,083.
tato niṣpatato yuddhe daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ raṇe nidhanaśaṃsīni rūpāṇy etāni jajñire R_6,083.
sa tu prahārābhihataḥ sugrīveṇa mahāgajaḥ apāsarpad dhanurmātraṃ niṣasāda nanāda ca R_6,084.
uvāca ca samīpasthaṃ mahodaram ariṃdamam asmin kāle mahābāho jayāśā tvayi me sthitā R_6,085.
tato jagrāha tejasvī sugrīvo vasudhātalāt āyasaṃ musalaṃ ghoraṃ sarvato hemabhūṣitam R_6,085.
tataḥ śūlāni niścerur gadāś ca musalāni ca kārmukād dīpyamānāni vajrasārāṇi sarvaśaḥ R_6,088.
na hi pratijñāṃ kurvanti vitathāṃ satyavadinaḥ lakṣaṇaṃ hi mahat tv asya pratijñāparipālanam R_6,089.
tacchūlāṃ rāgavo dṛṣṭvā jvalantaṃ ghoradarśanam | sasarja viśikhān rāmaś cāpam āyamya vīryavān ||
nipatyorasi gṛdhrās te kṣitau kṣiptasya rāvaṇa pibantu rudhiraṃ tarṣād bāṇaśalyāntarothitam R_6,092.
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kurvan rāvaṇasya mahāratham | cakrasaṃbhūtarajasā rāvaṇaṃ vyavadhūnayat
rudhirāktah sa vegena śarīrāntakaraḥ śaraḥ | rāvaṇasya haran prāṇān viveśa dharaṇītalam
evaṃ vadantyo rurudus tasya tā duḥkhitāḥ striyaḥ | bhūya eva ca duḥkhārtā vilepuś ca punaḥ punaḥ
ity evaṃ vadataḥ śrutvā sītā rāmasya tad vacaḥ | mṛgīvotphullanayanā babhūvāśrupariplutā
matkṛte viprayuktā ye putrair dāraiś ca vānarāḥ | tān prītamanasaḥ sarvān draṣṭum icchāmi mānada
vidyunmālī hataś cātra suṣeṇena mahātmanā | lakṣmaṇenendrajic cātra rāvaṇir nihato raṇe
brāhmaṇārthe niyuktasya rakṣataḥ sarvatāpasān | rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā babhūveyam aninditā
sa pṛṣṭo rājaputreṇa bṛsyāṃ samupaveśitaḥ | ācacakṣe tataḥ sarvaṃ rāmasya caritaṃ vane
tato rāmābhyanujñātaṃ tad vimānam anuttamam | haṃsayuktaṃ mahāvegam nipapāta mahītalam
abravīt tu tadā rāmas tad vimānam anuttamam | vaha vaiśravaṇaṃ devam anujānāmi gamyatām
nirdasyur abhaval loko nānarthaḥ kaścid aspṛśat | na ca sma vṛddhā bālānāṃ pretakāryāṇi kurvate
tatreṣūpalayantrāṇi balavanti mahānti ca āgatam pratisainyam tais tatra pratinivāryate
saṃpṛktaṃ nabhasāpy ambhaḥ saṃpṛktaṃ ca nabho 'mbhasā tādṛgrūpe sma dṛśyete tārāratnasamākule
variants.b_text: सम्पृक्तं नभसाप्यम्भस्सम्पृक्तं च नभोऽम्भसा । तादृग्रूपेच दृश्यते तारारत्नसमाकुले ।।6.4.119।।

variants.a_text: agniṣṭheṣv agniśālāsu tathā brahmasthalīṣu ca sarīsṛpāṇi dṛśyante havyeṣu ca pipīlikāḥ
rathaiś cātirathā śīghram mataiś ca varavāraṇaiḥ anūtpetur daśagrīvam ākrīḍadbhiś ca vājibhiḥ
adeyā ca yathā sītā vadhyau daśarathātmajau | bhavadbhir mantryatām mantraḥ sunītam cābhidhīyatām ||
mūḍho ‘pragalbho ‘vinayopapannas | tīkṣaṇasvabhāvo ‘lpamatir durātmā | mūrkhas tvam atyantasudurmatiś ca | tvam indrajid bālatayā bravīṣi ||
sakṛd eva prapannāya tavāsmīti ca yācate | abhayam sarvabhūtebhyo dadāmy etad vratam mama ||
taccāsya balam ādāsye balena mahatā vṛtaḥ | jyotiṣām iva sarveṣām prabhām udyan divākaraḥ ||
kaś ca senāpatis teṣām vānarāṇām mahaujasām | tacca jñātvā yathā tattvam śīghram āgantum arhathaḥ ||
śvaḥ kālye nagarīm laṅkām saprākārām satoraṇām | rākṣasam ca balam paśya śarair vidhvaṃsitam mayā ||
na te cārayitum śakyā rājan vānarapumgavāḥ | vikrāntā balavantaś ca rāghaveṇa ca rakṣitāḥ ||
athaivam uktaḥ śārdūlo rāvaṇenottamaś caraḥ | idam vacanam ārebhe vaktum rāvaṇasamnidhau ||
tatprahastapraṇītena balena mahatā mama | balamasya hatam rātrau yatra rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ||
sa tasyāḥ paripṛccantyā vadham mitrabalasya te | tava cākhyāsyate nūnam niśāyām rākṣasair vadham ||
sa baddhvā bhrukuṭim vaktre krodhasya vaśamāgataḥ | amarṣāt parivṛttākṣo mālyavantam athābravīt ||
evam bruvāṇam saṃrabdham ruṣṭam vijnāya rāvaṇam | vrīḍito mālyavān vākyam nottaram pratyapadyata ||
atha teṣu bruvāṇeṣu rāvaṇāvarajo ‘bravīt | vākyam agrāmyapadavat puṣkalārtham vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
krodhavegena saṃyuktaḥ sattvena ca balena ca | acalāgrād athotthāya pupluve gopurasthale ||
sthitvā muhūrtaṃ samprekṣya nirbhayenāntarātmanā | tṛṇīkṛtya ca tadrakṣaḥ so ‘bravīt paruṣaṃ vacaḥ ||
niṣpandau tu tadā dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau vasudhāyāṃ nirucchvāsau hatāv ity anvamanyata ||
tataḥ sarvāṇy anīkāni sthāpayitvā vibhīṣaṇaḥ ājagāma gadāpāṇis tvaritaṃ yatra rāghavaḥ ||
tēṣāṃ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ saṃjajñē kapirakṣasām . anyōnyaṃ pādapair ghōrair nighnatāṃ śūlamudgaraiḥ ||
dhanurjyātantrimadhuraṃ hikkātālasamanvitam . mandastanitagītaṃ tad yuddhagāndharvam ābabhau ||
ātmānaṃ tv apraharaṇaṃ jñātvā krōdhasamanvitaḥ . śailam utpāṭayāmāsa vēgēna haripuṃgavaḥ ||
na śēkuḥ samavasthātuṃ nihatē vāhinīpatau . sētubandhaṃ samāsādya viśīrṇaṃ salilaṃ yathā ||
yō vajrapātaśanisaṃnipātān na cakṣubhē nāpi cacāla rājā . sa rāmabāṇābhihatō bhṛśārtaś cacāla cāpaṃ ca mumōca vīraḥ ।।
sa kāñcanamayaṃ divyam āśritya paramāsanam . viprēkṣamāṇō rakṣāṃsi rāvaṇō vākyam abravīt ।।
adya rākṣasarājasya bhayam utpāṭayāmy aham . dārayiṣyē mahēndraṃ vā śītayiṣyē tathānalam ।।
ēkēnāhnā tv asau vīraś caran bhūmiṃ bubhukṣitaḥ . vyāttāsyō bhakṣayēl lōkān saṃvṛddha iva pāvakaḥ ।।
tad ētat sarvam ātiṣṭha vīryaṃ bhīmaparākrama na hi tē sarvabhūtēṣu dṛśyatē sadṛśō balī ।।
[mamajjur arṇavē kēcid guhāḥ kēcit samāśritāḥ] nipētuḥ kēcid aparē kēcin naivāvatasthirē kēcid bhūmau nipatitāḥ kēcit suptā mṛtā iva ।।
kṛcchrēṇa ca samāśvastāḥ saṃgamya ca tatas tataḥ vṛkṣādrihastā harayas tasthuḥ saṃgrāmamūrthani ।।
prakṣiptāḥ kumbakarṇēna vaktrē pātālasaṃnibhē . nāsāpuṭābhyāṃ saṃjagmuḥ karṇābhyāṃ caiva vānarāḥ ।।
rājyēna nāsti mē kāryaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi sītayā . kumbhakarṇavihīnasya jīvitē nāsti mē matiḥ ।।
rathēna ca rathaṃ cāpi vāraṇēnāpi vāraṇam hayēna ca hayaṃ kēcin nijaghnur vānarā raṇē ।।
variants.b_text: रथेन च रथंचापिवारणेनैववारणम् ।।6.69.61।। हयेन च हयंकेचिन्निजघ्नुर्वानरारणे ।

variants.a_text: sa vānarān sapta śatāni vīraḥ prāsēna dīptēna vinirbibhēda . ēkaḥ kṣaṇēnēndraripur mahātmā jaghāna sainyaṃ haripuṃgavānām ।।
vajraniṣpēṣasadṛśaṃ prāsasyābhinipātanam . na śēkur vānarāḥ sōḍhuṃ tē vinēdur mahāsvanam ।।
dēvāntakāya taṃ vīraś cikṣēpa sahasāṅgadaḥ . mahāvṛkṣaṃ mahāśākhaṃ śakrō dīptam ivāśanim ।।
atha rṣabhaḥ samutpatya vānarō rāvaṇānujam . mattānīkam upāgamya tasthau tasyāgratō balī ।।
tat tasya vākyaṃ bruvatō niśamya cukōpa saumitrir amitrahantā . amṛṣyamāṇaś ca samutpapāta jagrāha cāpaṃ ca tataḥ smayitvā ।।
atikāyēna saumitris tāḍitō yudhi vakṣasi susrāva rudhiraṃ tīvraṃ madaṃ matta iva dvipaḥ ।।
saptabhis tu mahāvīryō maindaṃ marmavidāraṇaiḥ . pañcabhir viśikhaiś caiva gajaṃ vivyādha saṃyugē ।।
gopurāṭṭa pratolīṣu caryāsu vividhāsu ca prāsādeṣu ca saṃhṛṣṭāḥ sasṛjus te hutāśanam R_6,062.
sṛṣṭān dvividamaindābhyāṃ drumān utpāṭya vīryavān . babhañja gadayā madhyē śōṇitākṣaḥ pratāpavān ।।
atha tān rākṣasān sarvān makarākṣō ‘bravīd idam . yūyaṃ sarvē prayudhyadhvaṃ purastān mama rākṣasāḥ ।।
tau hanyamānau nārācair dhārābhir iva parvatau hemapuṅkhān naravyāghrau tigmān mumucatuḥ śarān R_6,067.
abhipetuś ca garjanto rākṣasān vānararṣabhāḥ parivārya hanūmantam anvayuś ca mahāhave R_6,069.
rāmam āśvāsamāne tu lakṣmaṇe bhrātṛvatsale nikṣipya gulmān svasthāne tatrāgacchad vibhīṣaṇaḥ R_6,071.
vibhīṣaṇamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvaṃ tāṃś ca vānarān lakṣmaṇovāca mandārtham idaṃ bāṣpapariplutaḥ R_6,071.
svam anīkaṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ tu śrutvā śatrubhir arditam udatiṣṭhata durdharṣaḥ sa karmaṇy ananuṣṭhite R_6,073.
vṛkṣāndhakārān niṣkramya jātakrodhaḥ sa rāvaṇiḥ āruroha rathaṃ sajjaṃ pūrvayuktaṃ susaṃyatām R_6,073.
astrāṇy astravidāṃ śreṣṭhau darśayantau punaḥ punaḥ śarān uccāvacākārān antarikṣe babandhatuḥ R_6,076.
suvarṇapuṅkhair nāracair balavantau kṛtavraṇau prasusravāte rudhiraṃ kīrtimantau jaye dhṛtau R_6,076.
teṣāṃ saṃjalpamānānām aśokavanikāṃ gatām abhidudrāva vaidehīṃ rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ R_6,080.
evaṃ pravṛtte saṅgāme hy adbhutaṃ sumahad rajaḥ rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca śāntaṃ śoṇitavisravaiḥ R_6,081.
tadā gadābhir gurvībhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ nirjaghnur vānarān ghorān rākṣasāḥ parvatopamāḥ R_6,081.
jāmbavantaṃ tribhir bāṇair ājaghāna stanāntare ṛkṣarājaṃ gavākṣaṃ ca jaghāna bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ R_6,086.
tasya bāṇaiś ca ciccheda dhanur gajakaropamam lakṣmaṇo rākṣasendrasya pañcabhir niśitais tadā R_6,088.
tām anuvyāharac chaktim āpatantīṃ sa rāghavaḥ svastyas tu lakṣmaṇāyeti moghā bhava hatodyamā R_6,088.
tasya niṣkarṣataḥ śaktiṃ rāvaṇena balīyasā śarāḥ sarveṣu gātreṣu pātitā marmabhedinaḥ R_6,088.
bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇena durātmanā viṣṭanantaṃ tu duḥkhārtaṃ marmaṇyabhihataṃ bhṛśam R_6,089.
sa nīlamiva jīmūtaṃ toyapūrṇam nabhastalāt | utpapāta gṛhītvā tu hanūmāñ śikharaṃ gireḥ R_6,089.
tataḥ śarasahasreṇa rāmam akliṣṭakāriṇam ardayitvā śaraugheṇa mātaliṃ pratyavidhyata R_6,090.
tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ uvāca rāvaṇaṃ vīraḥ prahasya paruṣaṃ vacaḥ R_6,092.
babhūva dviguṇaṃ vīryaṃ balaṃ harṣaś ca saṃyuge rāmasyāstrabalaṃ caiva śatror nidhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ R_6,092.
śubhāny etāni cihnāni vijñāyātmagatāni saḥ bhūya evārdayad rāmo rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasāntakṛt R_6,092.
ājñāpaya yathātattvaṃ vakṣyasy ariniṣūdana tat kariṣyāmy ahaṃ vīra gatānṛṇyena cetasā R_6,093.
saṃtuṣṭas tena vākyena rāvaṇas tasya sāratheḥ praśasyainaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yuddhalubdho 'bravīd idam R_6,093.
tato vineduḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vānarā jitakāśinaḥ | vadanto rāghavajayaṃ rāvaṇasya ca tad vadham
vibhīṣaṇasya ca tathā saphalo ‘dya pariśramaḥ | viguṇaṃ bhrātaraṃ tvaktvā yo māṃ svayam upasthitaḥ
kartā sarvasya lokasya śreṣṭho jñānavidāṃ prabhuḥ | upekṣase kathaṃ sītāṃ patantīṃ havyavāhane | kathaṃ devagaṇaśreṣṭham ātmānaṃ nāvabuddhyase
iti bruvāṇaṃ kākutsthaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ | abravīc chṛṇu me vākyaṃ satyaṃ satyaparākrama
etat paśya yathā kṣipraṃ pratigacchāma tām purīm | ayodhyām gacchato hy eṣa panthāh paramadurgamaḥ
sāṃpratam tu samṛddhārthaṃ samitragaṇabāndhavam | samīkṣya vijitāriṃ ca mamābhūt prītir uttamā
ayodhyāṃ tvarito gatvā śīghraṃ plavagasattama | jānīhi kaccit kuśalī jano nṛpatimandire
Сто двадцать шестая песнь bahūni nāma varṣāṇi gatasya sumahad vanam | śṛṇomy ahaṃ prītikaraṃ mama nāthasya kīrtanam
rākṣasāśca viniṣpiṣṭāḥ kharaśca nihato raṇe | dūṣaṇaṃ cāgrato hatvā triśirās tadanantaram
tathā bruvāṇaṃ bharataṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ bhrātṛvatsalam | mumucur vānarā bāṣpaṃ rākṣasaś ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
tataḥ śatrughnavacanān nipuṇāḥ śmaśruvardhakāḥ | sukhahastāḥ suśīghrāś ca rāghavaṃ paryavārayan
akṣataṃ jātarūpaṃ ca gāvaḥ kanyāḥ sahadvijāḥ | narā modakahastāś ca rāmasya purato yayuḥ
te prārthitān varān sarvān prāpnuvantīha rāghavāt | śravaṇena surāḥ sarve prīyante saṃpraśṛṇvatām
vānarāṇāṃ hi dhīrāṇāṃ sahasraiḥ parivāritaḥ rāmo 'bhyeti purīṃ laṅkām asmākam uparodhakaḥ
akṣayā balavantaś ca śūrā labdhavarāḥ punaḥ tvayā saṃvatsaraṃ yuddhvā samare dānavā vibho
teṣāṃ vīryaguṇotsāhair na samo rāghavo raṇe prasahya te tvayā rājan hatāḥ samaradurjayāḥ
kaumbhakarṇis tato vīro nikumbho nāma vīryavān abravīt paramakurddho rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam
tato mahātmā vipulam suyugyam | ratham varam hemavicitritāṅgam | śubham samāsthāya yayau yaśasvī | vibhīṣaṇaḥ saṃsadam agrajasya ||
sā prasahya mayā bhuktā kṛtā vivasanā tataḥ | svayambhūbhavanam prāptā lolitā nalinī yathā ||
ko hi simham ivāsīnam suptam giriguhāśaye | kruddham mṛtyum ivāsīnam sambodhayitum icchati ||
abravīcca tadā vākyam jātakrodho vibhīṣaṇaḥ | antarikṣagataḥ śrīmān bhrātaram rākṣasādhipam ||
cintayitvā muhūrtam tu vānarāṃs tān uvāca ha | hanūmatpramukhān sarvān idam vacanam uttamam ||
evam uktvā tu tam rāmam samrabdho vāhinīpatiḥ | vākyajño vākyakuśalam tato maunam upāgamat ||
tato maindas tu samprekṣya nayāpanayakovidaḥ | vākyam vacanasampanno babhāṣe hetum uttaram ||
piśācān dānavān yakṣān pṛthivyām caiva rākṣasān | angulyagreṇa tān hanyām icchan harigaṇeśvara ||
variants.b_text: पिशाचानदानवान् यक्ष I नपृथिव्यांचैवराक्षसान् । अङ्गुल्यग्रेणतान् हन्यामिच्छन् हरिगणेश्वर ।।6.18.22।।

variants.a_text: ānayainam hariśreṣṭha dattam asyābhayam mayā | vibhīṣaṇo vā sugrīva yadi vā rāvaṇaḥ svayam ||
vyathitāḥ pannagāś cāsan dīptāsyā dīptalocanāḥ | dānavāś ca mahāvīryāḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ ||
ācāryā guravo vṛddhā vṛthā vām paryupāsitāḥ | sāram yad rājaśāstrāṇām anujīvyam na gṛhyate ||
tato daśagrīvam upasthitās te | cārā bahir nityacarā niśācarāḥ | gireḥ suvelasya samīpavāsinam | nyavedayan bhīmabalam mahābalāḥ ||
etac chrutvā daśagrīvo rākṣasaprativeditam | aśokavanikām tyaktvā mantriṇām darśanam yayau ||
evam uktvā tato gatvā samīpam tasya rakṣasaḥ | śuśrāva kathitam tasya rāvaṇasya samantriṇaḥ ||
ekaikasyātra yuddhārthe rākṣasasya viśāṃpate | parivāraḥ sahasrāṇām sahasram upatiṣṭhati ||
tad bhavāṃś caturangeṇa balena mahatā vṛtaḥ | vyūhyedam vānarānīkam nirmathiṣyasi rāvaṇam ||
kurvantas te mahāvegā mahīm cāraṇapīḍitām | rajaś ca sahasaivordhvam jagāma caraṇotthitam ||
laṅkāyās tūttaradvāraṃ śailaśṛṅgam ivōnnatam . rāmaḥ sahānujō dhanvī jugopa ca rurodha ca ||
śikharair vikirāmaināṃ laṅkāṃ muṣṭibhir ēva vā . iti sma dadhirē sarvē manāṃsi hariyūthapāḥ ||
tatō marmasu marmajñō majjayañ niśitān śarān . rāmalakṣmaṇayōr vīrō nanadā ca muhur muhuḥ ||
bāṇapātāntarē rāmaṃ patitaṃ puruṣarṣabham sa tatra lakṣmaṇō dṛṣṭvā nirāśō jīvitē ‘bhavat ||
vimṛjya vadanaṃ tasya kapirājasya dhīmataḥ abravīt kālasamprāptam asaṃbhrāntam idaṃ vacaḥ ||
utpapāta tatō hṛṣṭaḥ putraṃ ca pariṣasvajē rāvaṇō rakṣasāṃ madhyē śrutvā śatrū nipātitau ||
bhartāraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam . vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ sītā karuṇaṃ śōkakarśitā ||
vaidhavyaṃ yānti yair nāryō ‘lakṣaṇair bhāgyadurlabhāḥ . nātmanas tāni paśyāmi paśyantī hatalakṣaṇā ||
satyanāmāni padmāni strīṇām uktāni lakṣaṇaiḥ . tāny adya nihatē rāmē vitathāni bhavanti mē ||
yathaiva māṃ vanaṃ yāntam anuyātō mahādyutiḥ . aham apy anuyāsyāmi tathaivainaṃ yamakṣayam ||
śarair imāv alaṃ viddhau rudhirēṇa samukṣitau . vasudhāyām imau suptau dṛśyētē śalyakāv iva ||
ahaṃ tu rāvaṇaṃ hatvā saputraṃ sahabāndhavam . maithilīm ānayiṣyāmi śakrō naṣṭām iva śriyam ||
yathā tātaṃ daśarathaṃ yathājaṃ ca pitāmaham . tathā bhavantam āsādya hṛdayaṃ mē prasīdati ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tēṣāṃ rākṣasēndrō mahābalaḥ . cintārōṣasamākrāntō vivarṇavadano ‘bhavat ||
pratyuvāca tatō rāmō vibhīṣaṇam ariṃdamaḥ ahō dīptamahātējā rāvaṇō rākṣasēśvaraḥ ।।
kāmam ārya suparyāptō vadhāyāsya durātmanaḥ . vidhamiṣyāmy ahaṃ caitam anujānīhi māṃ vibhō ।।
tam abravīn mahātējā rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ . gaccha yatnaparaś cāpi bhava lakṣmaṇa saṃyugē ।।
mahōdaravacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ . kumbhakarṇō mahātējāḥ sampratasthē mahābalaḥ ।।
rāvaṇas tv abravīd dhṛṣṭō rākṣasāṃs tān upasthitān . draṣṭum ēnam ihēcchāmi yathānyāyaṃ ca pūjyatām ।।
gaccha sainyāni sarvāṇi vyūhya tiṣṭhasva pāvakē . dvārāṇy ādāya laṅkāyāś caryāś cāpy atha saṃkramān ।।
saṃśayastham idaṃ sarvaṃ śatrōḥ pratisamāsanē . ēkasya gamanaṃ tāta na hi mē rōcatē bhṛśam ।।
ādadē niśitaṃ śūlaṃ vēgāc chatrunibarhaṇaḥ . sarvaṃ kālāyasaṃ dīptaṃ taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇam ।।
bhagnānāṃ vō na paśyāmi parikramya mahīm imām sthānaṃ sarvē nivartadhvaṃ kiṃ prāṇān parirakṣatha ।।
tam āpatantaṃ samprēkṣya kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam . utpapāta tadā vīraḥ sugrīvō vānarādhipaḥ ।।
sa tat tathā bhagnam avēkṣya śūlaṃ cukōpa rakṣōdhipatir mahātmā . utpāṭya laṅkāmalayāt sa śṛṅgaṃ jaghāna sugrīvam upētya tēna ।।
sa taṃ mahāmēghanikāśarūpam utpāṭya gacchan yudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ . rarāja mērupratimānarūpō mērur yathā vyuchritaghōraśṛṅgaḥ ।।
rāmē mayātra nihatē yē ‘nyē sthāsyanti saṃyugē . tān ahaṃ yōdhayiṣyāmi svabalēna pramāthinā ।।
kumbhakarṇas tu saṃkruddhaḥ samārūḍhaḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ vyadhūnayat tān vēgēna duṣṭahastīva hastipān ।।
tau tasya pādau pradiśō diśaś ca girēr guhāś caiva mahārṇavaṃ ca . laṅkāṃ ca sēnāṃ kapirākṣasānāṃ vinādayan tau vinipētatuś ca ।।
tvayā ‘sakṛddhi śastrēṇa viśastā dēvadānavāḥ . sa sarvāyudhasaṃpannō rāghavaṃ śāstum arhasi ।।
sa tasya śīrṣāṇy asinā śitēna kirīṭajuṣṭāni sakuṇḍalāni . kruddhaḥ pracicchēda sutō ‘nilasya tvaṣṭuḥ sutasyēva śirāṃsi śakraḥ ।।
sa kṛttamūlaḥ sahasēva vṛkṣaḥ kṣitau papāta kṣatajōkṣitāṅgaḥ . tāṃ cāsya ghōrāṃ yamadaṇḍakalpāṃ gadāṃ pragṛhyāśu tadā nanāda ।।
sa saṃdhāya mahātējās taṃ bāṇaṃ sahasōtsṛjat tēna saumitrim āyāntam ājaghāna stanāntarē ।।
tasya pētur nagā bhūmau harivēgāc ca jajvaluḥ . śṛṅgāṇi ca vyakīryanta pīḍitasya hanūmatā ।।
sa taṃ samutpāṭya kham utpapāta vitrāsya lokān sasurān surendrān saṃstūyamānaḥ khacarair anekair jagāma vegād garuḍogravegaḥ ||
tatō harir gandhavahātmajas tu tam ōṣadhīśailam udagravēgaḥ . nināya vēgād dhimavantam ēva punaś ca rāmēṇa samājagāma ।।
durātmann ātmanāśāya keśapakṣe parāmṛśaḥ brahmarṣīṇāṃ kule jāto rākṣasīṃ yonim āśritaḥ R_6,068.
adṛṣṭapratikāreṇa avyaktenāsatā satā kathaṃ śakyaṃ paraṃ prāptuṃ dharmeṇārivikarśana R_6,070.
adharmasaṃśrito dharmo vināśayati rāghava sarvam etad yathākāmaṃ kākutstha kurute naraḥ R_6,070.
kathayantaṃ tu saumitriṃ saṃnivārya vibhīṣaṇaḥ puṣkalārtham idaṃ vākyaṃ visaṃjñaṃ rāmam abravīt R_6,071.
vānarān mohayitvā tu pratiyātaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ māyāmayīṃ mahābāho tāṃ viddhi janakātmajām R_6,071.
tac chrutvā rākṣasendrasya garjitaṃ lakṣmaṇas tadā abhītavadanaḥ kruddho rāvaṇiṃ vākyam abravīt R_6,075.
atha samarapariśramaṃ nihantuṃ samaramukheṣv ajitasya lakṣmaṇasya priyahitam upapādayan mahātmā samaram upetya vibhīṣaṇo 'vatasthe R_6,076.
te cāsya hayamukhyeṣu tūrṇam utpatya vānarāḥ caturṣu sumahāvīryā nipetur bhīmavikramāḥ R_6,077.
te hayā mathitā bhagnā vyasavo dharaṇīṃ gatāḥ te nihatya hayāṃs tasya pramathya ca mahāratham punar utpatya vegena tasthur lakṣmaṇapārśvataḥ R_6,077.
muktam indrajitā tat tu śaravarṣam ariṃdamaḥ avārayad asaṃbhrānto lakṣmaṇaḥ sudurāsadam R_6,078.
tena tad vihataṃ śastraṃ vāruṇaṃ paramādbutam tataḥ kruddho mahātejā indrajit samitiṃjayaḥ agneyaṃ saṃdadhe dīptaṃ sa lokaṃ saṃkṣipann iva R_6,078.
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā gandharvā garuḍoragāḥ śatakratuṃ puraskṛtya rarakṣur lakṣmaṇaṃ raṇe R_6,078.
abhyatikramya saumitriṃ rāvaṇaḥ samitiṃjayaḥ āsasāda raṇe rāmaṃ sthitaṃ śailam ivāparam R_6,087.
rāghavo rāvaṇaṃ tūrṇaṃ rāvaṇo rāghavaṃ tathā anyonyaṃ vividhais tīkṣṇaiḥ śaravarṣair vavarṣatuḥ R_6,087.
etasminn antare kruddho rāghavasyānujo balī lakṣmaṇaḥ sāyakān sapta jagrāha paravīrahā R_6,088.
kīryamāṇaḥ śaraugheṇa visṛṣṭena mahātmanā na prahartuṃ manaś cakre vimukhīkṛtavikramaḥ R_6,088.
vijayo ‘pi hi me śūra na priyāyopakalpate acakṣurviṣayaś candraḥ kāṃ prītiṃ janayiṣyati R_6,089.
deśe deśe kalatrāṇi deśe deśe ca bāndhavāḥ | taṃ tu deśaṃ na paśyāmi yatra bhrātā sahodaraḥ ||

variants.a_text: tataḥ śarasahasrāṇi kṣiprahasto niśācaraḥ nijaghānorasi kruddho rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ R_6,092.
bhinnamaryāda nirlajja cāritreṣv anavasthita darpān mṛtyum upādāya śūro 'ham iti manyase R_6,092.
adya madbāṇābhinnasya gatāsoḥ patitasya te karṣantv antrāṇi patagā garutmanta ivoragān R_6,092.
tam uktavākyaṃ vikrāntaṃ rājaputraṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ uvāca śokasaṃtapto bhrātur hitam anantaram
rāvaṇam nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā | antaḥpurād viniṣpetū rākṣasyaḥ śokakarśitāḥ
na caitat karma rāmasya śraddadhāmi camūmukhe | sarvataḥ samupetasya tava tenābhimarśaṇam
tato vimuktvā saśaraṃ śarāsanaṃ | mahendradattaṃ kavacaṃ ca tan mahat | vimucya roṣaṃ ripunigrahāt tato | rāmaḥ susaumyatvam upāgato ‘riha
bhartuḥ priyahite yukte bhartur vijayakāṅkṣiṇi | snigdham evaṃvidhaṃ vākyaṃ tvam evārhasy anindite
ayaṃ vyāghrasamīpe tu purāṇo dharmasaṃhitaḥ | ṛkṣeṇa gītaḥ śloko ‘sti taṃ nibodha plavaṅgama
na paraḥ pāpam ādatte pareṣāṃ pāpakarmaṇām | samayo rakṣitavyas tu santaś cāritrabhūṣaṇāḥ
evam ukto hanumatā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | agacchat sahasā dhyānam īṣad bāṣpapariplutaḥ
saṃprāptam avamānaṃ yas tejasā na pramārjati | kas tasya pauruṣeṇārtho mahatāpy alpacetasaḥ
imam ārṣam stavaṃ divyam itihāsaṃ purātanam | ye narāḥ kīrtayiṣyanti nāsti teṣāṃ parābhavaḥ
siddhārthā khalu kausalyā yā tvāṃ rāma gṛhaṃ gatam | vanān nivṛttaṃ saṃhṛṣṭā drakṣyate śatrusūdana
nīrujo nirvraṇāścava saṃpannabalapauruṣāḥ | samutthāsyanti harayaḥ suptā nidrākṣaye yathā
Сто двадцать вторая песнь upasthitam tu taṃ kṛtvā puṣpakaṃ puṣpabhūṣitam | avidūre sthito rāmam ity uvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
evam uktvā mahātejāḥ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ | utpapāta mahāvegād vegavān avicārayan
sa tu dattavaraḥ prītyā vānaraiśca samāgataḥ | puṣpakeṇa vimānena kiṣkindhām abhyupāgamat
pratikarma ca sītāyāḥ sarvā daśarathastriyaḥ | ātmanaiva tadā cakrur manasvinyo manoharam
itīva sa mahābāhuḥ sītāharaṇakarśitaḥ rāmaḥ sāgaram āsādya vāsam ājñāpayat tadā
tatas tu sugrīvavaco niśamya| taddharīśvareṇābhihitam nareśvaraḥ | vibhīṣaṇenāśu jagāma samgamam | patatrājena yathā purandaraḥ ||
rāvaṇānantaro bhrātā mama jyeṣṭhaś ca vīryavān | kumbhakarṇo mahātejāḥ śakrapratibalo yudhi ||
dvitīyena tathaivāhnā yojanāni tu viṃśatiḥ | kṛtāni plavagais tūrṇam bhīmakāyair mahābalaiḥ ||
nimittāni nimittajño dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ | saumitrim sampariṣvajyedam vacanam abravīt ||
anuvālisutasyāpi balena mahatā vṛtaḥ | vīras tiṣṭhati saṅgāme setuhetur ayam nalaḥ ||
tasya dṛṣṭvā mukham devi pūrṇacandram ivoditam | mokṣyase śokajam vāri nirmokam iva pannagī ||
etasminn antare śabdo bherīśankhasamākulaḥ | śruto vai sarvasainyānām kampayan dharaṇītalam ||
pūrvam prahastaḥ sabalo dvāram āsādya tiṣṭhati | dakṣiṇam ca mahāvīryau mahāpārśvamahodarau ||
tatas tē rākṣasās tatra gatvā rāvaṇamandiram . nyavēdayan purīṃ ruddhāṃ rāmēṇa saha vānaraiḥ ||
tathā vṛkṣair mahākāyāḥ parvatāgraiś ca vānarāḥ . nijaghnus tāni rakṣāṃsi nakhair dantaiś ca vēgitāḥ ||
praviśya sītā bahuvṛkṣakhaṇḍāṃ tāṃ rākṣasēndrasya vihārabhūmim . samprēkṣya sañcintya ca rājaputrau paraṃ viṣādaṃ samupājagāma ||
athōvāca mahātējā harirājō mahābalaḥ . kim iyaṃ vyathitā sēnā mūḍhavātēva naur jalē ||
rākṣasair vānarā ghōrā vinikṛttaḥ samantataḥ . vānarai rākṣasāś cāpi drumair bhūmisamīkṛtāḥ ||
tatas tam abhidudrāva rākṣasēndram akampanam . purā hi namuciṃ saṃkhyē vajrēṇēva puraṃdaraḥ ||
taṃ parvatāgram ākāśē rakṣōbāṇavidāritam . vikīrṇaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanumān krōdhamūrchitaḥ ||
tēṣām anyōnyam āsādya saṃgrāmaḥ sumahān abhūt bahūnām aśmavṛṣṭiṃ ca śaravarṣaṃ ca varṣatām ||
tān prēkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā nikṛttān nikṛttabhōgān iva pannagēndrān . laṅkēśvaraḥ krōdhavaśaṃ jagāma sasarja cānyān niśitān pṛṣatkān ।।
sa bāṇajālāny atha tāni tāni mōghāni paśyaṃs tridaśārirājaḥ . visismiyē lakṣmaṇalāghavēna punaś ca bāṇān niśitān mumōca ।।
māṃ nihatya kila tvāṃ hi nihaniṣyati rāghavaḥ . nāham ātmani saṃtāpaṃ gacchēyaṃ rākṣasādhipa ।।
śrōṇīsūtrēṇa mahatā mēcakēna virājata amṛtōtpādanē naddhō bhujaṅgēnēva mandaraḥ ।।
samabhyupētyādbhutaghōravīryaṃ sa kumbhakarṇō yudhi vānarēndram . jahāra sugrīvam abhipragṛhya yathānilō mēgham iva pracaṇḍaḥ ।।
mayā tu mōkṣitasyāsya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ . aprītiś ca bhavēt kaṣṭā kīrtināśaś ca śāśvataḥ ।।
sa tīvrēṇa ca kōpēna rudhirēṇa ca mūrchitaḥ vānarān rākṣasān ṛkṣān khādan sa paridhāvati ।।
variants.b_text: स तीव्रेण च कोपेनरुधिरेण च मूर्छितः ।।6.67.123।। वानरान्राक्षसानृक्षान्खादन्विपरिधावति ।

variants.a_text: atikāyō ‘titējasvī rākṣasēndrasutas tadā . ārurōha rathaśrēṣṭhaṃ śrēṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām ।।
sa tāñ chittvā śitair bāṇair lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ādadē niśitaṃ bāṇaṃ jvalantam iva tējasā ।।
adyēndravaivasvataviṣṇurudrasādhyāś ca vaiśvānaracandrasūryāḥ . drakṣyantu mē vikramam apramēyaṃ viṣṇōr ivōgraṃ baliyajñavāṭē ।।
sa saṃprāpya mahātējā yuddhabhūmim ariṃdamaḥ sthāpayāmāsa rakṣāṃsi rathaṃ prati samantataḥ ।।
śrutvā hanumatō vākyaṃ tadā vivyathitēndriyaḥ . punar jātam ivātmānaṃ manyatē plavagōttamaḥ ।।
aśōbhata tadā rāmō dhanur visphārayan mahat . bhagavān iva samkruddhō bhavō vēdamayaṃ dhanuḥ ।।
tasya jṛmbhitavikṣēpād vyāmiśrā vai diśō daśa . rūpavān iva rudrasya manyur gātrēṣv adṛśyata ।।
tatas tu cōditās tēna rākṣasā jvalitāyudhāḥ . laṅkāyā niryayur vīrāḥ praṇadantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।
ghnantam anyaṃ jaghānānyaḥ pātayantam apātayat garhamāṇaṃ jagarhānyō daśantam aparō ‘daśat ।।
tataḥ kumbhaṃ samutkṣipya sugrīvō lavaṇāmbhasi . pātayāmāsa vēgēna darśayann udadhēs sthalam ।।
nikumbhaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā kumbhaṃ ca vinipātitam . rāvaṇaḥ paramāmarṣī prajajvālānalō yathā ।।
tataḥ prekṣya hanūmantaṃ vrajantaṃ yatra rāghavaḥ sa hotukāmo duṣṭātmā gataś caityaṃ nikumbhilām R_6,069.
tasyāntarikṣe carataḥ sarathasya mahāyaśaḥ na gatir jñāyate vīra sūryasyevābhrasaṃplave R_6,072.
atha tasyām avasthāyāṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ rāvaṇānujaḥ pareṣām ahitaṃ vākyam arthasādhakam abravīt R_6,073.
tathety uktvā mahātejāḥ saumitrir mitranandanaḥ babhūvāvasthitas tatra citraṃ visphārayan dhanuḥ R_6,074.
kṣatrabandhuṃ sadānāryaṃ rāmaḥ paramadurmatiḥ bhaktaṃ bhrātaram adyaiva tvāṃ drakṣyati hataṃ mayā R_6,075.
vidhūtavarmā nārācair babhūva sa kṛtavraṇaḥ indrajit samare vīraḥ pratyūṣe bhānumān iva R_6,076.
adya vānarasainyāni rathena pavanaujasā dhanuḥsamudrād udbhūtair mathiṣyāmi śarormibhiḥ R_6,083.
muhūrtāl labdhasaṃjñas tu mahāpārśvo mahābalaḥ aṅgadaṃ bahubhir bāṇair bhūyas taṃ pratyavidhyata R_6,086.
tasmin pratihate 'stre tu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ krodhaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ cakre krodhāc cāstram anantaram R_6,088.
rathena mama bhūmiṣṭhaṃ śīghraṃ yāhi raghūttamam | āhūya bhūtalaṃ yātaḥ kuru devahitaṃ mahat
atha saṃsmārayāmāsa mātalī rāghavaṃ tadā | ajānanniva kiṃ vīra tvam enam anuvartase
anena dattāni vanīpakeṣu | bhuktāś ca bhogā nibhṛtāś ca bhṛtyāḥ | dhanāni mitreṣu samarpitāni | vairāṇy amitreṣu nipātitāni
yā tvaṃ virahitā nītā calacittena rakṣasā | daivasaṃpādito doṣo mānuṣeṇa mayā jitaḥ
imām api viśālākṣīṃ rakṣitāṃ svena tejasā | rāvaṇo nātivarteta velām iva mahodadhiḥ
upasthāpaya me śīghraṃ vimānaṃ rākṣaseśvara | kṛtakāryasya me vāsah katham syād iha saṃmataḥ
bharatas tu tvayā vācyaḥ kuśalaṃ vacanān mama | siddhārthaṃ śaṃsa māṃ tasmai sabhāryaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam
tato lakṣmaṇam āsādya vaidehīṃ ca paraṃtapaḥ | athābhyavādayat prīto bharato nāma cābravīt
te kṛtvā mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ | kuśalaṃ paryapṛcchaṃs te prahṛṣṭā bharataṃ tadā
abhivādya sumitrāṃ ca kaikeyīṃ ca yaśasvinīm | sa mātṝś ca tataḥ sarvāḥ purohitam upāgamat
variants.b_text: अभिवाद्यसुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम् ।।6.130.49।। स मात्रूश्चततस्सर्वापुरोहितमुपागमत् ।

variants.a_text: yat tu phalgu balam kiṃcit tad atraivopapadyatām etad dhi kṛtyam ghoram no vikrameṇa prayujyatām
variants.b_text: यच्च फल्गु बलं किञ्चित्त दत्रैवोपपद्यताम् । एतद्धि कृत्यं घोरं नो विक्रमेण प्रयुज्यताम् ।।6.4.13।।

variants.a_text: balīmukhaḥ prajaṅghaś ca jambho 'tha rabhasaḥ kapiḥ sarvataś ca yayur vīrās tvarayantaḥ plavaṃgamān
variants.b_text: दरीमुखः प्रजङ्घश्च रम्भोऽथ रभसः कपिः । सर्वतश्च ययुर्वीरास्त्वरयन्तः प्लवङ्गमान् ।।6.4.36।।

variants.a_text: niviṣṭāyāṃ tu senāyāṃ tīre nadanadīpateḥ pārśvasthaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmo vacanam abravīt
na tu kṣamaṃ vīryavatā tena dharmānuvartinā vairaṃ nirarthakaṃ kartuṃ dīyatām asya maithilī
rākṣasās tadvacaḥ śrutvā laṅkāyām paricakramuḥ anugeham avasthaya vihāraśayaneṣu ca udyāneṣu ca rakṣaṃsi codayanto hy abhītavat
baddham kālasya pāśena sarvabhūtāpahāriṇaḥ na naśyantam upekṣe tvāṃ pradīptaṃ śaraṇaṃ yathā ||
mitrabhāvena samprāptam na tyajeyam kathaṃcana | doṣo yadyapi tasya syāt satām etad agarhitam ||
dīnā dīnasvarāḥ krūrāḥ sarvato mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | pratyādityam vinardanti janayanto mahadbhayam ||
sā vīrasamitī rājñā virarāja vyavasthitā | śaśinā śubhinakṣatrā paurṇamāsīva śāradī ||
paśya mattavihaṃgāni pralīnabhramarāṇi ca | kokilākulakhaṇḍāni dodhavīti śivo ‘nilaḥ ||
yas tu savyam asau pakṣam rāmasyāśritya tiṣṭhati | rakṣogaṇaparikṣipto rājā hy eṣa vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
cāreṇa viditaḥ śatruḥ paṇḍitair vasudhādhipaiḥ | yuddhe svalpena yatnena samāsādya nirasyate ||
nūnam asti mahārāja rājabhāvāt kṣamānvita | kiṃcid ātyayikam kāryam teṣām tvam darśanam kuru ||
pāṇḍurā raktapādāś ca vihagāḥ kālacoditāḥ | rākṣasānām vināśāya kapotā vicaranti ca ||
suvelam sādhu śailendram imam dhātuśataiś citam | adhyārohāmahe sarve vatsyāmo ‘tra niśām imām ||
dṛśyantē na yathāvac ca nakṣatrāṇy abhivartatē yugāntam iva lōkasya paśya lakṣmaṇa śaṃsati ||
tataḥ paścāt sumahatī pṛtanarkṣavanaukasām . pracchādya mahatīṃ bhūmim anuyāti sma rāghavam ||
tatas tasyāvidūrēṇa nipatya sa haripuṃgavaḥ . dīptāgnisadṛśas tasthāv aṅgadaḥ kanakāṅgadaḥ ||
papāta prathamaṃ rāmō viddhō marmasu mārgaṇaiḥ . krōdhād indrajitā yēna purā śakrō vinirjitaḥ ||
vinēduś ca mahānādān sarvē tē jaladōpamāḥ hatō rāma iti jñātvā rāvaṇiṃ samapūjayan ||
iṣṭabandhujanō nityaṃ māṃ ca nityam anuvrataḥ . imām adya gatō ‘vasthāṃ mamānāryasya durnayaiḥ ||
visasarjaikavēgēna pañca bāṇaśatāni yaḥ . iṣvastreṣv adhikas tasmāt kārtavīryāc ca lakṣmaṇaḥ ||
saha śūrair harigaṇair labdhasaṃjñāv ariṃdamau . gaccha tvaṃ bhrātarau gṛhya kiṣkindhāṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
vainatēyēna samspṛṣṭās tayōḥ samruruhur vraṇāḥ . suvarṇe ca tanū snigdhē tayōr āśu babhūvatuḥ ||
ētē nāgāḥ kādravēyās tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrā viṣōlbaṇāḥ . rakṣōmāyāprabhāvēṇa śarābhūtvās tvadāśrayāḥ ||
dhūmrākṣaṃ prēkṣya niryāntaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhīmavikramam . vinēdur vānarāḥ sarvē prahṛṣṭā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||
sa vṛkṣēṇahatas tēna sakrōdhēna mahātmanā . rākṣasō vānarēndrēṇa papāta ca mamāra ca ||
tasya niryāṇaghōṣēṇa rākṣasānāṃ ca nardatām laṅkāyāṃ sarvabhūtāni vinēdur vikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ ||
yō ‘sau navārkōditatāmracakṣur āruhya ghaṇṭāninadapraṇādam . gajaṃ kharaṃ garjati vai mahatmā mahōdarō nāma sa ēṣaḥ vīraḥ ।।
tām āpatantīṃ bharatānujō ‘strair jaghāna bāṇaiś ca hutāgnikalpaiḥ. tathāpi sā tasya vivēśa śaktir bhujāntaraṃ dāśarathēr viśālam ।।
tam adriśṛṅgapratimaṃ kirīṭinaṃ spṛśantam ādityam ivā ‘tmatējasā . vanaukasaḥ prēkṣya vivṛddham adbhutaṃ bhayārditā dudruvirē yatas tataḥ ।।
ācakṣva sumahān kō ‘sau rakṣō vā yadi vāsuraḥ . na mayaivaṃvidhaṃ bhūtaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ kadācana ।।
karma caiva hi sarvēṣāṃ kāraṇānāṃ prayōjakam . śrēyaḥ pāpīyasāṃ cātra phalaṃ bhavati karmaṇām ।।
sarpair uṣṭraiḥ kharair aśvaiḥ simhadvipamṛgadvijaiḥ . anujagmuś ca taṃ ghōraṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam ।।
kumbhakarṇabhujābhyāṃ tu pīḍitō vānararṣabhaḥ nipapāta rṣabhō bhīmaḥ pramukhagataśōṇitaḥ ।।
taṃ śailam iva śailābhāḥ sarvē tu plavagarṣabhāḥ . samāruhya samutpatya dadaṃśuś ca mahābalāḥ ।।
pragṛhītāyudhasyēha mṛtyōr iva mahāmṛdhē . tiṣṭhann apy agrataḥ pūjyaḥ kimu yuddhapradāyakaḥ ।।
tē vānarā bhagnahatāvaśēṣāḥ paryantam āśritya tadā viṣaṇṇāḥ . prapīḍitāṅgā dadṛśuḥ sughōraṃ narēndrarakṣōdhipasaṃnipātam ।।
nūnaṃ tribhuvanasyāpi paryāptas tvam asi prabhō . sa kasmāt prākṛta iva śōcasy ātmānam īdṛśam ।।
brahmadattāsti tē śaktiḥ kavacaḥ sāyakō dhanuḥ . sahasrakharasaṃyuktō rathō mēghasvanō mahān ।।
kṣuraprair ardhacandraiś ca bhallaiś ca niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ rākṣasā vānarēndrāṇāṃ bibhiduḥ pādapāñ śilāḥ ।।
sa muṣṭiniṣpiṣṭavibhinnamūrdhā nirvāntadantākṣivilambijihvaḥ . dēvāntakō rākṣasarājasūnur gatāsur urvyāṃ sahasā papāta ।।
bālas tvam asi saumitrē vikramēṣv avicakṣaṇaḥ . gaccha kiṃ kālasadṛśaṃ māṃ yōdhayatum icchasi ।।
dēhīty anyō dadāty anyō dadāmīty aparaḥ punaḥ kiṃ klēśayasi tiṣṭhēti tatrānyōnyaṃ babhāṣirē ।।
abhipētur mahākāyāḥ pratiyattā mahābalāḥ . rākṣasā vānarān rōṣād asibāṇagadādharāḥ ।।
jahi vīra mahāvīryau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau adṛśyo dṛśyamāno vā sarvathā tvaṃ balādhikaḥ R_6,067.
sa rākṣasānāṃ kadanaṃ cakāra sumahākapiḥ vṛto vānarasainyena kālāntakayamopamaḥ R_6,069.
sa saṃprahāras tumulaḥ saṃjajñe kapirakṣasām śabdena mahatā laṅkāṃ nādayan vai samantataḥ R_6,073.
sa rathenāgnivarṇena balavān rāvaṇātmajaḥ indrajit kavacī khaḍgī sadhvajaḥ pratyadṛśyata R_6,074.
na ca sītāṃ daśagrīvaḥ prāpnoti janakātmajām baddhaṃ balavatā vairam akṣayaṃ rāghaveṇa сa R_6,082.
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ kuryād yadi sma dhanadānujaḥ śmaśānabhūtā duḥkhārtā neyaṃ laṅkā bhaviṣyati R_6,082.
ceratuś ca ciraṃ citraṃ maṇḍalaṃ savyadakṣiṇam bāṇavegāt samutkṣiptāv anyonyam aparājitau R_6,087.
etasminn antare vīro lakṣmaṇas taṃ vibhīṣaṇam prāṇasaṃśayam āpannaṃ tūrṇam abhyavapadyata R_6,088.
na viṣādasya kālo 'yam iti saṃcintya rāghavaḥ cakre sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ rāvaṇasya vadhe dhṛtaḥ sarvayatnena mahatā lakṣmaṇaṃ parivīkṣya ca R_6,088.
śūlo 'yaṃ vajrasāras te rāma roṣān mayodyataḥ tava bhrātṛsahāyasya samyak prāṇān hariṣyati R_6,091.
rāmaś cikṣepa tejasvī ketumuddiśya sāyakam | jagāma sa mahīṃ bhittvā daśagrīvadhvajaṃ śaraḥ
indralokaṃ gataḥ śrīmāṃs tvayā putreṇa tāritaḥ | lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā tvam enam abhivādaya
tasya tacchirasā vākyaṃ pratigṛhya nṛpātmajaḥ | bāḍham ity eva saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śrīmān varam ayācata
evam ukto hanumatā bharataḥ kaikayīsutaḥ | papāta sahasā hṛṣṭo harṣān moham upāgamat
śrūyatāṃ sarvam ākhyāsye durgakarmavidhānataḥ guptā purī yathā laṅkā rakṣitā ca yathā balaiḥ
hariḥ śatabalir vīraḥ koṭībhir daśabhir vṛtaḥ sarvām eko hy avaṣṭabhya rarakṣa harivāhinīm
variants.b_text: हरिश्शतवलिर्वीरः कोटीभिर्दशभिर्वृतः । सर्वामेको ह्यावष्टभ्य ररक्ष हरिवाहिनीम् ।।6.4.32।।

variants.a_text: kathaṃ janakarājasya duhitā mama ca priyā rākṣasīmadhyagā śete snuṣā daśarathasya ca
śūrāś ca balavantaś ca varuṇasya sutā raṇe nirjitās te mahābhāga caturvidhabalānugāḥ
anena hi mahārāja maheśvaram anuttamam iṣṭvā yajñam varo labdho loke paramadurlabhaḥ
tato 'bravīt susaṃkruddho vajradaṃṣṭro mahābalaḥ pragṛhya parighaṃ ghoraṃ māṃsaśoṇitadūṣitam
balāny aparimeyāni vīryāṇi ca niśācarāḥ pareṣāṃ sahasāvajñā na kartavyā kathaṃ cana
sarvam etan mahārāja kṛtam apratimam tava | vidhīyeta sahāsmābhir ādāv evāsya karmaṇaḥ ||
tasmāt tvayā samārabdhaṃ karma hy apratimam paraiḥ | aham samīkariṣyāmi hatvā śatrūṃs tavānagha ||
punarmām sa dvitīyena śareṇa nihaniṣyati | tato’ham tasya pāsyāmi rudhiram kāmamāśvasa ||
kumbhakarṇaḥ sahāsmābhir indrajic ca mahābalaḥ | pratiṣedhayituṃ śaktau savajram api vajriṇam ||
sa ca na pratijagrāha rāvaṇaḥ kālacoditaḥ | ucyamānaṃ hitam vākyam viparīta ivauṣadham ||
praṇīdhī rākṣasendrasya rāvaṇasya bhaved ayam | anupraviśya so ‘smāsu bhedam kuryān na saṃśayaḥ ||
praṇidhāya hi cāreṇa yathāvat sūkṣmabuddhinā | parīkṣya ca tataḥ kāryo yathā nyāyam parigrahaḥ ||
rasātalam vā praviśet pātālam vāpi rāvaṇaḥ | pitāmahasakāśam vā na me jīvanvimokṣyate ||
rākṣasānām vadhe sāhyam laṅkāyāś ca pradharṣaṇe | kariṣyāmi yathā prāṇam pravekṣyāmi ca vāhinīm ||
na ca darśayate rūpaṃ mando rāmasya sāgaraḥ | prayatenāpi rāmeṇa yathārham abhipūjitaḥ ||
tasmin vikṛṣṭe sahasā rāghaveṇa śarāsane | rodasī saṃpaphāleva parvatāśca cakampire ||
sabale sāgaram tīrṇe rāme daśarathātmaje | amātyau rāvaṇaḥ śrīmān abravīc chukasāraṇau ||
rākṣasānām variṣṭhaś ca tava bhrātā vibhīṣaṇaḥ | pratigṛhya purīṃ laṃkām rāghavasya hite rataḥ||
sakāmā bhava kaikeyi hato ‘yam kulanandanaḥ | kulam utsāditam sarvam tvayā kalahaśīlayā ||
śirasā me śiraś cāsya kāyam kāyena yojaya | rāvaṇānugamiṣyāmi gatim bhartur mahātmanaḥ ||
sā praviṣṭā tatas tatra dadarśa janakātmajām | pratīkṣamāṇām svām eva bhraṣṭapadmām iva śriyam ||
kāryasiddhim puraskṛtya mantrayadhvam vinirṇaye | nityam saṃnihito yatra rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ||
ity uktaḥ sa tu tāreyo rāmēṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā . jagāmākāśām āviśya mūrtimān iva havyavāṭ ||
vyathayan rākṣasān sarvān harṣayaṃś cāpi vānarān . sa vānarāṇāṃ madhyē tu rāmapārśvam upāgataḥ ||
tatkarma vāliputrasya sarvē dēvāḥ saharṣibhiḥ tuṣṭuvuḥ pūjanārhasya tau cōbhau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
nēmau mōkṣayituṃ śakyāv ētasmād iṣubandhanāt sarvair api samāgamya sarṣisaṅghaiḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
jāmbavantaṃ mahēṣvāsō viddhvā bāṇēna vakṣasi hanūmatō vēgavatō visasarja śarān daśa ||
parityakṣāmy ahaṃ prāṇān vānarāṇāṃ tu paśyātām . yadi pañcatvam āpannaḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ ||
prakṛtyā rākṣasāḥ sarvē saṃgrāmē kūṭayōdhinaḥ . śūrāṇāṃ śuddhabhāvānāṃ bhavatām ārjavaṃ balam ||
bālavṛddhāvaśēṣāṃ tu kṛtvā laṅkāṃ śarōrmibhiḥ . rāvaṇaṃ ca ripuṃ hatvā sītāṃ tvaṃ samulapsyatē ||
rathaṃ tasya samāsādya bāhum udyamya dakṣiṇam . trāsayan rāvaṇaṃ dhīmān hanūmān vākyam abravīt ।।
tatas tē cukruśur hṛṣṭā labdhalakṣāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ . nīlalāghavasambhrāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇam āhavē ।।
tathāpi tvāṃ mayā muktaḥ sāyōkō ‘straprayōjitaḥ . jīvitaṃ parirakṣantaṃ jīvitād bhraṃśayiṣyati ।।
jānāmi vīryaṃ tava rākṣasēndra balaṃ pratāpaṃ ca parākramaṃ ca . avasthitō ‘haṃ śaracāpapāṇir āgaccha kiṃ mōghavikatthanēna ।।
sa bāṇavarṣaṃ tu vavarṣa tīvraṃ rāmānujaḥ kārmukasamprayuktam . kṣurārdhacandrōttamakarṇabhallaiḥ śarāṃś ca cicchēda na cukṣubhē ca ।।
tēna muṣṭiprahārēṇa rāvaṇō rākṣasēśvaraḥ . jānubhyām apatad bhūmau cacāla ca papāta ca ।।
sarvam adyaiva yūpākṣa harisainyaṃ salakṣmaṇam . rāghavaṃ ca raṇē jitvā tatō drakṣyāmi rāvaṇam ।।
kumbhakarṇaprahārārtō vijajvāla sa vāsavaḥ . tatō viṣēduḥ sahasā devā brahmarṣidānavāḥ prajābhiḥ saha śakraś ca yayau sthānaṃ svayambhuvaḥ ।।
ahaṃ dvijihvaḥ saṃhrādī kumbhakarṇō vitardanaḥ . pañca rāmavadhāyaitē niryāntv ity avaghōṣaya ।।
kṛtaṃ naḥ kadanaṃ ghōraṃ kumbhakarṇēna rakṣasā . na sthānakālō gacchāmō dayitaṃ jīvitaṃ hi naḥ ।।
dēvā hi māṃ hasiṣyanti dṛṣṭvā pūrvāpakāriṇam . katham indraṃ jayiṣyāmi kumbhakarṇa hatē tvayi ।।
tēna muṣṭiprahārēṇa saṃcukōpa mahākapiḥ . kupitaś ca nijagrāha kirīṭē rākṣasarṣabham ।।
pūrayan sa mahīṃ sarvām ākāśaṃ sāgaraṃ diśaḥ . jyāśabdō lakṣmaṇasyōgras trāsayan rajanīcarān ।।
āgnēyēna tadāstrēṇa yōjayāmāsa sāyakam sa jajvāla tadā bāṇō dhanuścāsya mahātmanaḥ ।।
tāny āyudhāny adbhutavigrahāṇi mōghāni kṛtvā sa śarō ‘gnidīptaḥ . pragṛhya tasyaiva kirīṭajuṣṭam tadātikāyasya śirō jahāra ।।
sa tatrāgniṃ samāstīrya śarapatraiḥ satōmaraiḥ chāgasya kṛṣṇavarṇasya galaṃ jagrāha jīvataḥ ।।
tataḥ pāvakasaṃkāśaiḥ śarair āśīviṣōpamaiḥ . vānarāṇām anīkāni bibhēda samarē prabhuḥ ।।
udīkṣamāṇā gaganaṃ kēcin nētrēṣu tāḍitāḥ . śarair viviśur anyōnyaṃ pētuś ca jagatītalē ।।
sa taṃ samīkṣyānalaraśmidīptaṃ visiṣmiye vāsavadūtasūnuḥ āplutya taṃ cauṣadhiparvatendraṃ tatrauṣadhīnāṃ vicayaṃ cakāra ||
yatō hataḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ kumārāś ca niṣūditāḥ . nēdānīm upanirhāraṃ rāvaṇō dātum arhati ।।
tasyāṃ sa phalakē khaḍgaṃ nijaghāna tatō ‘ṅgadaḥ . yajñōpavītavac cainaṃ cicchēda kapikuñjaraḥ ।।
sa lalāṭē mahāvīryam aṅgadaṃ vānararṣabham . ājaghāna mahātējāḥ sa muhūrtaṃ cacāla ha ।।
ākarṇākṛṣṭamuktēna jaghāna dvividaṃ tadā . tēna hāṭakapuṅkhēna patriṇā patravāsasā ।।
tad yuddham abhavat tatra sametyānyonyam ojasā khararākṣasaputrasya sūnor daśarathasya ca R_6,066.
tān uvāca tataḥ sarvān hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ viṣaṇṇavadanān dīnāṃs trastān vidravataḥ pṛthak R_6,069.
yathaiva sthāvaraṃ vyaktaṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca tathāvidham nāyam arthas tathā yuktas tvadvidho na vipadyate R_6,070.
variants.b_text: यथैवस्थावरंव्यक्तंजङ्गमं न तथाविधम् । नायमर्थस्तथायुक्तस्त्वद्विधो न विपद्यते ।।6.83.16।।

variants.a_text: sa saṃprāpya dhanuṣpāṇir māyāyogam ariṃdamaḥ tasthau brahmavidhānena vijetuṃ raghunandanaḥ R_6,072.
ity evam uktas tu tadā mahātmā vibhīṣaṇenārivibhīṣaṇena dadarśa taṃ parvatasaṃnikāśaṃ rathasthitaṃ bhīmabalaṃ durāsadam R_6,073.
tataḥ pramāthī rabhasaḥ śarabho gandhamādanaḥ amṛṣyamāṇāś catvāraś cakrur vegaṃ harīśvarāḥ R_6,077.
tau mahāgrahasaṃkāśāv anyōnyaṃ saṃnipatya ca saṃgrāme śatadhā yātau medinyāṃ caiva petatuḥ R_6,078.
vibhīṣaṇo hanūmāṃś ca jāmbavāṃś carkṣayūthapaḥ vijayenābhinandantas tuṣṭuvuś cāpi lakṣmaṇam R_6,078.
tad asukaram athābhivīkṣya hṛṣṭāḥ priyasuhṛdo yudhi lakṣmaṇasya karma paramam upalabhan manaḥpraharṣaṃ vinihatam indraripuṃ niśamya devāḥ R_6,078.
rudhiraklinnagātras tu lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ babhūva hṛṣṭas taṃ hatvā śakrajetāram āhave R_6,079.
yuddhe hato mahārāja lakṣmaṇena tavātmajaḥ vibhīṣaṇasahāyena miṣatāṃ no mahādyutiḥ R_6,080.
kavacaṃ brahmadattaṃ me yad ādityasamaprabham devāsuravimardeṣu na chinnaṃ vajramuṣṭibhiḥ R_6,080.
sa tad durātmā suhṛdā niveditaṃ vacaḥ sudharmyaṃ pratigṛhya rāvaṇaḥ gṛhaṃ jagāmātha tataś ca vīryavān punaḥ sabhāṃ ca prayayau suhṛdvṛtaḥ R_6,080.
cālayantaṃ mahāsainyaṃ vidhamantaṃ mahārathān dadṛśus te na vai rāmaṃ vātaṃ vanagataṃ yathā R_6,081.
adya prabhṛti lokāṃs trīn sarve dānavarākṣasāḥ bhayena prāvṛtā nityaṃ vicariṣyanti śāśvatam R_6,082.
kharasya kumbhakarṇasya prahastendrajitos tathā kariṣyāmi pratīkāram adya śatruvadhād aham R_6,083.
adya vānaramūkhyānāṃ tāni yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ dhanuṣā śarajālena vadhiṣyāmi patatriṇā R_6,083.
gadāparighahastau tau yudhi vīrau samīyatuḥ nardantau govṛṣaprakhyau ghanāv iva savidyutau R_6,085.
taṃ tailadhautaṃ vimalaṃ śailasāramayaṃ dṛḍham rākṣasaḥ paramakruddho vāliputre nyapātayat R_6,086.
tato rāvaṇavegena sudūram avagāḍhayā śaktyā vibhinnahṛdayaḥ papāta bhuvi lakṣmaṇaḥ R_6,088.
ity ukto devarājena mātalir devasārathiḥ | praṇamya śirasā devaṃ tato vacanam abravīt
tān dṛṣṭvā pannagān rāmaḥ samāpatata āhave astraṃ gārutmataṃ ghoraṃ prāduścakre bhayāvaham R_6,090.
astre pratihate kruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ abhyavarṣat tadā rāmaṃ ghorābhiḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ R_6,090.
rathaṃ ca tasyātha javena sārathir | nivārya bhīmaṃ jaladasvanaṃ tadā | jagāma bhītyā samarān mahīpatiṃ | nirastavīryaṃ patitaṃ samīkṣya
rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇu guhyaṃ sanātanam | yena sarvān arīn vatsa samare vijayiṣyase
tad apy aśanisaṃkāśaiś chinnaṃ rāmasya sāyakaiḥ | evam eva śataṃ chinnaṃ śirasāṃ tulyavarcasām
daśarathasutarākṣasendrayos tayor | jayam anavekṣya raṇe sa rāghavasya | suravararathasārathir mahātmā | raṇaratarāmam uvāca vākyam āśu
dhṛtipravālaḥ prasabhāgryapuṣpas | tapobalaḥ śauryanibaddhamūlaḥ | raṇe mahān rākṣasarājavṛkṣaḥ | saṃmardito rāghavamārutena
naivaṃ vinaṣṭāḥ śocyante kṣatradharmavyavasthitāḥ | vṛddhim āśaṃsamānā ye nipatanti raṇājire
saumyaṃ tasyā mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanūmān plavagottamaḥ | rāmasya vacanaṃ sarvam ākhyātum upacakrame
iti bruvantī rudatī bāṣpagadgadabhāṣiṇī | uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ sītā dīnaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇam
aprītena guṇair bhartrā tyaktāyā janasaṃsadi | yā kṣamā me gatir gantuṃ pravekṣye havyavāhanam
avaśyaṃ ca mayā kāryaṃ sarveṣāṃ vo vaco hitam | snigdhānāṃ lokanāthānām evaṃ ca vadatāṃ hitam
variants.b_text: अवश्यं च मयाकार्यंसर्वेषांवोवचोहितम् । स्निग्धानांलोकनाधानामेवं च वदतांहितम् ।।6.121.21।।

variants.a_text: matpriyeṣv abhiraktāś ca na mṛtyuṃ gaṇayanti ye | tvatprasādāt sameyus te varam etam ahaṃ vṛṇe
evam uktvā sahasrākṣo rāmaṃ saumitriṇā saha | vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśair yayau hṛṣṭaḥ suraih saha
evam uktas tu kākutsthaṃ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ | ahnā tvāṃ prāpayiṣyāmi tām purīṃ pārthivātmaja
tatpuṣpakam kāmagamaṃ vimānam | upasthitam bhūdharasaṃnikāśam | dṛṣṭvā tadā vismayamājagāma | rāmaḥ sasaumitrir udārasattvaḥ
mitrakāryam kṛtam idaṃ bhavadbhir vānararṣabhāḥ | anujñātā mayā sarve yatheṣṭam pratigacchata
sugrīveṇābhyanujñātā gantuṃ sarvaiś ca vānaraiḥ | mama cāpi priyaṃ kāryam ayodhyādarśanena ca
praveśam caiva rāmasya paurajānapadaiḥ saha | vibhūtiṃ caiva sarvāsāṃ strīṇāṃ daśarathasya ca
śṛṅgaberapuraṃ prāpya guhaṃ gahanagocaram | niṣādādhipatiṃ brūhi kuśalaṃ vacanān mama
śrutvā tāṃ maithilīṃ rāmas tv āśaśaṃse sa jīvitam | jīvitāntam anuprāptaḥ pītvāmṛtam ivāturaḥ
bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ parapurañjayaḥ | tatheti pratijagrāha niṣasādāsane śubhe
dadṛśus te samāyāntaṃ rāghavaṃ sapuraḥsaram | virājamānaṃ vapuṣā rathenātirathaṃ tadā
evam uktā mahātmāno vānarā vāraṇopamāḥ | utpetur gaganaṃ śīghraṃ garuḍā iva śīghragāḥ
ājānulambibāhuś ca mahāvakṣāḥ pratāpavān | lakṣmaṇānucaro rāmaḥ śaśāsa pṛthivīm imām
dvāreṣu tāsāṃ catvāraḥ saṃkramāḥ paramāyatāḥ yantrair upetā bahubhir mahadbhir gṛhapaṅktibhiḥ
jāmbavāṃś ca suṣeṇaś ca vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ ṛkṣarājo mahābāhuḥ kukṣiṃ rakṣantu te trayaḥ
variants.b_text: जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः । ऋक्षराजो महासत्त्वः कुक्षिं रक्षन्तु ते त्रयः ।।6.4.20।।

variants.a_text: tasmāt sumantritaṃ sādhu bhavanto matisattamāḥ kāryaṃ saṃpratipadyantām etat kṛtyaṃ mataṃ mama
yāni karmāpadānāni rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇa | akhyātāni ca tattvena hy avagacchāmi tāny aham ||
aham yady aharam bhāryām rājaputrasya dhīmataḥ | kim tatra tava sugrīva kiśkindhām prati gamyatām ||
pannagaiḥ saha dīptāsyaiḥ samudraḥ pratyadṛśyata | snigdhavaidūryasamkāśo jāmbūnadavibhūṣaṇaḥ ||
cārās tu te tathety uktvā prahṛṣṭā rākṣaseśvaram | śārdūlamagrataḥ kṛtvā tataś cakruḥ pradakṣiṇam ||
vānarair arditās te tu vikrāntair laghuvikramaiḥ | punar laṅkām anuprāptāḥ śvasanto naṣṭacetasaḥ ||
nāsti rāmasya sadṛśo vikrame bhuvi kaścana | virādho nihato yena kabandhaś cāntakopamaḥ ||
sā hi tatra kṛtā mitram sītayā rakṣyamāṇayā | rakṣantī rāvaṇādiṣṭā sānukrośā dṛḍhavratā ||
tac caitrarathasamkāśam manojñam nandanopamam | vanam sarvartukam ramyam śuśubhe ṣaṭpadāyutam ||
mēghāḥ kravyādasaṃkāśāḥ paruṣāḥ paruṣasvanāḥ . krūrāḥ krūraṃ pravarṣante miśraṃ śōṇitabindubhiḥ ||
avatīrya ca dharmātmā tasmāc chailāt sa rāghavaḥ . paraiḥ paramadurdharṣaṃ dadarśa balam ātmanaḥ ||
mahāñ chabdō ‘bhavat tatra balaughasyābhivartataḥ sāgarasyēva bhinnasya yathā syāt salilasvanaḥ ||
rāmalakṣmaṇaguptā sā sugrīvēṇa ca vāhinī babhūva durdharṣatarā sarvair api surāsuraiḥ ||
vānarāṇām api camūr bṛhatī jayam icchatām . abhyadhāvata tāṃ sēnāṃ rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpiṇam ||
vajramuṣṭiś ca maindēna dvividēnāśaniprabhaḥ rākṣasābhyāṃ sughōrābhyāṃ kapimukhyau samāgatau ||
tam āpatantaṃ gadayā vidyunmālī niśācaraḥ . vakṣasy abhijaghānāśu suṣēṇaṃ haripuṃgavam ||
ēvam uktvā tu dharmajñau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau . nirbibhēda śitair bāṇaiḥ prajaharṣa nanāda ca ||
sabāṣpaśōkābhihatā samīkṣya tau bhrātarau dēvasamaprabhāvau . vitarkayantī nidhanaṃ tayōḥ sā duḥkhānvitā vākyam idaṃ jagāda ||
śōdhayitvā janasthanaṃ pravṛttim upalabhya ca . tīrtvā sāgaram akṣōbhyaṃ bhrātarau gōṣpadē hatau ||
kāraṇāni ca vakṣyāmi mahānti sadṛśāni ca . yathēmau jīvatō dēvī bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
sainyaṃ tu vidrutaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhūmrākṣō rākṣasarṣabhaḥ . rōṣēṇa kadanaṃ cakrē vānarāṇāṃ yuyutsatām ||
śūrāṇāṃ yudhyamānānāṃ samarēṣv nivartinām . tadrākṣasagaṇānāṃ ca suyuddhaṃ samavartata ||
jagrāha cārṣabhaṃ carma khaḍgaṃ ca vipulaṃ śubham kiṅkiṇājālasañchannaṃ carmaṇā ca pariṣkṛtam ||
krōdhamūrcitarūpas tu dhūnvan paramakārmukam . dṛṣṭvā tu karma śatrūṇāṃ sārathiṃ vākyam abravīt ||
akampanavadhaṃ śrutvā kruddhō vai rākṣasēśvaraḥ . kiñcid dīnamukhaś cāpi sacivāṃs tān udaikṣata ||
āvarta iva saṃjajñē sēnayōr ubhayōs tadā kṣubhitasyāpramēyasya sāgarasyēva niḥsvanaḥ ||
hatē prahastē nīlēna tad akampyaṃ mahābalam . rākṣasānām ahṛṣṭānāṃ laṅkām abhijagāma ha ||
tatas tu nīlō vijayī mahābalaḥ praśasyamānaḥ sukṛtēna karmaṇā . samētya rāmēṇa salakṣmaṇēna prahṛṣṭarūpas tu babhūva yūthapaḥ ||
athāśvāsya mahātējā rāvaṇō vākyam abravīt sadhu vānara vīryēṇa ślāghanīyō ‘si mē ripuḥ ।।
tatō rāmō mahātējā rāvaṇēna kṛtavraṇam . dṛṣṭvā plavagaśārdūlaṃ krōdhasya vaśam ēyivān ।।
kō ‘sau parvatasaṃkāśaḥ kirīṭī harilōcanaḥ . laṅkāyāṃ dṛśyatē vīraḥ savidyud iva tōyadaḥ ।।
aśāstraviduṣāṃ tēṣāṃ kāryam nābhihitaṃ vacaḥ . arthaśāstrānabhijñānāṃ vipulāṃ śriyam icchatām ।।
atīva hi samālakṣya bhrātaraṃ kṣubhitēndriyam kumbhakarṇaḥ śanair vākyaṃ babhāṣē parisāntvayan ।।
tē nivṛttā mahākāyāḥ śrutvāṅgadavacas tadā . naiṣṭhikīṃ buddhim āsthāya sarvē saṅgrāmakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।।
athāsya kavacaṃ śubhraṃ jāmbhūnadamayaṃ śubham . pracchādayāmāsa śaraiḥ saṃdhyābhram iva mārutaḥ ।।
ity uktavākyaṃ tad rakṣaḥ prōvāca stutisaṃhitam . mṛdhē ghōrataraṃ vākyaṃ saumitriḥ prahasann iva ।।
tiṣṭha kiṃ prākṛtair ēbhir haribhis tvaṃ kariṣyasi . asmin vajrasamasparśaṃ prāsaṃ kṣipa mamōrasi ।।
sa vāyusunūḥ kupitaś cikṣēpa śikharaṃ girēḥ . triśirās tac charais tīkṣṇair bibhēda bahudhā balī ।।
viṃśatir daśa cāṣṭau ca tūṇāsya ratham āsthitāḥ . kārmukāni ca bhīmāni jyāś ca kāñcanapiṅgalāḥ ।।
variants.b_text: विंशतिर्दशचाष्टौ च तूण्योऽस्यरथमास्थिताः । कार्मुकानि च भीमानिज्याश्चकाञ्चनपिङ्गळाः ।।6.71.20।।

variants.a_text: yasya bāhūṃ samāśritya laṅkā vasatinirbhayā . tanayaṃ dhānyamālinyā atikāyam imaṃ viduḥ ।।
sa lalāṭē śarō magnas tasya bhīmasya rakṣasaḥ dadṛśē śōṇitēnāktaḥ pannagēndra ivācalē ।।
ekaṃ trīn pañca saptēti sāyan rākṣasarṣabhaḥ ādadē saṃdadhē cāpi vicakarṣōtsasarja ca ।।
tas tān rākṣasōtsṛṣṭāñ śaraughān rāghavānujaḥ asambrāntaḥ pracicchēda niśitair bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
sa vai gadābhir hariyūthamukhyān nirbhidya bāṇais tapanīyavarṇaiḥ . vavarṣa rāmaṃ śaravṛṣṭijālaiḥ salakṣmaṇaṃ bhāskararamaśikalpaiḥ ।।
tatō rāmaśarān dṛṣṭvā vimānēṣu gṛhēṣu ca . saṃnāhō rākṣasēndrāṇāṃ tumulaḥ samapadyata ।।
tasya tac chuśubhē bhūyaḥ saśaraṃ dhanuruttamam . vidyudairāvatārciṣmadidvatīyēndradhanur yathā ।।
nikṣipya paramāyattō nikumbhaṃ niṣpipēṣa ca utpatya cāsya vēgēna papātōrasi vīryavān ।।
sa hi dhūmāndhakāraṃ ca cakre pracchādayan nabhaḥ diśaś cāntardadhe śrīmān nīhāratamasā vṛtaḥ R_6,067.
imāṃ hatvā tato rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ tvāṃ ca vānara sugrīvaṃ ca vadhiṣyāmi taṃ cānāryaṃ vibhīṣaṇam R_6,068.
variants.b_text: इमांहत्वाततोरामंलक्ष्मणंत्वां च वानर ।।6.81.27।। सुग्रीवं च वधिष्यामितंचानार्यंविभीषणम् ।

variants.a_text: sa gatvā dūram adhvānaṃ saumitrir mitranandanaḥ rākṣasendrabalaṃ dūrād apaśyad vyūham āśritam R_6,072.
kubereṇa svayaṃ svapne yad dattam amitātmanā durjayaṃ durviṣahyaṃ ca sendrair api surāsuraiḥ R_6,078.
tataḥ saṃsaktahastas tu rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ nārācamālāṃ rāmasya lalāṭe pratyamuñcata R_6,087.
pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca diśaś ca pradiśas tathā prākampayat tadā śabdo rākṣasendrasya dāruṇaḥ R_6,091.
nimittāni ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yāni prādurbhavanti naḥ teṣu teṣv abhipanneṣu lakṣayāmy apradakṣiṇam R_6,093.
enam āpatsu kṛcchreṣu kāntāreṣu bhayeṣu ca | kīrtayan puruṣaḥ kaścin nāvasīdati rāghava
parituṣṭaḥ sa rāmasya tena vākyena mātaliḥ | pracodayāmāsa rathaṃ surasārathisattamaḥ
tau tathā yudhyamānau tu samare rāmarāvaṇau | dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni vismitenāntarātmanā
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ piśācoragarakṣasām | paśyatāṃ tan mahāyuddhaṃ sarvarātram avartata
kiṃ śeṣam iha lokasya gatasattvasya saṃprati | raṇe rākṣasaśārdūle prasupta iva pāṃsuṣu
tadevaṃ niścayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tattvam āsthāya vijvaraḥ | yad ihānantaraṃ kāryaṃ kalpyaṃ tadanucintaya
diṣṭyā sarvasya lokasya pravṛddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ tamaḥ | apāvṛttaṃ tvayā saṃkhye rāma rāvaṇajaṃ bhayam
kaikeyyā yāni coktāni vākyāni vadatāṃ vara | tava pravrājanārthāni sthitāni hṛdaye mama
tatas tu sā lakṣmaṇarāmapālitā | mahācamūr hṛṣṭajanā yaśasvinī | śriyā jvalantī virarāja sarvato | niśā praṇīteva hi śītaraśminā
tasya buddhiṃ ca vijñāya vyavasāyaṃ ca vānara | yāvan na dūraṃ yātāḥ smaḥ kṣipram āgantum arhasi
variants.b_text: तस्यबुद्धिं च विज्ञायव्यवसायं च वानर । यावन्नदूरंयाताःस्मक्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि ।।6.128.18।।

variants.a_text: manasā brahmaṇā sṛṣṭe vimāne bharatāgrajaḥ | rarāja pṛthudīrghākṣo vajrapāṇir ivāmaraḥ
sauvarṇān vānarendrāṇān caturṇāṃ caturo ghaṭān | dadau kṣipraṃ sa sugrīvaḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitān
taṃ tu śokaparidyūnaṃ rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam uvāca vacanaṃ śrīmān sugrīvaḥ śokanāśanam
agnicūrṇam ivāviddhaṃ bhāskarāmbumahoragam surārinilayaṃ ghoraṃ pātālaviṣayaṃ sadā
variants.b_text: अग्निचूर्णमिवाविद्धं भास्वराम्बुमहोरगम् । सुरारिविषयं घोरं पाताळविषमं सदा ।।6.4.117।।

variants.a_text: āśvāsito lakṣmaṇena rāmaḥ saṃdhyām upāsata smaran kamalapatrākṣīṃ sītāṃ śokākulīkṛtaḥ
preṣitā bharatenaiva bhrātrā tava yavīyasā sa hi senām samutthāpya kṣipram evopayāsyati
ākāśe gaṇaśaḥ sthitvā hatvā tām harivāhinīm aśmaśastramahāvṛṣṭyā prāpayāma yamakṣayam
yāvan na sagajāṃ sāśvāṃ bahuratnasamākulām purīṃ dārayate bāṇair dīyatām asya maithilī

sa kṛttacāpaḥ śaratāḍitaś ca mēdārdragātrō rudhirāvasiktaḥ . jagrāha śaktiṃ svayam ugraśaktiḥ svayambhudattāṃ yudhi dēvaśatruḥ ।।
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā guṇadōṣau vimṛśya ca . paścād api mahābāhō śatrūn yudhi vijēṣyasi ।।
śīghraṃ khalv abhyupētaṃ tvāṃ phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ . nirayēṣv ēva patanaṃ yathā duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ ।।
ṣōḍaśāṣṭau ca daśa ca viṃśatriṃśat tathaiva ca parikṣipya ca bāhubhyāṃ khādan sa paridhāvati bhakṣyan bhṛśasaṃkruddhō garuḍaḥ pannagān iva ।।

ēvaṃ gṛhītēna kathaṃ nu nāma śakyaṃ mayā samprati kartum adya . tathā kariṣyāmi yathā harīṇāṃ bhaviṣyatīṣṭaṃ ca hitaṃ ca kāryam ।।
pitṛvyaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā dēvāntakanarāntakau . triśirāś cātikāyaś ca ruruduḥ śōkapīḍitāḥ ।।

ta drumāṇāṃ śilānāṃ ca varṣaṃ prāṇaharaṃ mahat . vyapōhata mahātējā rāvaṇiḥ samitiṃjayaḥ ।।

tataḥ kumbhanipātēna jalarāśiḥ samutthitaḥ . vindhyamandarasaṃkāśō visasarpa samantataḥ ।।

pratipūjya yathānyāyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ te mahārathāḥ tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve bhartur vijayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ R_6,083.

sā tolitā balavatā śaktir ghaṇṭākṛtasvanā nabhaḥ prajvālayāmāsa yugāntolkeva saprabhā R_6,091.
