te sametya sabhāyām vai rākṣasā rājaśāsanāt yathārham upatasthus te rāvaṇam rākṣasādhipam
anupāyena karmāṇi viparītāni yāni ca | kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīmṣy aprayateṣv iva ||
upapradānam sāntvam vā bhedam vā kuśalaiḥ kṛtam | samatikramya daṇḍena siddhimartheṣu rocaye ||
na bhavantam matiśreṣṭham samartham vadatām varam | atiśāyayitum śakto bṛhaspatir api bruvan ||
tena cemam mahāprājñam abhiṣinca vibhīṣaṇam | rājānam rakṣasām kṣipram prasanne mayi mānada ||
tayos tad vacanam śrutvā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ | abravīt prahasan vākyam sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ||
adṛṣṭam mṛtyum āpannaḥ kasmāt tvam nayaśāstravit | vyasanānām upāyajnaḥ kuśalo hyasi varjane ||
śīghram bherīninādena sphuṭaṃ koṇāhatena me | samānayadhvam sainyāni vaktavyam ca na kāraṇam ||
ihāsīnā sukham sarvam ākhyāhi mama tattvataḥ | krūrasya niścayam tasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ||
kharābhistanitā ghorā meghāh pratibhayaṅkaraḥ | śoṇitenābhivarṣanti lankām uṣṇena sarvataḥ ||
gandhāḍhyāny abhiramyāṇi puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca | dhārayanty agamās tatra bhūṣaṇānīva mānavāḥ ||
prāsādaiś ca vimānaiś ca lankā paramabhūṣitā | ghanair ivātapāpāye madhyamam vaiṣṇavam padam ||
tau tv adīrghēṇa kālēna bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau . rāvaṇasya purīṃ laṅkām asēdatur ariṃdamau ||
tatrāsīt sumahad yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ rōmaharṣaṇam rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca vīrāṇāṃ jayam icchatām ||
vidyunmālī rathasthas tu śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ . suṣēṇaṃ tāḍayāmāsa nanāda ca muhur muhuḥ ||
rukmapuṅkhaiḥ prasannāgrai rajōgatibhir āśugaiḥ . nārācair ardhanārācair bhallair añjalikair api vivyādha vatsadantaiś ca siṅhadaṅṣṭraiḥ kṣurais tathā ||
rāmasya lakṣmaṇasyaiva sarvēṣāṃ ca vanaukasām . vikramā niṣphalāḥ sarvē yathā śaradi tōyadāḥ ||
tān ardhayitvā bāṇaughais trāsayitvā ca vānarān prajahāsa mahābāhur vacanaṃ cēdam abravīt ||
gavayēna gavākṣēṇa śarabhēṇa gajēna ca . anyaiś ca haribhir yuddhaṃ madarthē tyaktajīvitaiḥ ||
jīvann adya vipannō ‘smi naṣṭarājyamanōrathaḥ . prāptapratijñaś ca ripuḥ sakāmō rāvaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
tasya kruddhasya rōṣēṇa gadāṃ tāṃ bahukaṇṭakām . pātayāmāsa dhūmrākṣō mastakē ‘tha hanūmataḥ ||
tatō ‘nyaṃ vṛkṣam utpāṭya kṛtvā vēgam anuttamam . śirasy abhijaghānāśu rākṣasēndram akampanam ||
ruddhāṃ tu nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇō rākṣasēśvaraḥ uvācātmahitaṃ kālē prahastaṃ yuddhakōvidam ||
amṛṣyamāṇas tat karma prahastō ratham āśritaḥ cakāra kadanaṃ ghōraṃ dhanuṣpāṇir vanaukasām ||
ēvam uktvā tatō rāmō dhanur ādāya vīryavān . lakṣmaṇānucaras tasthau samuddhṛtya śarōttamam ।।
tatas tṛpta iti jñātvā samutpētur niśācarāḥ . śirōbhiś ca praṇamyainaṃ sarvataḥ paryavārayan ।।
sa rājamārgaṃ vapuṣā prakāśayan sahasraraśmir dharaṇīm ivāṃśubhiḥ . jagāma tatrāñjalimālayā vṛtaḥ śatakratur gēham iva svayambhuvaḥ ।।
athāsīnasya paryaṅkē kumbhakarṇō mahābalaḥ . bhrātur vavandē caraṇau kiṃ kṛtyam iti cābravīt ।।
vināśayantō bhartāraṃ sahitāḥ śatrubhir budhaiḥ . viparītāni kṛtyāni kārayantīha mantriṇaḥ ।।
adya rāmasya paśyantu nidhanaṃ sumahatpriyam . laṅkāyāṃ rākṣasāḥ sarvē yē tē nihatabāndhavāḥ ।।
aihalaukikapārakyaṃ karma pumbhir niṣēvyatē . karmāṇy api tu kalyāṇi labhatē kāmam āsthitaḥ ।।
tatō vinēduḥ sahasā prahṛṣṭā rakṣōgaṇās taṃ vyathitaṃ samīkṣya . plavaṅgamās tu vyathitā bhayartāḥ pradudruvuḥ saṃyati kumbhakarṇāt ।।
sparśān iva prahārāṃs tān vēdayānō na vivyathē ṛṣabhaṃ tu mahāvēgaṃ bāhubhyāṃ pariṣasvajē ।।
kṛtaṃ bhārasahasrasya śūlaṃ kālāyasaṃ mahat . babhañja jānum ārōpya tadā hṛṣṭaḥ plavaṅgamaḥ ।।
tatas tam ādāya jagāma vīraḥ saṃstūyamānō yudhi rākṣasēndraiḥ . śṛṇvan ninādaṃ tridivālayānāṃ plavaṅgarājagrahavismitānām ।।
tatas tam ādāya tadā sa mēnē harīndram indrōpamam indravīryaḥ asmin hatē sarvam idaṃ hataṃ syāt sarāghavaṃ sainyam itīndraśatruḥ ।।
ayaṃ muhūrtāt sugrīvō labdhasaṃjñō mahāhavē . ātmanō vānarāṇāṃ ca yat pathyaṃ tat kariṣyati ।।
tasyōrasi nimagnās tē śarā barhiṇavāsasaḥ . hastāc chāsya paribhraṣṭā gadā cōrvyāṃ papāta ha ।।
taṃ chinnabāhuṃ samavēkṣya rāmaḥ samāpatantaṃ sahasā nadantam . dvāv ardhacandrau niśitau pragṛhya cicchēda pādau yudhi rākṣasasya ।।
adyaiva taṃ gamiṣyāmi dēśaṃ yatrānujō mama . na hi bhrātṛn samutsṛjya kṣaṇaṃ jīvitam utsahē ।।
tataḥ sudarśanaṃ nāgaṃ nīlajīmūtasaṃnibham . airāvatakulē jātam ārurōha mahōdaraḥ ।।
ēkēnāntakakalpēna prāsēnādityatējasā . bhagnāni harisainyāni nipētur dharaṇītalē ।।
tadasmin kriyatāṃ yatnaḥ kṣipraṃ puruṣapuṅgava . purā vānarasainyāni kṣayaṃ nayati sāyakaiḥ ।।
na śaśāka rujaṃ kartuṃ yudhi tasya narōttamaḥ . athainam abhyupāgamya vāyur vākyam uvāca ha ।।
tatō hatān rākṣasapuṃgavāṃs tān dēvāntakāditriśirō ‘tikāyān . rakṣōgaṇās tatra hatāvaśiṣṭās tē rāvaṇāya tvaritāḥ śaśaṃsuḥ ।।
tatas tu rājānam udīkṣya dīnaṃ śōkārṇavē saṃparipupluvānam . ratharṣabhō rākṣasarājasūnus tam indrajid vākyam idaṃ babhāṣē ।।
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā jāmbavān vākyam abravīt . śṛṇu nairṛtaśārdūla yasmāt pṛcchāmi mārutim ।।
sa tu tēna prahārēṇa maindō vānarayūthapaḥ . marmaṇy abhihatas tēna papāta bhuvi mūrchitaḥ ।।
nikumbhō bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvēṇa nipātitam . pradahann iva kōpēna vānarēndram avaikṣata ।।
atha ninadati sāditē nikumbhē pavanasutēna raṇē babhūva yuddham . daśarathasutarākṣasēndrasūnvōr bhṛśataram āgata rōṣayōḥ subhīmam ।।
sō ‘bhivādya daśagrīvaṃ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam . nirjagāma gṛhāc chubhrād rāvaṇasyājñayā balī ।।
tasya tē rathasaṃyuktā hayā vikramavarjitāḥ . caraṇair ākulair gatvā dīnāḥ sāsramukhā yayuḥ ।।
hutvāgniṃ tarpayitvātha devadānavarākṣasān āruroha rathaśreṣṭham antardhānagataṃ śubham R_6,067.
hanūmān puratas teṣāṃ jagāma kapikuñjaraḥ pragṛhya sumahac chṛṅgaṃ parvatasya durāsadam R_6,068.
śubhe vartmani tiṣṭhantaṃ tvām ārya vijitendriyam anarthebhyo na śaknoti trātuṃ dharmo nirarthakaḥ R_6,070.
vibhīṣaṇena sahito rājaputraḥ pratāpavān kṛtasvastyayano bhrātrā lakṣmaṇas tvarito yayau R_6,072.
vibhiṣaṇena sahito rajaputraḥ pratāpavān aṅgadena ca vīreṇa tathānilasutena ca R_6,072.
parasvaharaṇe yuktaṃ paradārābhimarśakam tyajyam ahur durātmānaṃ veśma prajvalitaṃ yathā R_6,074.
rākṣasair vadhyamānānāṃ vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātā rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam R_6,081.
tataḥ prajavitāśvena rathena sa mahārathaḥ dvāreṇa niryayau tena yatra tau rāmalakṣmaṇau R_6,083.
vivṛttanayanaṃ krodhāt saphenaṃ rudhirāplutam dadṛśus te virūpākṣaṃ virūpākṣataraṃ kṛtam R_6,084.
te mahāmeghasaṃkāśe kavace patitāḥ śarāḥ avadhye rākṣasendrasya na vyathāṃ janayaṃs tadā R_6,087.
tataś cakrāṇi niṣpetur bhāsvarāṇi mahānti ca kārmukād bhīmavegasya daśagrīvasya dhīmataḥ R_6,088.
sa viddho daśabhir bāṇair mahākārmukaniḥsṛtaiḥ rāvaṇena mahātejā na prākampata rāghavaḥ R_6,088.
sā kṣiptā bhīmavegena vajrāśanisamasvanā śaktir abhyapatad vegāl lakṣmaṇaṃ raṇamūrdhani R_6,088.
samāgamya mahāvegaḥ saṃnyasya śikharaṃ gireḥ | viśramya kiṃcid dhanumān suṣeṇam idam abravīt
samudyamya mahākāyo nanāda yudhi bhairavam saṃraktanayano roṣāt svasainyam abhiharṣayan R_6,091.
sa tāṃ mātalinā nītāṃ śaktiṃ vāsavasaṃmatām jagrāha paramakruddho rāghavo raghunandanaḥ R_6,091.
sa śoṇitasamādigdhaḥ samare lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ phulla ivāraṇye sumahān kiṃśukadrumaḥ R_6,092.
sthalanimnāni bhūmeś ca samāni viṣamāṇi ca yuddhakālaś ca vijñeyaḥ parasyāntaradarśanam R_6,093.
diśaśca pradiśaḥ sarvā babhūvus timirāvṛtāḥ | pāṃsuvarṣeṇa mahatā durdarśaṃ ca nabho ‘bhavat
gatāsur bhīmavegas tu nairṛtendro mahādyutiḥ | papāta syandanād bhūmau vṛtro vajrahato yathā
tataḥ prajagmuḥ praśamaṃ marudgaṇā | diśaḥ prasedur vimalaṃ nabho ‘bhavat | mahī cakampe na ca māruto vavau | sthiraprabhaś cāpy abhavad divākaraḥ
tatas tu sugrīvavibhīṣaṇāṅgadāḥ | suhṛdviśiṣṭāḥ sahalakṣmaṇās tadā | sametya hṛṣṭā vijayena rāghavaṃ | raṇe ‘bhirāmaṃ vidhinābhyapūjayan
utkṣipya ca bhujau kācid bhūmau suparivartate | hatasya vadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kācin moham upāgamat
nanu nāma mahābāho tava vaiśravaṇānuja | kruddhasya pramukhe sthātuṃ trasyaty api puraṃdaraḥ
kathaṃ trailokyam ākramya śriyā vīryeṇa cānvitam | aviṣahyaṃ jaghāna tvāṃ mānuṣo vanagocaraḥ
ājñaptā rākṣaseneha rākṣasyas tarjayanti mām | hate tasmin na kurvanti tarjanaṃ mārutātmaja
evam uktā tu vaidehī pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam | asnātvā draṣṭum icchāmi bhartāraṃ rākṣaseṣvara
tato bāṣpapariklinnaṃ pramārjantī svam ānanam | śanair gadgadayā vācā bhartāram idam abravīt
na tathāsmi mahābāho yathā mām avagacchasi | pratyayaṃ gaccha me svena cāritreṇaiva te śape
viśuddhabhāvāṃ niṣpāpāṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva maithilīm | na kiṃcid abhidhātavyā aham ājñāpayāmi te
samuttiṣṭhantu te sarve hatā ye yudhi rākṣasaiḥ | ṛkṣāśca saha gopucchair nikṛttānanabāhavaḥ
dṛṣṭvā tvām abhiṣekārdhaṃ kausalyām abhivādya ca | acirād āgamiṣyāmaḥ svagṛhān nṛpasattama
śarabhaṅge divaṃ prāpte rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ | abhivādya munīnsarvāñ janasthānam upāgamat
ādiṣṭā vānarendreṇa sugrīveṇa mahātmanā | daśa koṭyaḥ plavaṅgānāṃ sarvāḥ prasthāpitā diśaḥ
bhrātā tu gṛdhrarājasya sampātir nāma vīryavān | samākhyāti sma vasatīṃ sītāṃ rāvaṇamandire
athābravīd rājaputraḥ sugrīvaṃ vānararṣabham | pariṣvajya mahātejā bharato dharmiṇāṃ varaḥ
hariyuktaṃ sahasrākṣo ratham indra ivānaghaḥ | prayayau ratham āsthāya rāmo nagaram uttamam
śṛṇoti ya idaṃ kāvyaṃ purā vālmīkinā kṛtam | śraddadhāno jitakrodho durgāṇy atitaraty asau
śataiḥ śatasahasraiś ca koṭībhir ayutair api vāraṇābhaiś ca haribhir yayau parivṛtas tadā
variants.b_text: शतैः शतसहस्रैश्च कोटिभिश्चायुतैरपि । वारणाभैश्च हरिभिर्ययौ परिवृतस्तदा ।।6.4.24।।

variants.a_text: tvayedam mahād ārabdham kāryam apraticintitam | diṣṭyā tvām nāvadhīd rāmo viṣamiśram ivāmiṣam ||
sarve mahārāja mahāprabhāvāḥ | sarve mahāśailanikāśakāyāḥ | sarve samarthāḥ pṛthivīm kṣaṇena | kartum pravidhvastavikīrṇaśailām ||
lakṣmaṇaś cātra dharmātmā mātaṅgānām ivarṣabhaḥ | yasya bāṇapatham prāpya na jīvedapi vāsavaḥ ||
lāghavēna tu saṃyuktō vidyunmālī niśācaraḥ apakramya rathāt tūrṇaṃ gadāpāṇiḥ kṣitau sthitaḥ ||
dūṣaṇasya ca hantārau kharasya ca mahābalau sāditau māmakair bāṇair bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
ahaṃ sakhā tē kākutstha priyaḥ prāṇō bahiścaraḥ . garutmān iha samprāptō yuvayōḥ sāhyakāraṇāt ||
tataḥ subhīmō bahubhir niśācarair vṛtō ‘bhiniṣkramya raṇōtsukō balī . dadarśa tāṃ rāghavabāhupālitāṃ mahaughakalpāṃ bahu vānarīṃ camūm ||
gaccha tvaṃ vīra niryāhi rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ . jahi dāśarathiṃ rāmaṃ sugrīvaṃ vānaraiḥ saha ||
ēvam uktvā tu bhartāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ vāhinīpatiḥ uvācēdaṃ balādhyakṣān prahastaḥ purataḥ sthitān ||
sā mahī rudhiraughēṇa pracchannā samprakāśatē saṃchannā mādhavē māsi palāśair iva puṣpitaiḥ ||
tatō nagaryāḥ sahasā mahaujā niṣkramya tad vānarasainyam ugram . mahārṇavābhrastanitaṃ dadarśa samudyataṃ pādapaśailahastam ।।
tad rākṣasānīkam atipracaṇḍam ālōkya rāmō bhujagēndrabāhuḥ . vibhīṣaṇaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham uvāca sēnānugataḥ pṛthuśrīḥ ।।
yō ‘sau hayaṃ kāñcanacitrabhāṇḍam āruhya saṃdhyābhragiriprakāśaḥ . prāsaṃ samudyamya marīcinaddhaṃ piśāca ēṣō ‘śanitulyavēgaḥ ।।
tam ālōkya mahātējā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ . nivārya śarajālāni pradudrāva sa rāvaṇam ।।
sa tāṃ sadhūmānalasaṃnikāśāṃ vitrāsanaṃ saṃyati vānarāṇām . cikṣēpa śaktiṃ tarasā jvalantīṃ saumitrayē rākṣasarāṣṭranāthaḥ ।।
mātaṃga iva siṃhēna garuḍēnēva pannagaḥ . abhibhūtō ‘bhavad rājā rāghavēṇa mahātmanā ।।
ucyantāṃ vānarāḥ sarvē yantram ētat samucchritam iti vijñāya harayō bhaviṣyantīha nirbhayāḥ ।।
kaścin mē tvatsamō nāsti sauhṛdēna balēna ca . gaccha śatruvadhāya tvaṃ kumbhakarṇa jayāya ca ।।
sō ‘pi sainyāni saṃkruddhō vānarāṇaṃ mahaujasām . mamantha paramāyattō vanāny agnir ivōtthitaḥ ।।
tasmin hate dēvaripau triśīrṣē hanūmatā śakraparākramēṇa . nēduḥ plavaṅgāḥ pracacāla bhūmī rakṣāṃsy athō dudruvirē samantāt ।।
sa havirlājasatkārair mālyagandhapuraskṛtaiḥ juhuvē pāvakaṃ tatra rākṣanēndraḥ pratāpavān ।।
rāghavaś cāpi vipulaṃ taṃ rākṣasavanaukasām śrutvā saṃgrāmanirghoṣaṃ jāmbavantam uvāca ha R_6,070.
rāghavaṃ ca mahātmānam ikṣvākukulanandanam dadarśa moham āpannaṃ lakṣmaṇasyāṅkam āśritam R_6,071.
athainaṃ chinnadhanvānam āśīviṣaviṣōpamaiḥ vivayādhōrasi saumitrī rāvaṇiṃ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
tad rākṣasatanūjasya bhinnaskandhaṃ śiro mahat tapanīyanibhaṃ bhūmau dadṛśe rudhirokṣitam R_6,078.
tataḥ paramasaṃkruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ abravīd rakṣasāṃ madhye saṃstambhayiṣur āhave R_6,080.
tatas te vānarāḥ sarve śoṇitaughapariplutāḥ dhvajavarmarathān aśvān nānāpraharaṇāni ca āplutyāplutya samare vānarendrā babhañjire R_6,081.
bhramantīm kāñcanīṃ koṭiṃ kārmukasya mahātmanaḥ alātacakrapratimāṃ dadṛśus te na rāghavam R_6,081.
rākṣasasya stanābhyāśe marmajño hṛdayaṃ prati indrāśanisamasparśaṃ sa muṣṭiṃ vinyapātayat R_6,086.
sa diśo daśa ghoṣeṇa rathasyātiratho mahān nādayan prayayau tūrṇaṃ rāghavaṃ cābhyadhāvata R_6,087.
tāmasaṃ sumahāghoraṃ cakārāstraṃ sudāruṇam nirdadāha kapīn sarvāṃs te prapetuḥ samantataḥ R_6,087.
iti cintāparaś cāsīd apramattaś ca saṃyuge | vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi rāghavo rāvaṇorasi
siṃharkṣalāṅgūlakakudviṣāṇaḥ | parābhijidgandhanagandhavāhaḥ | rakṣovṛṣaś cāpalakarṇacakṣuḥ | kṣitīśvaravyāgrahato ‘vasannaḥ
athavā rāmarūpeṇa kṛtāntaḥ svayamāgataḥ | māyāṃ tava vināśāya vidhāyāpratitarkitām
sītānimittajo mṛtyus tvayā dūrād upāhṛtaḥ | maithilī saha rāmeṇa viśokā vihariṣyati
tatah śailopamaṃ vīraṃ prāñjaliṃ praṇataṃ sthitam | uvācedaṃ vaco rāmo hanūmantaṃ plavaṅgamam
tato ‘bravīd dharivaraḥ sītām apratijalpatīm | kiṃ tvaṃ cintayase devi kiṃ ca māṃ nābhibhāṣase
divyāṅgarāgā vaidehī divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | yānam āroha bhadraṃ te bhartā tvāṃ draṣṭum icchati
yat kartavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa dharṣaṇāṃ pratimārjatā | tat kṛtaṃ rāvaṇaṃ hatvā mayedaṃ mānakāṅkṣiṇā
iti bruvāṇaṃ rājānaṃ rāmaḥ prāñjalir abravīt | kuru prasādaṃ dharmajña kaikeyyā bharatasya ca
tataḥ samudram āsādya nalaṃ setum akārayat | atarat kapivīrāṇāṃ vāhinī tena setunā
taṃ gaṅgāṃ punarāsādya vasantaṃ munisaṃnidhau | avighnaṃ puṣyayogena śvo rāmaṃ draṣṭum arhasi
te vardhayitvā kākutsthaṃ rāmeṇa pratinanditāḥ | anujagmur mahātmānaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritam
sugrīvo vānaraśreṣṭho dṛṣṭvā rāmābhiṣecanam | pūjitaścaiva rāmeṇa kiṣkindhāṃ prāviśat purīm
śrutvā rāmasya vacanaṃ hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ śreṣṭho rāmaṃ punar athābravīt
pūjitān dadhipātraiś ca sarpirbhiḥ sumanokṣataiḥ mantravedavido viprān dadarśa sa mahābalaḥ
sasomagrahanakṣatrair marudbhir iva vāsavaḥ | bhavadbhir aham atyartham vṛtaḥ śriyam avāpnuyām ||
prahastavākyam tv ahitam niśamya | vibhīṣaṇo rājahitānukāṅikṣī | tato mahārtham vacanam babhāṣe | dharmārthakāmeṣu niviṣṭabuddhiḥ ||
rāghavenābhaye datte saṃnato rāvaṇānujaḥ | vibhīṣaṇo mahāprājño bhūmim samavalokayat ||
pracacāla ca vegena trastā caiva vasundharā | pīḍyamānā balaughena tena sāgaravarcasā ||
etām pravṛttim lankāyām mantriproktam vibhīṣaṇaḥ | evam uktvā mahābāhū rākṣasāṃs tān adarśayat ||
grāhayāmāsa tārēyas svayam ātmanam ātmavān . balaṃ darśayituṃ vīrō yātudhānagaṇē tadā ||
ity ēvaṃ ghōṣayantaś ca garjantaś ca plavaṅgamāḥ . abhyadhāvanta laṅkāyāḥ prākāraṃ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ||
pūrvadvāraṃ tu kumudaḥ kōṭībhir daśabhir vṛtaḥ . āvṛtya balavāṃs tasthau haribhir jitakāśibhiḥ ||
niṣpatanti tataḥ sainyā hṛṣṭā rāvaṇacōditāḥ . samayē pūryamāṇasya vēgā iva mahōdadhēḥ ||
tatō dyāṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva vīkṣamāṇā vanaukasaḥ . dadṛśuḥ saṃtatau bāṇair bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
vṛṣṭvēvōparatē dēvē kṛtakarmaṇi rākṣasē . ājagāmātha taṃ dēśaṃ sasugrīvō vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
tām ādāya tu rākṣasyō bhartṛśōkaparājitām sītām ārōpayāmāsur vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ tadā ||
nahi kōpaparītāni harṣaparyutsukāni ca . bhavanti yudhi yōdhānāṃ mukhāni nihatē patau ||
mahatā pakṣavātēna sarvadvīpamahādrumāḥ . nipetur bhagnaviṭapāḥ salilē lavaṇāmbhasi ||
abhavan pannagās trastā bhōginas tatra vāsinaḥ . śīghraṃ sarvāṇi yādāṃsi jagmuś ca lavaṇārṇavam ||
tanna viśvasanīyaṃ vō rākṣasānāṃ raṇājirē . ētēnaivōpamānēna nityaṃ jihmā hi rākṣasāḥ ||
śīghraṃ niryāntu durdharṣā rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ . akampanaṃ puraskṛtya sarvaśastrāstrakōvidam ||
sō ‘haṃ ripuvināśāya vijayāyāvicārayan . svayam ēva gamiṣyāmi raṇaśīrṣaṃ tad adbhutam ।।
rajjubandhanabaddhābhiḥ śataghnībhiś ca sarvaśaḥ vadhyamānō mahākāyō na prābudhyata rākṣasaḥ ।।
atha dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇam upasthitam . tūrṇam utthāya saṃhṛṣṭaḥ saṃnikarṣam upānayat ।।
sarvakṣapitakōśaṃ ca sa tvam abhyupapadya mām . trāyasvēmāṃ purīṃ laṅkāṃ bālavṛddhāvaśēṣitām ।।
yaḥ paścāt pūrvakāryāṇi kuryād aiśvaryam āsthitaḥ . pūrvaṃ cōttarakāryāṇi na sa vēda nayānayau ।।
bāhubhyāṃ vānarān sarvān pragṛhya sa mahābalaḥ . bhakṣayām āsa saṃkruddhō garuḍaḥ pannagā niva ।।
sa śailaśṛṅgābhihataś cukōpa nanāda rōṣāc ca vivṛtya vaktram . vyāvidhya śūlaṃ ca taḍiṭprakāśaṃ cikṣēpa haryṛkṣipatēr vadhāya ।।
tasya rāmēṇa viddhasya sahasābhipradhāvataḥ . aṅgāramiśrāḥ kruddhasya mukhān niścērur arciṣaḥ ।।
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rājaputrasya dhīmataḥ tē samāruruhur hṛṣṭāḥ kumbhakarṇaṃ plavaṅgamāḥ ।।
ētēnārādhitō brahmō tapasā bhāvitātmanā . astrāṇi cāpy avāptāni ripavaś ca parājitāḥ ।।
nānāvikṛtasaṃsthānaṃ vājibhāṇḍaparicchadam gajagraivēyakakṣyāś ca rathabhāṇḍāś ca samskṛtān ।।
tanutrāṇi ca yōdhānāṃ hastyaśvānāṃ va carma ca khaḍgā dhanūṃṣi jyābāṇās tōmarāṅkuśaśaktayaḥ ।।
variants.b_text: नुत्राणि च योधानांहस्त्यश्वानां व चर्म च ।।6.75.11।। खडगाधनूंषिज्वाबाणास्तोमराङ्कुशशक्तयः ।

variants.a_text: pradagdhakāyān aparān rākṣasān nirgatān bahiḥ . sahasā hy utpatanti sma harayō ‘tha yuyutsavaḥ ।।
tatas tu kampanaṃ dṛṣṭvā śōṇitākṣō hataṃ raṇē . rathēnābhyapatat kṣipraṃ tatrāṅgadam abhītavat ।।
mahāvimardaṃ samarē mayā saha tavādbhutam . adya bhūtāni paśyantu śakraśambarayōr iva ।।
muṣṭinābhihatas tēnanipapātāśurākṣasaḥ . lōhitāṅga ivākāśād dīptaraśmir yadṛcchayā ।।
kumbhasya patatō rūpaṃ bhagnasyōrasi muṣṭīnā . babhau rudrābhipannasya yathā rūpaṃ gavāṃ patēḥ ।।
dhik tvāṃ pāpasamācāraṃ yasya te matir īdṛśī nṛśaṃsānārya durvṛtta kṣudra pāpaparākrama anāryasyedṛśaṃ karma ghṛṇā te nāsti nirghṛṇa R_6,068.
variants.b_text: धिक्त्वांपापसमाचारंयस्यतेमतिरिदृशी । नृशंसानार्य दुर्वृत्त क्षुद्र पापपराक्रम ।।6.81.19।। अनार्यस्येदृशंकर्मघृणातेनास्तिनिर्घृण ।

variants.a_text: sa tāṃ bāṇasahasreṇa vikṣobhya harivāhinīm hanūmantaṃ hariśreṣṭham indrajit pratyuvāca ha R_6,068.
sa saṃprahāras tumulaḥ saṃjajñe kapirākṣasām devāsurāṇāṃ kruddhānāṃ yathā bhīmo mahāsvanaḥ R_6,077.
nihataṃ sārathiṃ dṛṣṭvā samare rāvaṇātmajaḥ prajahau samaroddharṣaṃ viṣaṇṇaḥ sa babhūva ha R_6,077.
tatas tān rākṣasān sarvān harṣayan rāvanātmajaḥ stunvāno harṣamānaś ca idaṃ vacanam abravīt R_6,078.
variants.b_text: ततस्तान् राक्षसान् सर्वान् हर्षयन् रावणात्मजः । स्तुवानोहर्षमाणश्चइदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.91.4।।

variants.a_text: harṣaṃ ca śakro bhagavān saha sarvair mahārṣibhiḥ jagāma nihate tasmin rākṣase pāpakarmaṇi R_6,078.
vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ svakarmaniratas tathā striyāḥ kasmād vadhaṃ vīra manyase rākṣaseśvara R_6,080.
hatair gajapadātyaśvais tad babhūva raṇājiram ākrīḍabhūmīḥ kruddhasya rudrasyeva mahātmanaḥ R_6,081.
naivāntarikṣaṃ na diśo na ca dyaur nāpi sāgaraḥ prakāśatvaṃ gamiṣyanti madbāṇajaladāvṛtāḥ R_6,083.
variants.b_text: नैवान्तरिक्षं न दिशो न नद्यौर्नापिसागराः । प्रकाशत्वंगमिष्यन्तिमद्बाणजलदावृताः ।।6.96.12।।

variants.a_text: nihatya rāghavasyāstraṃ rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ āsuraṃ sumahāghoram anyad astraṃ cakāra saḥ R_6,087.
nyapatat sā mahāvegā lakṣmaṇasya mahorasi jihvevoragarājasya dīpyamānā mahādyutiḥ R_6,088.
lakṣmaṇena tu tad vākyam uktaṃ śrutvā sa rāghavaḥ saṃdadhe paravīraghno dhanur ādāya vīryavān
abravīcca tadā rāmaṃ sapratodo rathe sthitaḥ | prāñjalir mātalir vākyan sahasrākṣasya sārathiḥ
te rāvaṇadhanurmuktāḥ śarāḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ abhyavartanta kākutsthaṃ sarpā bhūtvā mahāviṣāḥ R_6,090.
śūreṇa dhanadabhrātrā balaiḥ samuditena ca ślāghanīyaṃ mahat karma yaśasyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tvayā R_6,092.
ardayantau tu samare tayos tau syandanottamau | parasparam abhikruddhau parasparam abhidrutau
asurebhyaḥ surebhyo vā pannagebhyo ‘pi vā tathā | bhayaṃ yo na vijānāti tasyedaṃ mānuṣād bhayam
evam uktā hanumatā sītā dharmapathe sthitā | abravīt paramaprītā bāṣpagadgadayā girā
yuddhe vikramataś caiva hitaṃ mantrayatas tathā | sugrīvasya sasainyasya saphalo ‘dya pariśramaḥ
nirjitā jīvalokasya tapasā bhāvitātmanā | agastyena durādharṣā muninā dakṣiṇeva dik
rāvaṇāṅkaparikliṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭāṃ duṣṭena cakṣuṣā | kathaṃ tvāṃ punar ādadyāṃ kulaṃ vyapadiśan mahat
suhṛdbhir bāndhavaiś caiva jñātibhiḥ svajanena ca | sarva eva sameṣyanti saṃyuktāḥ parayā mudā
aśokajaiḥ prītimayaiḥ kapim āliṅgya sambhramāt | siṣeca bharataḥ śrīmān vipulair aśrubindubhiḥ
tat kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau | sāyāhne śarabhaṅgasya ramyam āśramam īyatuḥ
uvāca ca mahātejāḥ sugrīvaṃ rāghavānujaḥ | abhiṣekāya rāmasya dūtān ājñāpaya prabho
āsan varṣasahasrāṇi tathā putrasahasriṇaḥ | nirāmayā viśokāś ca rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
madhye tu rājā sugrīvo rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca balibhir bahubhir bhīmair vṛtāḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
variants.b_text: मध्ये तु राजा सुग्रीवो रामो लक्ष्मण एव च । बलभिर्बहुभि र्भीमैर्वृताश्शत्रुनिबर्हणाः ।।6.4.31।।

variants.a_text: tato vayam itas turṇam śūlaśaktigadādharāḥ cāpabāṇāsihastaś ca tvaritās tatra yāmahe
yāvan na laṅkāṃ samabhidravanti | valīmukhāḥ parvatakūṭamātrāḥ | damṣṭrayudhāś caiva nakhāyudhāś ca | pradīyatām dāśarathāya maithilī ||
yāvan na gṛhṇanti śirāṃsi bāṇā | rāmer itā rākṣasapuṅgavānām | vajropamā vāyusamānavegāḥ | pradīyatām dāśarathāya maithilī ||
dharmapradhānasya mahārathasya | iksvākuvaṃśaprabhavasya rājñaḥ | puro ‘sya devāś ca tathāvidhasya | kṛtyeṣu śaktasya bhavanti mūḍhāḥ ||
yāvaddhi keśagrahaṇāt suhṛdbhiḥ | sametya sarvaiḥ paripūrṇakāmaiḥ | nigṛhya rājā parirakṣitavyo | bhūtair yathā bhīmabalair gṛhītaḥ ||
sunītam hitakāmena vākyam uktam daśānana | na gṛhṇanty akṛtātmānaḥ kālasya vaśamāgatāḥ||
evam uktam tadā rakṣo rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā | rāvaṇasya balam sarvam ākhyātum upacakrame ||
evam uktau tato vīrāv ubhau sugrīvalakṣmaṇau | samudācārasamyuktam idam vacanam ūcatuḥ ||
athādhvani pariśrāntam ardharātre sthitam balam | sukhasuptaṃ samāsādya caritam prathamaṃ caraiḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā dāśarathir laṅkāṃ citradhvajapatākinīm . jagāma manasā sītāṃ dūyamānēna cētasā ||
tatō vānarasainyēna uktō nādaḥ samantataḥ . malayaḥ pūritō yēna sasānuprasthakandaraḥ ||
nikumbas tu raṇē nīlaṃ nīlāñjanacayaprabham . nirbibhēda śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ karair mēgham ivāṃśumān ||
sa tasya gatim anvicchan rājaputraḥ pratāpavān . didēśātibalō rāmō daśa vānarayūthapān ||
ētē hi phullanayanās trāsād āgatasādhvasāḥ karṇē karṇē prakathitā harayō harisattama ||
snigdhagambhīranirghōṣaṃ śrutvā sa ninadaṃ bhṛśam . sacivānāṃ tatas tēṣāṃ madhyē vacanam abravīt ||
kṣipraṃ prahara niḥśaṅkaṃ sthirāṃ kīrtim avāpnuhi . tatas tvāṃ jñātavikrāntaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi vānara ।।
tatō dānavadarpaghnaṃ saumitriṃ dēvakaṇṭakaḥ . taṃ pīḍayitvā bāhubhyāṃ na prabhur laṅghanē ‘bhavat ।।
tatō rāmō mahātējā dhanur ādāya vīryavān . kirīṭinaṃ mahākāyaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ dadarśa ha ।।
adya paśya mahābāhō mayā samaramūrdhani . hate rāmē saha bhrātrā dravantīṃ harivāhinīm ।।
sthānaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca hāniṃ ca dēśakālavidhānavit . ātmanaś ca parēṣāṃ ca budhyatē rākṣasarṣabhaḥ ।।
variants.b_text: स्थानंवृद्धिं च हानि च देशकालविभागवित् । आत्मनश्चपरेषां च बुध्यतेराक्षसर्षभः ।।6.64.4।।

variants.a_text: ṛṣabhaśarabhamaindadhūmranīlāḥ kumudasuṣēṇagavākṣarambhatārāḥ . dvividapanasavāyuputramukhyās tvaritatarābhimukhaṃ raṇaṃ preyātāḥ ।।
tatō harīṇāṃ tad anīkam ugraṃ dudrāva śūlaṃ niśitaṃ pragṛhya tasthau sa tasyāpatataḥ puras tān mahīdharāgraṃ hanumān pragṛhya ।।
babhūvātha paritrastō rākṣasō vimukhō ‘bhavat . siṃhanādaṃ ca tē cakruḥ prahṛṣṭā vanagōcarāḥ mārutiṃ pūjayāṃ cakrur dṛṣṭvā śūlaṃ tathāgatam ।।
sa tasya bāhur giriśṛṅgakalpaḥ samudgarō rāghavabāṇakṛttaḥ . papāta tasmin harirājasainyē jaghāna tāṃ vānaravāhinīm ca ।।
sa dēvalōkasya tamō nihatya sūryō yathā rāhumukhād vimuktaḥ . tathā vyabhāsīd dharisainyamadhyē nihatya rāmō yudhi kumbhakarṇam ।।
drumāṃś ca vipulaskandhān gṛhya vānarapuṃgavāḥ . tad yuddham abhavad ghōraṃ rakṣōvānarasaṃkulam ।।
tē śarair bahubhiś citrais tīkṣṇavēgair alaṅkṛtaiḥ . tōmarair aṅkuśaiś cāpi vānarān jaghnur āhavē ।।
sa taṃ samāsādya mahānagēndram atipravṛddhōttamahemaśṛṅgam . dadarśa puṇyāni mahāśramāṇi surarṣisaṅghōttamasēvitāni ।।
sa tena śailena bhṛśaṃ rarāja śailopamo gandhavahātmajas tu sahasradhāreṇa sapāvakena cakreṇa khe viṣṇur ivārpitena ||
tāv apy ubhau mānuṣarājaputrau taṃ gandham āghrāya mahauṣadhīnām . babhūvatus tatra tadā viśalyāv uttasthur anyē ca haripravīrāḥ ।।
udghuṣṭaṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ ca niḥsvanam . jyāśabdas tāv ubhau śabdāv ati rāmasya śuśruvē ।।
variants.b_text: उद्घुष्टंवानराणां च राक्षसानां च निस्स्वनम् । ज्याशब्दस्तावुभौशब्दावतिरामस्यशुश्रुवे ।।6.75.38।।

variants.a_text: āhūya sō’ṅgadaṃ kōpāt tāḍayāmāsa vēgitaḥ . gadayā kampanaḥ pūrvaṃ sa cacāla bhṛśāhataḥ ।।
jāmbavāṃś ca suṣēṇaś ca vēgadarśī ca vānaraḥ kumbhakarṇātmajaṃ vīraṃ kruddhāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ ।।
ahaṃ rākṣasarājēna rāvaṇēna mahātmanā . ājñaptaḥ samare hantuṃ tāv ubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।।
tathokto rākṣasendreṇa pratigṛhya pitur vacaḥ yajñabhūmau sa vidhivat pāvakaṃ juhuvendrajit R_6,067.
jājvalyamāno vapuṣā tapanīyaparicchadaḥ mṛgaiś candrārdhacandraiś ca sa rathaḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ R_6,067.
ayudhyamānaṃ pracchannaṃ prāñjaliṃ śaraṇāgatam palāyamanāṃ mattaṃ vā na hantuṃ tvam ihārhasi R_6,067.
ayam anagha tavoditaḥ priyārthaṃ janakasutānidhanaṃ nirīkṣya ruṣṭaḥ sarathagajahayaṃ sarākṣasendrāṃ bhṛśam iṣubhir vinipātayāmi laṅkām R_6,070.
etān nihatyātibalān bahūn rākṣasasattamān bāhubhyāṃ sāgaraṃ tīrtvā laṅghyatāṃ goṣpadaṃ laghu R_6,077.
hatam indrajitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṃ ca raṇakṣitau rākṣasānāṃ sahasreṣu na kaś cit pratyadṛśyata R_6,078.
variants.b_text: हतमिन्द्रजितंदृष्टवाशयानं च रणक्षितौ । राक्षसानांसहस्रेषु न कश्चित्प्रत्यदृश्यत ।।6.91.83।।

variants.a_text: tato rāmam abhikramya saumitrir abhivādya ca tasthau bhrātṛsamīpasthaḥ śakrasyendrānujo yathā R_6,079.
praharantaṃ śarīreṣu na te paśyanti rāghavam indriyārtheṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ bhūtātmānam iva prajāḥ R_6,081.
dharmārthasahitaṃ vākyaṃ sarveṣāṃ rakṣasāṃ hitam yuktaṃ vibhīṣaṇenoktaṃ mohāt tasya na rocate R_6,082.
kumbhakarṇaṃ hataṃ śrutvā rāghaveṇa mahābalam atikāyaṃ ca durmarṣaṃ lakṣmaṇena hataṃ tadā priyaṃ cendrajitaṃ putraṃ rāvaṇo nāvabudhyate R_6,082.
dakṣiṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cobhau sutūrṇaṃ saṃparīyatuḥ anyonyam abhisaṃkruddhau jaye praṇihitāv ubhau R_6,085.
tadavasthaṃ samīpastho lakṣmaṇaṃ prekṣya rāghavaḥ bhrātṛsnehān mahātejā viṣaṇṇahṛdayo 'bhavat R_6,088.
sa gāndharveṇa gāndharvaṃ daivaṃ daivena rāghavaḥ astraṃ rākṣasarājasya jaghāna paramāstravit R_6,090.
te rāghavadhanurmuktā rukmapuṅkhāḥ śikhiprabhāḥ suparṇāḥ kāñcanā bhūtvā viceruḥ sarpaśatravaḥ R_6,090.
vyasaneṣu na kṛcchreṣu na yuddheṣu svayaṃvare | na kratau no vivāhe ca darśanaṃ duṣyate striyaḥ
variants.b_text: व्यसनेषु न कृच्छ्रेषु न युद्धेषुस्वयंवरे । न क्रतौनोविवाहेवादर्शनंदूष्यतेस्त्रियाः ।।6.117.28।।

variants.a_text: pratyakṣaṃ vānarasyāsya tadvākyasamanantaram | tvayā saṃtyaktayā vīra tyaktaṃ syāj jīvitaṃ mayā
evaṃ uktas tu vaidehyā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā | amarṣavaśam āpanno rāghavaṃ samudaikṣata
abravīttu tadā rāmaṃ sākṣī lokasya pāvakaḥ | eṣā te rāma vaidehī pāpamasyāṃ na vidyate
anuraktena balinā śucinā dharmacāriṇā | iccheyaṃ tvām ahaṃ draṣṭuṃ bharatena samāgatam
teṣv ārūḍheṣu sarveṣu kauberam paramāsanam | rāghaveṇābhyanujñātam utpapāta vihāyasam
niśamya rāmāgamanaṃ nṛpātmajaḥ | kapipravīrasya tadādbhutopamam | praharṣito rāmadidṛkṣayābhavat | punaś ca harṣād idam abravīd vacaḥ
ekena saha saṃgamya rāmeṇa raṇamūrdhani | ahnaś caturthabhāgena niḥśeṣā rākṣasāḥ kṛtāḥ
tany añjalisahasrāṇi pragṛhītāni nāgaraiḥ | vyākośānīva padmāni dadarśa bharatāgrajaḥ
sugrīvo hanumāṃś caiva mahendrasadṛśadyutī | snātau divyanibhair vastrair jagmatuḥ śubhakuṇḍalau
sakhyaṃ ca rāmaḥ sugrīve prabhāvaṃ cānilātmaje | vānarāṇāṃ ca tatkarma hy ācacakṣe ‘tha mantriṇām
variants.b_text: सख्यं च रामस्सुग्रीवेप्रभावंचानिलात्मजे । वानराणां च तत्कर्मह्याचचक्षेऽऽथमन्त्रिणाम् ।।6.131.39।।

variants.a_text: na paryadevan vidhavā na ca vyālakṛtaṃ bhayam | na vyādhijaṃ bhayaṃ cāsid rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
variants.b_text: स पर्यदेवन्विधवा न च व्यालकृतंभयम् । न व्याधिजंभयंचासीद्रामेराज्यंप्रशासति ।।6.131.99।।

variants.a_text: niyukto nṛpateḥ karyaṃ na kuryād yaḥ samāhitaḥ bhṛtyo yuktaḥ samarthaś ca tam āhuḥ puruṣādhamam
variants.b_text: नियुक्तो नृपतेः  कार्यं न कुर्याद्यस्समाहितः । भृत्यो युक्तस्समर्थश्च तमाहुः पुरुषाधमम् ।।6.1.9।।

variants.a_text: samudraṃ laṅghayitvā tu mahānakrasamākulam laṅkām ārohayiṣyāmo haniṣyāmaś ca te ripum
svayaṃ prakṛtimāpanno yuyutsū rāma rāvaṇaḥ utthitaś cāpramattaś ca balānām anudarśane
trividhāḥ puruṣā loke uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ guṇadoṣau vadāmy aham
sa maheśvarasakhyena ślāghamānas tvayā vibho nirjitaḥ samare roṣāl lokapālo mahābalaḥ
kiṃ ca rākṣasarājasya rāmeṇāpakṛtaṃ purā ājahāra janasthānād yasya bhāryāṃ yaśasvinaḥ
śarabhas tv atha niścitya sārtham vacanam abravīt | kṣipram asmin naravyāghra cāraḥ pratividhīyatām ||
ālikhantīm ivākāśam utthitām paśya lakṣmaṇa | manaseva kṛtām laṅkām nagāgre viśvakarmaṇā ||
suvibhaktamahāvyūhā mahāvānararakṣitā | anīkinī sā vibabhau yathā dyauḥ sābhrasamplavā ||
ete sugrīvasacivāḥ kiṣkindhānilayāḥ sadā | harayo devagandharvair utpannāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ||
śatam śatasahasrāṇāṃ koṭim āhur manīṣiṇaḥ | śatam koṭisahasrāṇām śaṅkur ity abhidhīyate ||
garuḍavyūham āsthāya sarvato haribhir vṛtaḥ | mām visṛjya mahātejā laṅkām evābhivartate ||
atha suptasya rāmasya prahastena pramāthinā | asaktam kṛtahastena śiraś chinnaṃ mahāsinā ||
daṇḍanirghātavādinyāḥ śrutvā bheryā mahāsvanam | uvāca saramā sītām idam madhurabhāṣiṇī ||
nahi rājyam adharmēṇa bhōktuṃ kṣaṇam api tvayā . śakyaṃ mūrkhasahāyēna pāpēnāviditātmanā ||
sō ‘tipatya muhūrtēna śrīmān rāvaṇamandiram . dadarśāsīnam avyagraṃ rāvaṇaṃ sacivaiḥ saha ||
suṣēṇas tu mahāvīryō girikūṭōpamō hariḥ . bahubhiḥ samvṛtas tatra vānaraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ ||
tasya taṃ ratham āsthāya hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ . pramamātha talēnāśu saha tēnaiva rakṣasā ||
athavā rakṣyatāṃ rāmō yāvat saṃjñāviparyayaḥ labdhasaṃjñau hi kākutsthau bhayaṃ nau vyapanēṣyataḥ ||
tatra rāvaṇam āsādya abhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ ācacakṣē priyaṃ pitrē nihatau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
tān ārtān naṣṭasaṃjñāṃś ca gatāsūṃś ca bṛhaspatiḥ . vidyābhir mantrayuktābhir ōṣadhībhiś cikitsati ||
kō bhavān rūpasampannō divyasraganulēpanaḥ . vasānō virajē vastre divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
ētat tu vacanaṃ cōktvā mantriṇō rākṣasēśvaraḥ . uvāca nairṛtāṃs tatra samīpaparivartinaḥ ||
niṣpatantō mahōtsāhā bhinnadēhaśirōdharāḥ . rudhirōkṣitasarvāṅgā nyapatan dharaṇītalē ||
sa prahasya mahātējā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ . abhidudrāva tad rakṣaḥ kampayann iva mēdinīm ||
tataḥ sa rakṣōdhipatir mahātmā rakṣāṃsi tāny āha mahābalāni . dvārēṣu caryāgṛhagōpurēṣu sunirvṛtās tiṣṭhata nirviśaṅkāḥ ।।
draṣṭuṃ tvāṃ kāṃkṣatē rājā sarvarākṣasapuṃgavaḥ . gamanē kriyatāṃ buddhir bhrātaraṃ saṃpraharṣaya ।।
kumbhakarṇabalābhijñō jānaṃs tasya parākramam . babhūva muditō rājā śaśāṅka iva nirmalaḥ ।।
kāñcanāṅgadakēyūraniṣkābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ kumbhakarṇō bṛhatkarṇaḥ suhutō’gnir ivābabhau ।।
tē bhakṣyamāṇā harayō rāmaṃ jugmus tadā gatim . kumbhakarṇō bhṛśaṃ kruddhaḥ kapīn khādan pradhāvati ।।
sa kumbhakarṇaṃ surasainyamardanaṃ mahatsu yuddhēṣu kadācanājitam . nananda hatvā bharatāgrajō raṇē mahāsuraṃ vṛtram ivāmarādhipaḥ ।।
tē ‘tikāyaṃ samāsādya vānarā mūḍhacētasaḥ . śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmur lakṣmaṇāgrajam āhavē ।।
sarvāyudhasamāyuktō dhanvī tvaṃ rathamāsthitaḥ . śarair vā yadi vāpy astrair darśayasva parākramam ।।
indrajit tu tadā kruddhō mahātējā mahābalaḥ . vānarāṇāṃ śarīrāṇi vyadhamad rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।।
sa bhāskarādhvānam anuprapannas taṃ bhāskarābhaṃ śikharaṃ pragṛhya babhau tadā bhāskarasaṃnikāśo raveḥ samīpe pratibhāskarābhaḥ ||
prajaṅghasahitō vīrō yūpākṣas tu tatō balī . rathēnābhiyayau kruddō vāliputraṃ mahābalam ।।
aṅgadaṃ parirakṣantau maindō dvivida ēva ca . tasya tasthatur abhyāśē parasparadidṛkṣayā ।।
parigṛhya ca bāhubhyāṃ parivṛtya śirōdharām utpāṭayāmāsa śirō bhairavaṃ nadatō mahat ।।
makarākṣasya tac chrutvā vacanaṃ tē niśācarāḥ . sarvē nānāyudhōpētā balavantaḥ samāhitāḥ ।।
yācyamānaḥ subahuśo mayā hitacikīrṣuṇā vaidehīm utsṛjasveti na ca tat kṛtavān vacaḥ R_6,071.
yauvarājyaṃ ca laṅkāṃ ca rakṣāṃsi ca paraṃtapa mātaraṃ māṃ ca bhāryāś ca kva gato 'si vihāya naḥ R_6,080.
variants.b_text: यौवराज्यं च लङ्कां च रक्षांसि च परन्तप ।।6.93.13।। मातरंमां च भार्याश्चक्वगतोऽसिविहायनः ।

variants.a_text: taṃ na paśyāmahe loke yo naḥ śaraṇado bhavet rāghaveṇopasṛṣṭānāṃ kāleneva yugakṣaye R_6,082.
atha ravir avadan nirīkṣya rāmaṃ | muditamanāḥ paramaṃ prahṛṣyamāṇaḥ | niśicarapatisaṃkṣayaṃ viditvā | suragaṇamadhyagato vacas tvareti
jaghanebhyaḥ sphuliṅgāṃśca netrebhyo ‘śrūṇi saṃtatam | mumucus tasya turagās tulyam agniṃ ca vāri ca
rāvaṇadhvajam uddiśya mumoca niśitaṃ śaram | mahāsarpam ivāsahyaṃ jvalantaṃ svena tejasā
rāvaṇasya hayān rāmo hayān rāmasya rāvaṇaḥ | jaghnatus tau tadānyonyaṃ kṛtānukṛtakāriṇau
bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṃ nirjitaṃ raṇe | śokavegaparītātmā vilalāpa vibhīṣaṇaḥ
daśagrīvaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇācintyakarmaṇā | patiṃ maṇdodarī tatra kṛpaṇā paryadevayat
sītām utpalapatrākṣīṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām | avadad vai varārohāṃ madhye vānararakṣasām
prāptacāritrasaṃdehā mama pratimukhe sthitā | dīpo netrāturasyeva pratikūlāsi me dṛḍhā
evam uktā tu vaidehī paruṣaṃ romaharṣaṇam | rāghaveṇa saroṣeṇa śrutvā pravyathitābhavat
preṣitas te mahāvīro hanūmān avalokakaḥ | laṅkāsthāhaṃ tvayā rājan kiṃ tadā na visarjitā
dadṛśus tāṃ viśālākṣīṃ patantīṃ havyavāhanam | sītāṃ sarvāṇi rūpāṇi rukmavedinibhāṃ tadā
ruddhā cāntaḥpure guptā tvaccittā tvatparāyaṇā | rakṣitā rākṣasībhiś ca ghorābhir ghorabuddhibhiḥ
tārito ‘haṃ tvayā putra suputreṇa mahātmanā | aṣṭāvakreṇa dharmātmā kaholo brāhmaṇo yathā
upayānaṃ samudrasya sāgarasya ca darśanam | yathā ca kāritaḥ setū rāvaṇaśca yathā hataḥ
variants.b_text: उपयानंसमुद्रस्यसागरस्य च दर्शनम् । यथा च कारितस्सेतूरावणश्चयथाहतः ।।6.128.10।।

variants.a_text: svāgataṃ te mahābāho kausalyānandavardhana | iti prāñjalayaḥ sarve nāgarā rāmam abruvan
tato rāmābhyanujñātaṃ tad vimānam anuttamam | uttarāṃ diśam uddiśya jagāma dhanadālayam
dhuram ekākinā nyastāṃ vṛṣabheṇa balīyasā | kiśoravad guruṃ bhāraṃ na voḍhum aham utsahe
yāvad āvartate cakraṃ yāvatī ca vasuṃdharā | tāvat tvam iha lokasya svāmitvam anuvartaya
dhyātvā punar uvācedaṃ vacanaṃ raghusattamaḥ harīṇām īṣvarasyāpi sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ
variants.b_text: ध्यात्वा पुनरुवाचेदं वचनं रघुनन्दनः । हरीणामीश्वरस्यापि सुग्रीवस्योपशृण्वतः ।।6.1.15।।

variants.a_text: evam ājñāpaya kṣipraṃ balānāṃ sarvasaṃgraham muhūrtena tu yuktena prasthānam abhirocaya
vāyasāḥ saghaśaḥ krūrā vyāharanti samantataḥ samavetāśca dṛśyante vimānāgreṣu samghaśaḥ
senāpate yathā te syuḥ kṛtavidyāścaturvidhāḥ | yodhā nagararakṣāyām tathā vyādeṣṭum arhasi ||
aham utsādayiṣyāmi śatrūṃs tava niśācara | yadi śakravivasvantau yadi pāvakamārutau | tāv aham yodhayiṣyāmi kuberavaruṇāv api ||
suniviṣṭam hitaṃ vākyam uktavantam vibhīṣaṇam | abravīt paruṣam vākyam rāvaṇaḥ kālacoditaḥ ||
deśakālopapannam ca kāryam kāryavidām vara | saphalam kurute kṣipram prayogeṇābhisaṃhitam ||
samagram sāgaram tīrṇam dustaram vānaram balam | abhūtapūrvam rāmeṇa sāgare setubandhanam ||
na hy eṣa rāghavasyārthe jīvitam parirakṣati | eṣaivāśaṃsate yuddhe nihantum sarvarākṣasān ||
tam abravīt tato rājā rāvaṇo rākṣasam sthitam | vidyujjihvam mahājihvam samīpaparivartinam ||
saṃnāhajananī hy eṣā bhairavā bhīru bherikā | bherīnādam ca gambhīram śṛṇu toyadaniḥsvanam ||
rāvaṇāvaraje vākyam evam bruvati rāghavaḥ | śatrūṇām pratighātārtham idam vacanam abravīt ||
ādhirājyē ‘bhiṣēkō mē brāhmaṇaiḥ patinā saha . kṛtāntakuśalair uktaṃ tatsarvaṃ vitathīkṛtam ||
tatō dṛṣṭvā sarudhiraṃ niṣaṇṇaṃ gāḍham arpitam . bhrātaraṃ dīnavadanaṃ paryadēvayadāturaḥ ||
ēvaṃ vilapamānaṃ taṃ pariṣvajya vibhīṣaṇam . sugrīvaḥ sattvasampannō harirājō ‘bravīd idam ||
tāny auṣadhāny ānayituṃ kṣīrodaṃ yāntu sāgaram . javēna vānarāḥ śīghraṃ sampātipanasādayaḥ ||
tam āpatantaṃ dhūmrākṣō gadām udyamya vīryavān vinardamānaḥ sahasā hanūmantam abhidravat ||
tam āpatantaṃ saṃkṛddhaṃ rākṣasānāṃ bhayāvaham . dadarśākampanō vīraś cukṣōdha ca nanādaca ||
jāmbavāṃs tu susaṃkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīṃ śilām pātayāmāsa tējasvī mahānādasya vakṣasi ||
sa rāvaṇaṃ vāraṇahastabāhuṃ dadarśa bhīmōdyatadīptacāpam . pracchādayantaṃ śaravṛṣṭijālais tān vānarān bhinnavikīrṇadēhān ।।
śrutvā hanumatō vākyaṃ rāvaṇō bhīmavikramaḥ . saṃraktanayanaḥ krōdhād idaṃ vacanam abravīt ।।
rāmēṇābhinirastasya saṃgrāmē ‘smin sudāruṇē bhaviṣyati na mē śōkaḥ kumbhakarṇē vibōdhitē ।।
rākṣasāṃ tarpayiṣyāmi harīṇāṃ māṃsaśōṇitaiḥ . rāmalakṣmaṇayōś cāpi svayaṃ pāsyāmi śōṇitam ।।
tat tasya vākyaṃ bruvatō niśamya sagarvitaṃ rōṣavivṛddhadōṣam . mahōdarō nairṛtayōdhamukhyaḥ kṛtāñjalir vākyam idaṃ babhāṣē ।।
saṃpṛṣṭō rājaputrēṇa rāmēṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā . vibhīṣaṇō mahāprājñaḥ kākutstham idam abravīt ।।
vāsavasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarvalōkapitāmahaḥ . rakṣāṃsy āvāhayāmāsa kumbhakarṇaṃ dadarśa ha ।।
jvalantaṃ tējasā nityaṃ krōdhēna ca durāsadam . kas taṃ mṛtyum ivāsahyam āsādayitum arhati ।।
samālōkya tu tē rūpaṃ vidraviṣyanti vānarāḥ . rāmalakṣmaṇayōś cāpi hṛdayē prasphuṭiṣyataḥ ।।
laṅghayantaḥ pradhāvantō vānarā nāvalōkayan . kēcit samudrē patitāḥ kēcid gaganam āsthitāḥ ।।
praharṣam upanītāś ca vāliputrēṇa dhīmatā . ājñāpratīkṣās tasthuś ca sarvē vānarayūthapāḥ ।।
tataḥ parvatam utpāṭya dvividaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ dudrāva giriśṛṅgābhaṃ vilamba iva tōyadaḥ ।।
vajrahastō yathā śakraḥ pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ . śūlahastō babhau yuddhē kumbakarṇō mahābalaḥ ।।
kumbhakarṇō mahānādas trāsayan sarvavānarān . śūlaṃ sasarja vai rōṣād aṅgadē tu mahābalaḥ ।।
kumbhakarṇaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavēṇa mahātmanā . rākṣasā rākṣasēndrāya rāvaṇāya nyavēdayan ।।
hayam uccaiḥśravaḥprakhyaṃ śvētaṃ kanakabhūṣaṇam . manōjavaṃ mahākāyam ārurōha narāntakaḥ ।।
chinnavarmatanutrāṇā rākṣasā vānarair hatāḥ rudhiraṃ prasṛtās tatra rasasāram iva drumāḥ ।।
śailasaṃghātasaṃkāśō harīṇām uttamō ‘ṅgadaḥ . rarājāṅgadasaṃnaddhaḥ sadhātur iva parvataḥ ।।
athāṅgadō muṣṭiviśīrṇamūrdhā susrāva tīvraṃ rudhiraṃ bhṛśōṣṇam . muhur vijajvāla mumōha cāpi saṃjñāṃ samāsādya visiṣmiyē ca ।।
kō ‘sau parvatasaṃkāśō dhanuṣmān harilōcanaḥ . yuktē hayasahasrēṇa viśālē syandanē sthitaḥ ।।
raktakaṇṭhaguṇō dhīrō mahāparvatasannibhaḥ . kālaḥ kālamahāvaktrō mēghastha iva bhāskaraḥ ।।
paśyādya rāmaṃ saha lakṣmaṇēna madbāṇanirbhinnavikīrṇadēham . gatāyuṣaṃ bhūmitalē śayānaṃ śitaiḥ śarair ācitasarvagātram ।।
śrutvā jāmbavatō vākyam uvācēdaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ . āryaputrāv atikramya kasmāt pṛcchasi mārutim ।।
gatvā paramam adhvānam uparyupari sāgaram . himavantaṃ nagaśrēṣṭhaṃ hanuman gantum arhasi ।।
tasmin hatē bhīmaparākramēṇa plavaṅgamānām ṛṣabhēṇa yuddhē . mahī saśailā savanā cacāla bhayaṃ ca rakṣāṃsy adhikaṃ vivēśa ।।

tasmin saṃdhīyamāne tu rāghaveṇa śarottame | sarvabhūtāni saṃtresuś cacāla ca vasuṃdharā
sa rāvaṇāya saṃkruddho bhṛśam āyamya kārmukam | cikṣepa paramāyattaḥ śaraṃ marmavidāraṇam
sarvataś cābhipetus tān vānarā drumayodhinaḥ | daśagrīvavadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarā jitakāśinaḥ
mānuṣāṇām aviṣaye carataḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ | vināśas tava rāmeṇa saṃyuge nopapadyate
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maithilī janakātmajā | tataḥ śubhataraṃ vākyam uvāca pavanātmajam
yuktā rāmasya bhavatī dharmapatnī yaśasvinī | pratisaṃdiśa māṃ devi gamiṣye yatra rāghavaḥ
visṛjya śibikāṃ tasmāt padbhyām evopasarpatu | samīpe mama vaidehīṃ paśyantvete vanaukasaḥ
adhomukhaṃ sthitaṃ rāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam | upāvartata vaidehī dīpyamānaṃ hutāśanam
idānīṃ ca vijānāmi yathā saumya sureśvaraiḥ | vadhārthaṃ rāvaṇasyeha pihitaṃ puruṣottamam
evam uktas tato rāmah pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam | rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣam eva śṛṇvatām

Сто двадцать пятая песнь ayodhyāṃ tu samālokya cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ | priyakāmaḥ priyaṃ rāmas tatas tvaritavikramaḥ
cintayitvā tato dṛṣṭiṃ vānareṣu nyapātayat | uvāca dhīmāṃs tejasvī hanūmantaṃ plavaṅgamam
ayodhyāyāś ca te mārgaṃ pravṛttiṃ bharatasya ca | nivedayiṣyati prīto niṣādādhipatir guhaḥ
vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ divyaṃ samgṛhītaṃ tu rakṣasā | agamad dhanadaṃ vegād rāmavākyapracoditam
eṣa sarvasvabhūtas tu pariṣvaṅgo hanūmataḥ mayā kālam imaṃ prāpya dattas tasya mahātmanaḥ

ayaṃ paribhavo bhūyaḥ purasyāntaḥpurasya ca śrīmato rākṣasendrasya vānarendrapradharṣaṇam
purā śaratsūryamarīcisaṃnibhān navāgrapuṅkhān sudṛḍhān nṛpātmajaḥ sṛjaty amoghān viśikhān vadhāya te pradīyatāṃ dāśarathāya maithilī
tyajasva kopaṃ sukhadharmanāśanaṃ bhajasva dharmaṃ ratikīrtivardhanam prasīda jīvema saputrabāndhavāḥ pradīyatāṃ dāśarathāya maithilī
pitāmahasya bhavanaṃ gaccantīm puñjikasthalām cañcūryamāṇām adrākṣam ākāśe ‘gniśikhām iva ||

nityam anyonyasamhṛṣṭā vyasaneṣv ātatāyinaḥ | praccannahṛdayā ghorā jñātayas tu bhayāvahāḥ ||
baddhānjalipuṭaṃ dīnaṃ yācantaṃ śaraṇāgatam | na hanyād ānṛśaṃsyārtham api śatrum paraṃtapa||
baddhagodhāṅgulitraś ca avadhyakavaco yudhi | dhanurādāya yas tiṣṭhann adṛśyo bhavatīndrajit ||
evam uktas tu saumitrir abhyaṣincad vibhīṣaṇam | madhye vānaramukhyānām rājānam rāmaśāsanāt ||
tato niviṣṭām dhvajinīm sugrīveṇābhipālitām | dadarśa rākṣaso ‘bhyetya śārdūlo nāma vīryavān ||
pañcamena tathā cāhnā plavagaiḥ kṣiprakāribhiḥ | yojanāni trayoviṃśat suvelam adhikṛtya vai ||
tataḥ śuśruvur ākruṣṭam laṅkāyāṃ kānanaukasaḥ | bherīmṛdaṅgasamghuṣṭam tumulam romaharṣaṇam ||
tatas tam akṣobhyabalam laṅkādhipataye carāḥ | suvele rāghavam śaile niviṣṭam pratyavedayan ||
dīyatām abhisatkṛtya manujendrāya maithilī | nidarśanam te paryāptam janasthāne yad adbhutam ||
tam ninādam niśamyātha rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ | muhūrtam dhyānam āsthāya sacivān abhyudaikṣata ||
udyamya cānyonyam adhikṣipantau | saṃcakramāte bahu yuddhamārge | vyāyāmaśikṣābalasamprayuktau | klamaṃ na tau jagmatur āśu vīrau ||
atha tasmin nimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ sugrīvaṃ saṃpariṣvajya tathāvacanam abravīt ||
sa cintayitvā suciraṃ dhairyam ālambya rāvaṇaḥ rāghavaṃ hariyūthāṃś ca dadarśāyatalōcanaḥ ||
gōlāṅgūlō mahākāyō gavākṣō bhīmadarśanaḥ . vṛtaḥ kōṭyā mahāvīryas tasthau rāmasya pārśvataḥ ||
ētasminn antarē tēṣām anyōnyam abhidhāvatām . rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca dvandvayuddham avartata ||
vānarēndras tu sugrīvaḥ praghasēna samāgataḥ . saṅgataḥ samare śrīmān virūpākṣēṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ ||
jambumālī rathasthas tu rathaśaktyā mahābalaḥ . bibēda samarē kruddhō hanūmantaṃ stanāntarē ||
gōlāṅgūlēśvaraṃ caiva vāliputram athāṅgadam vivyādha bahubhir bāṇais tvaramāṇō ‘tha rāvaṇiḥ ||
samāśvāsya tu sugrīvaṃ rākṣasēndrō vibhīṣaṇaḥ vidrutaṃ vānarānīkaṃ tat samāśvāsayat punaḥ ||
śaranirbhinnagātrās tē śūlanirbhinnadēhinaḥ . jagṛhus tē drumāṃs tatra śilāś ca hariyūthapāḥ ||
vajradaṅṣṭraṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā bhayamōhitāḥ trastā hy abhyadravaṃl laṅkāṃ vadhyamānāḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ viṣaṇṇavadanā dīnā hriyā kiñcid avāṅmukhāḥ ||
vyabhram ākāśam āviśya māṃsaśōṇitabhōjanāḥ maṇḍalāny apasavyāni khagāś cakrū rathaṃ prati ||
tam āpatantaṃ sahasā samīkṣya dīptēṣucāpaṃ yudhi rākṣasēndram . mahat samutpāṭya mahīdharāgraṃ dudrāva rakṣōdhipatiṃ harīśaḥ ।।
tac chailaśṛṅgaṃ bahuvṛkṣasānuṃ pragṛhya cikṣēpa niśācarāya . tam āpatantaṃ sahasā samīkṣya cicchēda bāṇais tapanīyapuṅkhaiḥ ।।
rāvaṇō hi mahāvīryō raṇē ‘dbhutaparākramaḥ . trailōkyēnāpi saṃkruddhō duṣprasahyō na saṃśayaḥ ।।
tam āha saumitrir avismayānō garjantam udvṛttasitāgradaṃṣṭram . rājan na garjanti mahāprabhāvā vikatthasē pāpakṛtāṃ variṣṭha ।।
ēvaṃ bruvāṇaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ kumbhakarṇam ariṃdamam . yūpākṣaḥ sacivō rājñaḥ kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata ।।
yēna vaivasvatō yuddhē vāsavaś ca parājitaḥ . saiṣa viśravasaḥ putraḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ pratāpavān asya pramāṇasadṛśō rākṣasā ‘nyō na vidyatē ।।
śūlapāṇiṃ virūpākṣaṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam . hantuṃ na śēkus tridaśāḥ kālō ‘yam iti mōhitāḥ ।।
rākṣasānāṃ sahasraiś ca vṛtaḥ paramadurjayaḥ . gṛhēbhyaḥ puṣpavarṣēṇa kīryamāṇas tadā yayau ।।
ēvam uktavatō vākyaṃ kumbhakarṇasya dhīmataḥ . pratyuvāca tatō vākyaṃ prahasan rākṣasādhipaḥ ।।
ēvaṃ tasya bruvāṇasya kumbhakarṇasya rākṣasaḥ . nādaṃ cakrur mahāghōraṃ kampayanta ivārṇavam ।।
anēkaśō vadhyamānāḥ kumbhakarṇēna vānarāḥ . rāghavaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmur vyathitā bhinnacētasaḥ ।।
atha dāśarathīṃ rāmō raudram astraṃ prayōjayan . kumbhakarṇasya hṛdayē sasarja niśitāñ śarān ।।
athādadē sūryamarīcikalpaṃ sa brahmadaṇḍāntakakālakalpam . ariṣṭam aindraṃ niśitaṃ supuṅkhaṃ rāmaḥ śaraṃ mārutatulyavēgam ।।
hā vīra ripudarpaghna kumbhakarṇa mahābala . tvaṃ māṃ vihāya vai daivād yātō ‘si yamasādanam ।।
narāntakaḥ krōdhavaśaṃ jagāma hataṃ turaṅgaṃ patitaṃ nirīkṣya . sa muṣṭim udyamya mahāprabhāvō jaghāna śīrṣē yudhi vāliputram ।।
triśirās taṃ pracicchēda śarair āśīviṣōpamaiḥ . sa vṛkṣaṃ kṛttam ālōkya utpapāta tadāṅgadaḥ ।।
taṃ purastāt sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vānaraṃ parvatōpamam . ājaghānōrasi kruddhō gadayā vajrakalpayā ।।
tat sainyaṃ harivīrāṇāṃ trāsayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ . mṛgayūtham iva kruddhō harir yauvanadarpitaḥ ।।
tatas tad astraṃ cikṣēpa lakṣmaṇāya niśācaraḥ . vāyavyēna tad astrēṇa nijaghāna sa lakṣmaṇaḥ ।।
imāṃ pratijñāṃ śṛṇu śakraśatrōḥ suniścitāṃ pauruṣadaivayuktām adyaiva rāmaṃ saha lakṣmaṇēna saṃtarpayiṣyāmi śarair amōghaiḥ ।।
tasmin sampīḍyamānē tu bhagnadrumaśilātalē . na śēkur vānarāḥ sthātuṃ ghūrṇamānē nagōttamē ।।
taṃ pragṛhya mahākhaḍagaṃ vinadya ca punaḥ punaḥ . vāliputrō ‘bhidudrāva raṇaśīrṣē parān arīn ।।
naiva jyātalanirghoṣo na ca nemikhurasvanaḥ śuśruve caratas tasya na ca rūpaṃ prakāśate R_6,067.

adṛśyamānēna raṇē māyayā vāsavōpamau . mama nāthāv anāthāyā nihatau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
gajāṃś ca sagajārōhān sarathān rathinas tathā . jaghāna hanumān bhīmān rākṣasāṃś ca padātigān ||
tam antakam iva kruddhaṃ sadrumaṃ prāṇahāriṇam . hanūmantam abhiprēkṣya rākṣasā vipradudruvuḥ ||
nēdur āsphōṭayāmāsuś cikṣipus tē niśācarāḥ kumbhakarṇavibōdhārthaṃ cakrus tē vipulaṃ svanam ।।
tataḥ parihitā gāḍhaṃ rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ . mṛdaṃgapaṇavān bhērīḥ śaṅkhakumbhagaṇāṃs tathā ।।
sa pātyamānair giriśṛṅgavṛkṣair acintayaṃs tān vipulān prahārān . nidrākṣayāt kṣudbhayapīḍitaś ca vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ sahasōtpapāpa ।।
sa kumbhakarṇō hṛtakarṇanāsō vidāritas tēna radair nakhaiś ca . rōṣābhibhūtaḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ sugrīvam āvidhya pipēṣa bhūmau ।।

bubhukṣitaḥ śōṇaitamāṃsagṛdhnuḥ pravivya tad vānarasainyam ugram . cakhāda rakṣāṃsi harīn piśācān ṛkṣāṃś ca mōhād yudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ . yathaiva mṛtyur haratē yugāntē sa bhakṣyāmāsa harīṃś ca mukhyān ।।
variants.b_text: बुभुक्षितःशोणइतमांसगृध्नुःप्रविव्यतद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम् । चखादरक्षांसिहरीन् पिशाचान् ऋक्षांश्चमोहाद्युधिकुम्भकर्णः । यथैवमृत्युर्हरतेयुगान्ते स भक्ष्यामासहरींश्चमुख्यान् ।।6.67.95।।

variants.a_text: kumbhakarṇaśirō bhāti kuṇḍalālaṃkṛtaṃ mahat . ādityē ‘bhyuditē rātrau madhyastha iva candramāḥ ।।
tasmin hatē bhrātari rāvaṇasya tan nairṛtānāṃ balam arṇavābham . tyaktāyudhaṃ kēvalajīvitārthaṃ dudrāva bhinnārṇavasaṃnikāśam ।।
śaśāsa caiva tān sarvān rākṣasān sa mahābalān . rākṣasā gacchatādyaiva siṃhanādaṃ ca nādayan ।।
variants.b_text: शशासचैवतान् सर्वान्राक्षसान् सुमहाबलान् । राक्षसागच्छताद्यैवसिंहनादं च नादयन् ।।6.75.49।।

variants.a_text: tatovāca prahasyaitān rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ mahodaramahāpārśvau virūpākṣaṃ ca rākṣasaṃ R_6,083.
taptacāmīkarābhāya haraye viśvakarmaṇe | namas tamobhinighnāya rucaye lokasākṣiṇe
tataḥ pravṛttaṃ sukrūraṃ rāmarāvaṇayos tadā | sumahad dvairathaṃ yuddhaṃ sarvalokabhayāvaham
anujnāpya mahārājam imaṃ saumya vibhīṣaṇam | praviśya nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ kauśalaṃ brūhi maithilīm
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma tavāsmākaṃ nararṣabha | prītiyuktāḥ sma tena tvaṃ brūhi yanmanasepsitam
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ | mahendrah pratyuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ prītisaṃyutam
taṃ vinā kaikayīputram bharataṃ dharmacāriṇam | na me snānaṃ bahumataṃ vastrāṇy abharaṇāni ca
Сто двадцать четвертая песнь pūrṇe caturdaśe varṣe pañcamyāṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ | bharadvājāśramaṃ prāpya vavande niyato munim
mahābalā mahāvīryās tapaso vighnakāriṇaḥ | nihatā rāghaveṇājau daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ
sarvam evābhiṣekārthaṃ jayārhasya mahātmanaḥ | kartum arhatha rāmasya yad yan maṅgalapūrvakam
āyuṣyam ārogyakaraṃ yaśasyaṃ | saubhrātṛkaṃ buddhikaraṃ śubhaṃ ca | śrotavyam etan niyamena sadbhir | ākhyānam ojaskaram ṛddhikāmaiḥ
tān gṛhītāyudhān sarvān vārayitvā vibhīṣaṇaḥ abravīt prāñjalir vākyaṃ punaḥ pratyupaveśya tān
brāhmeṇāstreṇa samyojya brahmadaṇḍanibham śaram | samyojya dhanuṣi śreṣṭhe vicakarṣa mahābalaḥ ||
ripūṇām pratikūlānām yuddhārtham abhivartatām | ubhābhyām sadṛśam nāma vaktum aprastave stavam ||
hā hatāsmi mahābāho vīravratamanuvrata | imām te paścimāvasthām gatāsmi vidhavā kṛtā ||
tām ratnapūrṇām bahusaṃvidhānām | prāsādamālābhir alamkṛtām ca | purīm mahāyantrakavāṭamukhyām | dadarśa rāmo mahatā balena ||
paśyatāṃ vānarendrāṇām rāghavasyāpi paśyataḥ | darśanād rākṣasendrasya sugrīvaḥ sahasotthitaḥ ||
hantāsmi tvāṃ sahāmātyaṃ saputrajñātibāndhavam . nirudvignās trayo lōkā bhaviṣyanti hate tvayi ||
ity ēvaṃ paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ bruvāṇē haripuṅgavē . amarṣavaśam āpanno niśācaragaṇēśvaraḥ ||
atra sā mṛgaśāvākṣī matkṛtē janakātmajā pīḍyatē śōkasantaptā kṛśā sthaṇḍilaśāyinī ||
āplavantaḥ plavantaś ca garjantaś ca plavaṅgamāḥ . laṅkāṃ tām abhidhāvanti mahāvāraṇasaṃnibhāḥ ||
sā babhūva niśā ghōrā harirākṣasahāriṇī kālarātrīva bhūtānāṃ sarvēṣāṃ duratikramā ||
tam uvāca mahātējā vainatēyō mahābalaḥ . patattirājaḥ prītātmā harṣaparyākulēkṣaṇaḥ ||
viṣaṇṇavadanā bhūyō viprakīrṇaśirōruhāḥ . mūḍhāḥ śōṇitagandhēna nipētur dharaṇītalē ||
ētān autpātikān dṛṣṭvā vajradaṃṣṭrō mahābalaḥ . dhairyam ālambhya tējasvī nirjagāma raṇōtsukaḥ ||
śarair vidārayāmāsa kaṅkapatrair ajihmagaiḥ . bibhēda vānarāṃs tatra saptāṣṭau nava pañca ca vivyādha paramakruddhō vajradaṅṣṭraḥ pratāpavān ||
tatō harigaṇān bhagnān dṛṣṭvā vālisutas tadā krōdhēna vajradaṅṣṭraṃ tam udīkṣantam udaikṣata ||
sa ēvam uktvā jvalanaprakāśaṃ rathaṃ turaṃgōttamarājiyuktam . prakāśamānaṃ vapuṣā jvalantaṃ samārurōhāmararājaśatruḥ ।।
rāvaṇō ‘pi mahātējāḥ kapilāghavavismitaḥ . astram āhārayāmāsa dīptam āgnēyam adbhutam ।।
sa praviśya purīṃ laṅkāṃ rāmabāṇabhayārdhitaḥ . bhagnadarpas tadā rājā babhūva vyathitēndriyaḥ ।।
śṛṇu rājann avahitō mama vākyam ariṃdama alaṃ rākṣasarājēndra saṃtāpam upapadya tē . rōṣaṃ ca samparityajya svasthō bhavitum arhasi ।।
variants.b_text: शृणुराजन्नवहितोममवाक्यमरिन्दम ।।6.63.30।। अलंराक्षसराजेन्द्र सन्तापमुपपद्यते । रोषं च सम्परित्यज्यस्वस्थोभवितुमर्हसि ।।6.63.31।।

variants.a_text: sa puṣpavarṣair avakīryamāṇō dhṛtātapatraḥ śitaśūlapāṇiḥ . madōtkaṭaḥ śōṇitagandhamattō viniryayau dānavadēvaśatruḥ ।।
saṃnipatya ca rakṣāṃsi dagdhaśailōpamo mahān . kumbhakarṇō mahāvaktraḥ prahasann idam abravīt ।।
ulkāśaniyutā mēghā babhūvur gardabhāruṇāḥ . sasāgaravanā caiva vasudhā samakampata ।।
prāṃśubhir giriśṛṅgaiś ca śilābhiś ca mahābalaḥ . pādapaiḥ puṣpitāgraiś ca hanyamānō na kampatē ।।
tān samīkṣyāṅgadō bhagnān vānarān idam abravīt avatiṣṭhata yudhyāmō nivartadhvaṃ plavaṅgamāḥ ।।
na kumbhakarṇaḥ kākutsthaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvan gamiṣyati . dīpyamānam ivāsādya pataṅgō jvalanaṃ yathā ।।
tad rāmabāṇābhihataṃ papāta rakṣaḥśiraḥ parvatasannikāśam . babhañja caryāgṛhagōpurāṇi prākāram uccaṃ tam apātayac ca ।।
divaḥ kṣiptām ivōlkāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ kṣiptām asaṃgatām . gṛhītvā hariśārdūlō babhañja ca nanāda ca ।।
sā tasya raudrā samupētya dēhaṃ raudrasya dēvādhvaravipraśatrōḥ . bibhēda vakṣaḥ kṣatajaṃ ca bhūri susrāva dhātvambha ivādrirājaḥ ।।
ētēna śataśō dēvādānavāś ca parājitāḥ . rakṣitāni ca rakṣāṃsi yakṣāś cāpi niṣūditāḥ ।।
sukhaprasuptaṃ kālāgniṃ vibōdhayitum icchasi . nyasya cāpaṃ nivartasva mā prāṇān jahi madgataḥ ।।
tāñ śarān yudhi samprēkṣya nikṛttān rāvaṇātmajaḥ cukōpa tridaśēndrārir jagrāha niśitaṃ śaram ।।
teṣāṃ gṛhasahasrāṇi dadāha hutabhuk tadā prāsādāḥ parvatākārāḥ patanti dharaṇītalē ।।
tam āpatantaṃ samprēkṣya yūpākṣaṃ dvividas tvaran . ājaghānōrasi kruddhō jagrāha ca balād balī ।।
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā balādhyakṣō niśācaraḥ . syandanaṃ ca balaṃ caiva samīpaṃ pratyapādayat .
sugrīve sa śarān ghorān visasarja camūmukhe sthāpayām āsā codvignān rākṣasān saṃpraharṣayan R_6,084.
sphurantaṃ parivartantaṃ pārśvena rudhirokṣitam karuṇaṃ ca vinardāntaṃ dadṛśuḥ kapayo ripum R_6,084.
sa śarair bhinnasarvāṅgo gātraprasrutaśoṇitaḥ rākṣasendrasamūhasthaḥ phullāśoka ivābabhau R_6,091.
namaḥ pūrvāya giraye paścimāyādraye namaḥ | jyotirgaṇānāṃ pataye dinādhipataye namaḥ
tumulaṃ trāsajananaṃ bhīmaṃ bhīmapratisvanam | tad varṣam abhavad yuddhe naikaśastramayaṃ mahat
tasyaiva sadṛśaṃ cānyad rāvaṇasyotthitaṃ śiraḥ | tat kṣiptaṃ kṣiprahastena rāmeṇa kṣiprakāriṇā
dvitīyaṃ rāvaṇaśiraś chinnaṃ saṃyati sāyakaiḥ | chinnamātraṃ ca tacchīrṣaṃ punar eva pradrśyate
yasya vājeṣu pavanaḥ phale pāvakabhāskarau | śarīram ākāśamayaṃ gaurave merumandarau
sa vajra iva durdharṣo vajribāhuvisarjitaḥ | kṛtānta iva cāvāryo nyapatad rāvaṇorasi
āviveśa mahān harṣo devānāṃ cāraṇaiḥ saha | rāvane nihate raudre sarvalokabhayaṃkare
vānarāṇām vināśo ‘yaṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca te raṇe | tava caiva mahābāho daivayogād upāgataḥ
tato lakṣmaṇasugrīvau hanūmāṃśca plavaṅgamaḥ | niśamya vākyaṃ rāmasya babhūvur vyathitā bhṛśam
bhavān nārāyaṇo devaḥ śrīmāṃś cakrāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ | ekaśṛṅgo varāhas tvaṃ bhūtabhavyasapatnajit
nivṛttavanavāso ‘si pratijñā pūritā tvayā | rāvaṇaṃ ca raṇe hatvā devatāḥ paritoṣitāḥ
evam uktas tu kākutsthaḥ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam | harīn sugrīvamukhyāṃs tvaṃ snānenopanimantraya
varadānaṃ mahendreṇa brahmaṇā varuṇena ca | mahādevaprasādācca pitrā mama samāgamam
pañcamīm adya rajanīm uṣitvā vacanān muneḥ | bharadvājābhyanujñātaṃ drakṣyasy adyaiva rāghavam
rāghavasya harīṇāṃ ca katham āsīt samāgamaḥ | kasmin deśe kim āśritya tattvam ākhyāhi pṛcchataḥ
bharatāśramam āsādya sasainyo rāghavas tadā | avatīrya vimānāgrād avatasthe mahītale
dṛṣṭvā sarve mahātmānas tatas te vānararṣabhāḥ | visṛṣṭāḥ pārthivendreṇa kiṣkindhāṃ samupāgaman
rāghavaścāpi dharmātmā prāpya rājyam anuttamam | īje bahuvidhair yajñaiḥ sasutabhrātṛbāndhavaḥ
dūṣayeyur durātmānaḥ pathi mūlaphalodakam rākṣasāḥ pathi rakṣethās tebhyas tvaṃ nityam udyataḥ
variants.b_text: दूषयेयुर्दुरात्मनः पथि मूलफलोदकम् । राक्षसाः परिरक्षेथास्तेभ्यस्त्वं नित्यमुद्यतः ।।6.4.11।।

variants.a_text: matimadbhir mahāmātrair anuraktair adhiṣṭhitam rākṣasair āptaparyāptaih sarvataḥ parirakṣitam
mocito rāmavākyena vānaraiś ca nipīḍitaḥ | śukaḥ paramasamtrasto rakṣodhipam upāgamat ||
aham dāśarathenoḍhā mohāt svakulapāṃsanī | āryaputrasya rāmasya bhāryā mṛtyur ajāyata ||
rāmas tu bahubhir hṛṣṭair ninadadbhiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ . vṛto ripuvadhākāṅkṣī yuddhāyaivābhyavartata ||
vīraḥ pratapanō ghōrō rākṣasō raṇadurdharaḥ samare tīkṣṇavēgēna naḷēna samayudhyata ||
imau tau sattvasampannau vikrāntau priyasamyugau . imam avasthāṃ gamitau rākṣasaiḥ kūṭayōdhibhiḥ ||
rāvaṇēnaiva muktas tu prahastō vāhinīpatiḥ rākṣasēndram uvācēdam asurēndram ivōśanā ||
vānaraiś cāpi saṃkruddhai rākṣasaughāḥ samantataḥ pādapair giriśṛṅgaiś ca saṃpiṣṭā vasudhātalē ||
yaś caiṣa cāpāsiśaraughajuṣṭaṃ patākinaṃ pāvakadīptarūpam . rathaṃ samāsthāya vibhāty udagrō narāntakō ‘sau nagaśṛṅgayōdhī ।।
tē tu tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasēndrasya rākṣasāḥ jagmuḥ paramasambhrāntāḥ kumbhakarṇanivēśanam ।।
anyē ca balinas tasya kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ mūrdhni vakṣasi gātrēṣu pātan kūṭamudgarān ।।
tad uktam atikāyasya balinō bāhuśālināḥ kumbhakarṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvōvāca mahōdaraḥ ।।
tāṃs tu vipradrutān dṛṣṭvā rājaputrō ‘ṅgadō ‘bravīt . nalaṃ nīlaṃ gavākṣaṃ ca kumudaṃ ca mahābalam ।।
variants.b_text: तांस्तुविप्रद्रुतान् दृष्टवाराजपुत्रोऽङ्गदोऽब्रवीत् । नलंनीलंगवाक्षं च कुमुदं च महाबलम् ।।6.66.4।।

variants.a_text: sa kumbhakarṇaṃ kupitō jaghāna vēgēna śailōttamabhīmakāyam . saṃcakṣubhē tēna tadābhibhūtō mēdārdragātrō rudhirāvasiktaḥ ।।
ēkaṃ dvau trīn bahūn kruddhō vānarān saha rākṣasaiḥ . samādāyaikahastēna pracikṣēpa tvaran mukhē ।।
sarvān samabhidhāvantaṃ yathāruṣṭaṃ diśāgajam . mārgamāṇaṃ harīn kruddhaṃ rākṣasaiḥ parivāritam ।।
sa tanmahāparvatakūṭasaṃnibhaṃ vivṛttadaṃṣṭraṃ calacārukuṇḍalam . cakarta rakṣōdhipatēḥ śiras tadā yathaiva vṛtrasya purā puraṃdaraḥ ।।
yady ahaṃ bhrātṛhantāraṃ na hanmi yudhi rāghavam . nanu mē maraṇaṃ śrēyō na cēdaṃ vyarthajīvitam ।।
variants.b_text: यद्यहंभ्रातृहन्तारं न हन्मियुधिराघवम् । ननुमेमरणंश्रेयो न चेदंव्यर्थजीवितम् ।।6.68.18।।

variants.a_text: muhūrtam āsīt sa gatāsukalpaḥ pratyāgatātmā sahasā surāriḥ . utpatya saṃdhyābhrasamānavarṇas taṃ vārirājātmajam ājaghāna ।।
kṣaumaṃ ca dahyatē tatra kauśēyaṃ cāpi śōbhanam āvikaṃ vividhaṃ caurṇaṃ kāñcanaṃ bhāṇḍamāyudham ।।
saṃdhāya cānyaṃ sumukhaṃ śaram āśīviṣōpamam . ājaghāna mahātējā vakṣasi dvividāgrajam ।।
sa tathābhihatas tēna hanumān plavagōttamaḥ muṣṭiṃ samvartayāmāsa balēnātimahābalaḥ ।।
nidarśayitvātmabalaṃ samudyataṃ kuruṣva sarvāyudhasāyakavyayam na lakṣmaṇasyaitya hi bāṇagocaraṃ tvam adya jīvan sabalo gamiṣyasi R_6,074.
śāntaraśmir ivādityo nirvāṇa iva pāvakaḥ babhūva sa mahābāhur vyapāstagatajīvitaḥ R_6,078.
saṃdhyayā cāvṛtā laṅkā japāpuṣpanikāśayā | dṛśyate sampradīpteva divase ‘pi vasuṃdharā
nipapātāntarikṣāc ca puṣpavṛṣṭis tadā bhuvi | kirantī raghavarathaṃ duravāpā manoharā
parākramotsāhavijṛmbhitārcir | niḥśvāsadhūmaḥ svabalapratāpaḥ | pratāpavān saṃyati rākṣasāgnir | nirvāpito rāmapayodhareṇa
iti pratisamādiṣṭo hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ | praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ
laṅghanaṃ ca samudrasya laṅkāyāś cāpi mardanam | saphalaṃ tasya ca ślāghyam adya karma hanūmataḥ
variants.b_text: लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्यलङ्कायाश्चापिमर्धनम् । सफलंतस्य च श्लाघ्यमद्यकर्महनूमतः ।।6.118.7।।

variants.a_text: indrakarmā mahendras tvaṃ padmanābho raṇāntakṛt | śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇam ca tvām ahur divyā maharṣayaḥ
abhivādya ca kākutsthaḥ sarvāṃs tāṃs tridaśottamān | lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vāsam ājñāpayat tadā
sahāmībhis tvayā laṅkā nirjitā rākṣaseśvara | hṛṣṭaiḥ prāṇabhayaṃ tyaktvā saṃgrāmeṣv anivartibhiḥ
haraṇaṃ cāpi vaidehyā rāvaṇena balīyasā | sugrīveṇa ca saṃvādaṃ vālinaśca vadhaṃ raṇe
tūryasaṃghātanirghoṣaiḥ kāñcīnūpuraniḥsvanaiḥ | madhurair gītaśabdaiś ca pratibudhyasva śeṣva ca
sā nūnam asitāpāṅgī rakṣomadhyagatā satī mannāthā nāthahīneva trātāraṃ nādhigacchati
adya rāmaṃ sasugrīvaṃ parigheṇa salakṣmaṇam āgamiṣyāmi hatvaiko vikṣobhya harivāhinīm
gandharvāṇām ivāvāsam ālayam marutām iva ratnasaṃcayasambādham bhavanaṃ bhoginām iva
niśācarendrasya niśamya vākyam | sa kumbhakarṇasya ca garjitāni | vibhīṣaṇo rākṣasarājamukhyam | uvāca vākyam hitamarthayuktam ||
balam cākāśamāvṛtya sarvato daśayojanam | tattvabhūtam mahāraja kṣipram veditumarhasi ||
ugradarśanakarmāṇo bahavas tatra dasyavaḥ | ābhīrapramukhāḥ pāpāḥ pibanti salilam mama ||
iti pratisamādiṣṭau rākṣasau śukasāraṇau | harirūpadharau vīrau praviṣṭau vānaram balam ||
bahūni vānarendrāṇām eṣa yūthāni vīryavān | parigṛhyābhiyāti tvām svenānīkena marditum ||
evam vidhānam lankāyām kṛtvā rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ | kṛtakṛtyam ivātmānam manyate kālacoditaḥ ||
raktacandanasaṃkāśā saṃdhyā paramadāruṇā . jvalac ca nipataty ētad ādityād agnimaṇḍalam ||
saṃnahya tu sasugrīvaḥ kapirājabalaṃ mahat . kālajñō rāghavaḥ kale saṃyugāyābhyacōdayat ||
tad rāmavacanaṃ sarvam anyūnādhikam uttamam . sāmātyaṃ śrāvayāmāsa nivēdyātmānam ātmanā ||
tataḥ krōdhasamāviṣṭaḥ suṣēṇō haripuṃgavaḥ śilāṃ sumahatīṃ gṛhya niśācaram abhidravat ||
tau vīraśayanē vīrau śayānau rudhirōkṣitau . śaravēṣṭitasarvāṅgav ārtau paramapīḍitau ||
nirviśaṅkā nirudvignā nirapēkṣā ca maithilī mām upasthāsyatē sītā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
tataḥ puṣpakam ādāya rākṣasyō rāvaṇājñayā aśōkavanikāsthāṃ tāṃ maithilīṃ samupānayan ||
prāyēṇa gatasattvānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ gatāyuṣām . dṛśyamānēṣu vaktrēṣu paraṃ bhavati vaikṛtam ||
tān mṛtyuvaśamāpannān akampanavaśagatān . samīkṣya hanumāñ jñātīn upatasthē mahābalaḥ ||
sō ‘śvakarṇaṃ samāsādya rōṣadarpānvitō hariḥ . tūrṇam utpāṭayāmāsa mahāgirim ivōcchritam ||
tasmin pravṛddhōttamasānuvṛkṣē śṛṅgē vidīrṇē patitē pṛthivyām . mahāhikalpaṃ śaram antakābhaṃ samādadhē rākṣasalōkanāthaḥ ।।
sa tathōktas tu nirbhartsya kumbhakarṇō mahōdaram . abravīd rākṣasaśrēṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ rāvaṇaṃ tataḥ ।।
ēvam uktvā mahātējāḥ kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam . punarjātam ivātmānaṃ mēnē rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ ।।
aṅgadāny aṅgulīveṣṭān varāṇy ābharaṇāni ca hāraṃ ca śaśisaṃkāśam ābabandha mahātmanaḥ ।।
nāparādhyanti mē kāmaṃ vānarāḥ vanacāriṇaḥ . jātir asmadvidhānāṃ sā purōdyānavibhūṣaṇam ।।
mēdōvasāśōṇitadigdhagātraḥ karnāvasaktagrathitāntramālaḥ . vavarṣa śūlāni satīkṣaṇadaṃṣṭraḥ kālō yugāntastha iva vṛddhaḥ ।।
antakasyāpy akaṣṭēna yudhi jētāram āhavē . yudhyatā mām abhītēna khyāpitā vīratā tvayā ।।
ēvaṃ vilapamānasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ . śrutvā śōkābhitaptasya triśirā vākyam abravīt ।।
śrutvā triśirasō vākyaṃ rāvaṇō rākṣasādhipaḥ . punarjātam ivātmānaṃ manyatē kālacōditaḥ ।।
sarvauṣadhībhir gandhaiś ca samālabhya mahābalāḥ . nirjagmur nairṛtaśrēṣṭhā ṣaḍ ētē yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।।
narāntakaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā cukruśur nairṛtarṣabhāḥ . dēvāntakas trimūrdhā ca paulastyaś ca mahōdaraḥ ।।
tatō ‘tikāyō balavān praviśya harivāhinīm . viṣphārayāmāsa dhanur nanāda ca punaḥ punaḥ ।।
tam āpatantaṃ niśitaṃ śaram āśīviṣōpamam ardhacandrēṇa cicchēda lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।।
[atibalam atikāyam abhrakalpaṃ yudhi vinipātya sa lakṣmaṇaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ . tvaritam atha tadā sa rāmapārśvaṃ kapinivahaiś ca supūjitō jagāma ।।
variants.b_text: अतिबलमतिकायमभ्रकल्पंयुधिविनिपात्य स लक्ष्मणःप्रहृष्टः । त्वरितमथतदा स रामपार्श्वंकपिनिवहैश्चसुपूजितोजगाम ।।6.71.116।।

variants.a_text: sa ēvam uktvā tridaśēndraśatrur āpṛcchya rājānam adīnasattvaḥ . samārurōhānilatulyavēgaṃ rathaṃ kharaśrēṣṭhasamādhiyuktam ।।
svayambhuvā dattavarō mahātmā samāhitō ‘ntarhitabhīmakāyaḥ . kathaṃ nu śakyō yudhi naṣṭadēhō nihantum adyēndrajid udyatāstraḥ ।।
tatō viṣaṇṇaṃ samavēkṣya sainyaṃ vibhīṣaṇō buddhimatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ . uvāca śākhamṛgarājavīrān āśvāsayann apratimair vacōbhiḥ ।।
tam abhyāśagataṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarēndrō mahābalaḥ . ājaghānāśvakarṇēna drumēṇātibalas tadā ।।
parighōpamabāhus tu parighaṃ bhāskaraprabham balī balavatas tasya pātayāmāsa vakṣasi ।।
ghanāndhakāre timire śaravarṣam ivādbhutam sa vavarṣa mahābāhur nārācaśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ R_6,067.
bhūtānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca jaṅgamānāṃ ca darśanam yathāsti na tathā dharmas tena nāstīti me matiḥ R_6,070.
variants.b_text: भूतानांस्थावाराणां च जङ्गमानां च दर्शनम् । यथास्ति न तथाधर्मस्तेननास्तीतिमेमतिः ।।6.83.15।।

variants.a_text: sō ‘tividdhō balavatā śatruṇā śatrughātinā . asaktaṃ prēṣayāmāsa lakṣmaṇāya bahūñ śarān ।।
vyākośapadmavaktrāṇi padmakesaravarcasām adya yūthataṭākāni gajavat pramathāmy aham R_6,083.
na bhīto 'smi na mūḍho 'smi nopajapto 'smi śatrubhiḥ na pramatto na niḥsneho vismṛtā na ca satkriyā R_6,093.
variants.b_text: न भीतोऽस्मि न मूढोऽस्मिनोपजप्तोऽस्मिशत्रुभिः । न प्रमत्तो न निःस्नेहोविस्मृता न च सत्क्रिया ।।6.106.11।।

variants.a_text: nakṣatragrahatārāṇām adhipo viśvabhāvanaḥ | tejasāmapi tejasvī dvādaśātman namo ‘stu te
pūjayasvainam ekāgro devadevaṃ jagatpatim | etat triguṇitaṃ japtvā yuddheṣu vijayiṣyasi
etacchrutvā mahātejā naṣṭaśoko ‘bhavat tadā | dhārayāmāsa suprīto rāghavaḥ prayatātmavān
rāvaṇaśca yatas tatra pracacāla vasuṃdharā | rakṣasāṃ ca praharatāṃ gṛhītā iva bāhavaḥ
te śarās tam anāsādya purandararathadhvajam | rathaśaktiṃ parāmṛśya nipetur dharaṇītale
arditā vānarair bhraṣṭā laṅkām abhyapatan bhayāt | hatāśrayatvāt karuṇair bāṣpaprasravaṇair mukhaiḥ
dadṛśus tā mahākāyaṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahadyutim | rāvaṇaṃ nihataṃ bhūmau nīlāñjanacayopamam
vilepur evaṃ dīnās tā rākṣasādhipayoṣitaḥ | kurarya iva duḥkhārtā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ
tataḥ sahastābharaṇān pragṛhya vipulān bhujān | abruvaṃs tridaśaśreṣṭhā rāghavaṃ prāñjaliṃ sthitam
dharmaṃ prāpsyasi dharmajña yaśaś ca vipulaṃ bhuvi | rāme prasanne svargaṃ ca mahimānaṃ tathottamam
evamukto mahendreṇa prasannena mahātmanā | suprasannamanā hṛṣṭo vacanam prāha rāghavaḥ
akāle puṣpaśabalāḥ phalavantaś ca pādapāḥ | bhaviṣyanti maheṣvāsa nadyaś ca salilāyutāḥ
nava nāgasahasrāṇi yayur āsthāya vānarāḥ | mānuṣaṃ vigrahaṃ kṛtvā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
kānanāni vicitrāṇi nadīprasravaṇāni ca paśyann api yayau rāmaḥ sahyasya malayasya ca
variants.b_text: काननानि विचित्राणि नदी: प्रस्रवणानि च । पश्यन्ननि ययौ रामस्सह्यस्य मलयस्य च ।।6.4.73।।

variants.a_text: sarvāṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ saśailavanakānanām karomy avānarāṃ bhūmim ājñāpayatu māṃ bhavān
sa rāvaṇam mahātmānam vijane mantrisamnidhau uvāca hitamatyartham vacanam hetuniścitam
sā purī paramākīrṇā rathakuñjaravājibhiḥ sampatadbhir viruruce garutmadbhir ivāmabaram
tasya kāmaparītasya niśamya paridevitam | kumbhakarṇaḥ pracukrodha vacanam cedam abravīt ||
te jvalanto mahāvegās tejasā sāyakottamāḥ | praviśanti samudrasya salilam trastapannagam ||
rākṣasānām balaughasya vānarendrabalasya ca | naitayor vidyate saṃdhir devadānavayor iva ||
te suvelasya śailasya samīpe rāmalakṣmaṇau | pracchannā dadṛśur gatvā sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇau ||
vidyujjihvam ca māyājñam abravīd rākṣasādhipaḥ | mohayiṣyāvahe sītām māyayā janakātmajām ||
evam lālapyamānāyām sītāyām tatra rākṣasaḥ | abhicakrāma bhartāram anīkasthaḥ kṛtānjaliḥ ||
vijayasvāryaputreti so’bhivādya prasādya ca | nyavedayad anuprāptam prahastam vāhinīpatim ||
santi caughabalāḥ kēcit kēcic chataguṇōttarāḥ apramēyabalāś cānyē tatrāsan hariyūthapāḥ ||
tataḥ kōpaparītātmā rāvaṇō rākṣasēśvaraḥ . niryāṇaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ drutam ājñāpayat tadā ||
indrajit tu mahāmāyaḥ sarvasainyasamāvṛtaḥ vivēśa nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ pitaraṃ cābhyupāgamat ||
dhūmrākṣēṇārditaṃ sainyaṃ vyathitaṃ prēkṣya mārutiḥ . abhyavartata saṃkruddhaḥ pragṛhya vipulāṃ śilām ||
tatrāyudhasahasrāṇi tasminn āyōdhanē bhṛśam . rākṣasāḥ kapimukhyēṣu pātayāṃ cakrirē tadā ||
sāgarapratimaughēna vṛtas tēna balēna saḥ prahastō niryayau kruddhaḥ kālāntakayamōpamaḥ ||
sa tēnābhihataḥ kruddho nadan rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ . vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi plavaṅgānāṃ camūpatau ||
visaṃjñaṃ vānaraṃ dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvō raṇōtsukaḥ . rathēnāmbudanādēna saumitrim abhidudruvē ।।
vānaraiḥ parvatākārair laṅkēyaṃ parivāritā . sītāharaṇasaṃtaptād rāmān nas tumulaṃ bhayam ।।
prakṛtyā hyēṣa tējasvī kumbhakarṇō mahābalaḥ . anyēṣāṃ rākṣasēndrāṇāṃ varadānakṛtaṃ balam ।।
sa ēṣa nirgatō vīraḥ śibirād bhīmavikramaḥ . vānarān bhṛśasaṃkṛddhō bhakṣayan paridhāvati ।।
tān bhartā mitrasaṃkāśān amitrān mantranirṇayē . vyavahārēṇa jānīyāt sacivān upasaṃhitān ।।
sa suhṛd yō vipannārthaṃ dīnam abhyavapadyatē sa bandhur yō ‘panītēṣu sāhāyyāyōpakalpatē ।।
yasya nāsti manuṣyēṣu sadṛśō rākṣasōttama . katham āśaṃsasē yōddhuṃ tulyēnēndravivasvatōḥ ।।
mahōdarō ‘yaṃ rāmāt tu paritrastō na saṃśayaḥ . na hi rōcayatē tāta yuddhaṃ yuddhaviśārada ।।
variants.b_text: महोदरोऽयंरामात्तुपरित्रस्तो न संशयः । न हिरोचयतेतात युद्धंयुद्धविशारद ।।6.65.10।।

variants.a_text: nanāda ca mahānādaṃ samudram abhinādayan . vijayann iva nirghātān vidhamann iva parvatān ।।
śrutvā triśirasō vākyaṃ dēvāntakanarāntakau . atikāyaś ca tējasvī babhūvur yuddhaharṣitāḥ ।।
dēvāntakaś ca saṃkruddhaḥ parighēṇa tadāṅgadam . upagamyābhihatyāśu vyapacakrāma vēgavān ।।
ahō subalavān rāmō mahadastrabalaṃ ca vai yasya vikramam āsādya rākṣasā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ।।
adya śūlanipātaiś ca vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūm . pradahiṣyāmi saṃprāptāṃ śuṣkēndhanam ivānalaḥ ।।
parasvānāṃ ca haraṇaṃ paradārābhimarśanam suhṛdām atiśaṅkāṃ ca trayo doṣāḥ kṣayāvahāḥ R_6,074.
variants.b_text: परस्वानां च हरणंपरदाराभिमर्शनम् ।।6.87.23।। सुहृदामतिशङ्का च त्रयोदोषाःक्षयावहाः ।

variants.a_text: pitāmahena prītena devadānavarākṣasaiḥ rāvaṇasyābhayaṃ dattaṃ mānuṣebhyo na yācitam R_6,082.
tamoghnāya himagnāya śatrughnāyāmitātmane | kṛtaghnaghnāya devāya jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ
rāghavastavasaṃyuktā gagane ca viśuśruve | sādhu sādhviti vāgagryā devatānāṃ mahātmanām
sa tvaṃ mānuṣamātreṇa rāmeṇa yudhi nirjitaḥ | na vyapatrapase rājan kim idaṃ rākṣaseṣvara
divyāṅgarāgāṃ vaidehīṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām | iha sītāṃ śiraḥsnātām upasthāpaya mā ciram
lajjayā tv avalīyantī sveṣu gātreṣu maithilī | vibhīṣaṇenānugatā bhartāraṃ sābhyavartata
saha saṃvṛddhabhāvena saṃsargeṇa ca mānada | yadi te ‘haṃ na vijñātā hatā tenāsmi śāśvatam
variants.b_text: सहसम्वृद्धभावेनसंसर्गेण च मानद । यदितेऽहं न विज्ञाताहतातेनास्मिशाश्वतम् ।।6.119.10।।

variants.a_text: ṛtadhāmā vasuḥ pūrvaṃ vasūnāṃ ca prajāpatiḥ | trayāṇām api lokānām ādikartā svayaṃprabhuḥ
upasthitam anādhṛṣyaṃ tadvimānaṃ manojavam | nivedayitvā rāmāya tasthau tatra vibhīṣaṇaḥ
tam abravīn mahātejā lakṣmaṇasyopaśṛṇvataḥ | vimṛśya rāghavo vākyam idaṃ snehapuraskṛtam
maithilyanveṣaṇaṃ caiva yathā cādhigatā tvayā | laṅghayitvā mahātoyam āpagāpatim avyayam
ayodhyāyāṃ tu sacivā rājño daśarathasya ca | purohitaṃ puraskṛtya mantrayāmāsur arthavat
asmin muhūrte gatvaiko nivartiṣyāmi vānarān praviṣṭān sāgaraṃ bhīmam ambaraṃ vā rasātalam
atha saṃskārasampanno hanūmān sacivottamaḥ | uvāca vacanam ślakṣṇam arthavan madhuram laghu ||
saṃyuge yugasamkāśam śatrūṇām śokavardhanam | suhṛdām nandanam dīrgham sāgarāntavyapāśrayam ||
yadi mām prati yudhyeran devagandharvadānavāḥ | naiva sītām pradāsyāmi sarvalokabhayād api ||
enam śatasahasrāṇām śatārdham paryupāsate | yūthapā yūthapaśreṣṭham yeṣām yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ ||
hanūmān paścimadvāram nipīḍya pavanātmajaḥ | praviśatv aprameyātmā bahubhiḥ kapibhir vṛtaḥ ||
śailaśṛṅgāṇi śataśaḥ pravṛddhāṃś ca mahīruhān . jagṛhuḥ kuñjaraprakhyā vānarāḥ paravāraṇāḥ ||
rākṣasā vismayaṃ jagmuḥ sahasābhinipīḍitāḥ vānarair mēghasaṃkāśaiḥ śakratulyaparākramaiḥ ||
prēkṣatō rākṣasēndrasya tāny anīkāni bhāgaśaḥ rāghavapriyakāmārthaṃ laṅkām āruruhus tadā ||
harṣēṇa tu samāviṣṭa indrajit samitiñjayaḥ pravivēśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ harṣayan sarvanairvṛtān ||
bhartāram anavadyāṅgī lakṣmaṇaṃ cāsitēkṣaṇā prēkṣya pāṃsuṣu cēṣṭantau rurōda janakātmajā ||
diṣṭyāyam adya pāpātmā mama dṛṣṭipathaṃgataḥ . adya krōdhaṃ vimōkṣyāmi sītāharaṇasambhavam ।।
dhruvaṃ lōkavināśāya paulastyēnāsi nirmitaḥ . tasmāt tvam adyaprabhṛti mṛtakalpaḥ śayiṣyasē ।।
kumbhakarṇa kulē jātō dhṛṣṭaḥ prākṛtadarśanaḥ . avaliptō na śaknōṣi kṛtyaṃ sarvatra vēditum ।।
tasya niṣpatatas tūrṇaṃ kumbhakarṇasya dhīmataḥ . babhūvur ghōrarūpāṇi nimittāni samantataḥ ।।
sa laṅghayitvā prākāraṃ girikūṭōpamō mahān . niryayau nagarāt tūrṇaṃ kumbhakarṇō mahābalaḥ ।।
tatas tu nīlō balavān paryavasthāpayan balam . pravicikṣēpa śailāgraṃ kumbhakarṇāya dhīmatē ।।
sa tasya cāpanirghōṣāt kupitō rākṣasarṣabhaḥ . amṛṣyamāṇas taṃ ghōṣam abhidudrāva rāghavam ।।
tasmin pravṛttē tumulē vimardē prahṛṣyamāṇēṣu valīmukhēṣu . nipātyamānēṣu ca rākṣasēṣu maharṣayō dēvagaṇāś ca nēduḥ ।।
nirāyudhō mahātējāḥ kēvalaṃ nakhadaṃṣṭravān . narāntakam abhikramya vāliputrō ‘bravīd vacaḥ ।।
tam āpatantam ākāśē drumavarṣaṃ pratāpavān . triśirā niśitair bāṇaiś cicchēda ca nanāda ca ।।
saumitrēś cāpanirghōṣaṃ śrutvā pratibhayaṃ tadā . visiṣmiyē mahātējā rākṣasēndrātmajō balī ।।
adya tē māmakā bāṇās taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ . pāsyanti rudhiraṃ gātrād bāṇaśalyāntarōtthitam ।।
śastrāṇi śarapatrāṇi samidhō ‘tha vibhītakāḥ lōhitāni ca vāsāṃsi sruvaṃ kārṣṇāyasaṃ tathā ।।
saptaṣaṣṭir hatāḥ kōṭyō vānarāṇāṃ tarasvinām . ahnaḥ pañcamaśēṣēṇa vallabhēna svayambhuvaḥ ।।
śaṅkhabhērīsahasrāṇām āhatānāṃ samantataḥ . kṣvelitāsphōṭitānāṃ ca tatra śabdō mahān abhūt ।।
sa dadarśa kapiśreṣṭham acalopamam indrajit sūdamānam asaṃtrastam amitrān pavanātmajam R_6,073.
nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ nyagrodhaṃ bhīmadarśanam tejasvī rāvaṇabhrātā lakṣmaṇāya nyavedayat R_6,074.
taṃ samāsādya vegena vāliputraḥ pratāpavān talenābhyahanat kruddhaḥ karṇamūle sakuṇḍale R_6,086.
rāvaṇasya ca bāṇaughai rāmavispharitena ca śabdena rākṣasās tena petuś ca śataśas tadā R_6,087.
variants.b_text: रावणस्य च बाणौघैरामविस्फारितेन च । शब्देनराक्षसास्तेन पेतुश्च शतशस्तदा ।।6.100.16।।

variants.a_text: nīlameghanibhāṃś cāsya sadaśvān parvatopamān jaghānāplutya gadayā rāvaṇasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ R_6,088.
vyomanāthas tamobhedī ṛgyajuḥsāmapāragaḥ | ghanavṛṣṭir apāṃ mitro vindhyavīthīplavaṃgamaḥ
tadāśvasihi visrabdhaṃ svagṛhe parivartase | ayaṃ cābhyeti saṃhṛṣṭas tvaddarśanasamutsukaḥ
kañcukoṣṇīṣiṇas tatra vetrajharjharapāṇayaḥ | utsārayantas tān yodhān samantāt paricakramuḥ
puṣkarākṣa mahābāho mahāvakṣaḥ paraṃtapa | diṣṭyā kṛtam idaṃ karma tvayā dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
priye tvaṃ saha nārībhir vānarāṇāṃ mahātmanām | rāghaveṇābhyanujñātā maithilīpriyakāmyayā
tvara tvam abhigacchāmo gṛhya vānarayoṣitaḥ | ayodhyāṃ darśayiṣyāmaḥ sarvā daśarathastriyaḥ
teṣāṃ purastād balavān gacchatāṃ gahane vane | vinadan sumahānādaṃ virādhaḥ pratyadṛśyata
suṣeṇaṃ ca nalaṃ caiva gavākṣam gandhamādanam | śarabhaṃ panasaṃ caiva paritaḥ pariṣasvaje
jagad adyābhiṣiktaṃ tvām anupaśyatu rāghava | pratapantam ivādityaṃ madhyāhne dīptatejasaṃ
sarvaṃ muditam evāsīt sarvo dharmaparo ‘bhavat | rāmam evānupaśyanto nābhyahiṃsan parasparam
asmin muhūrte sugrīva prayāṇam abhirocaye yukto muhūrte vijaye prāpto madhyaṃ divākaraḥ
variants.b_text: अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते सुग्रीव  प्रयाणमभिरोचये । युक्तो मुहूर्तो विजयः प्राप्तो मध्यं दिवाकर ।।6.4.3।।

variants.a_text: rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sugrīvaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ senāṃ nyaveśayat tīre sāgarasya drumāyute
variants.b_text: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीव स्सहलक्ष्मणः । सेनां निवेशयततीरे सागरस्य द्रुमायुते ।।6.4.106।।

variants.a_text: svabhāvatanukā nūnaṃ śokenānaśanena ca bhūyas tanutarā sītā deśakālaviparyayāt
hitam mahārtham mṛdu hetusaṃhitam vyatītakālāyatisampratikṣamam niśamya tadvākyam upasthitajvaraḥ prasaṅgavān uttaram etad abravīt
mitrāṭavībalam caiva maulabhṛtyabalam tathā | sarvam etadbalam grāhyam varjayitvā dviṣadbalam ||
samudrasya tataḥ kruddho rāmo raktāntalocanaḥ | samīpastham uvācedam lakṣmaṇam śubhalakṣmaṇam ||
kṛtāni prathamenāhnā yojanāni caturdaśa | prahṛṣṭair gajasamkāśais tvaramāṇaiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ ||
na śakyam sauptikam kartum rāmasya viditātmanaḥ | vadhaśca puruṣavyāghre tasminnaivopapadyate ||
āha tvāṃ rāghavō rāmaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ . niṣpatya pratiyudhyasva nṛśaṃsa puruṣo bhava ||
sa dadarśa vṛtāṃ laṅkāṃ saśailavanakānanām . asaṅkhyēyair harigaṇaiḥ sarvatō yuddhakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
sa śarair abhividdhāṅgō dvividaḥ krōdhamūrchitaḥ . sālēna sarathaṃ sāśvaṃ nijaghānāśaniprabham ||
anyōnyaṃ baddhavairāṇāṃ ghōrāṇāṃ jayam icchatām . sampravṛttaṃ niśāyuddhaṃ tadā vānararakṣasām ||
tasmiṃs tamasi duṣpārē rākṣasāḥ krōdhamūrchitāḥ . paripētur mahāvēgā bhakṣayantaḥ plavaṃgamān ||
vajradaṅṣṭraṃ hataṃ śrutvā vāliputrēṇa rāvaṇaḥ balādhyakṣam uvācēdaṃ kṛtāñjalim upasthitam ||
asau ca jīmūtanikāśarūpaḥ kumbhaḥ pṛthuvyūḍhasujātavakṣāḥ . samāhitaḥ pannagarājakētur visphārayanyāti dhanur vidhūnvan ।।
athēndraśatruṃ tarasā jaghāna bāṇēna vajrāśanisaṃnibhēna . bhujāntarē vyūḍhasujātarūpē vajrēṇa mēruṃ bhagavān ivēndraḥ ।।
taṃ nirviṣāśīviṣasaṃnikāśaṃ śāntārciṣaṃ sūryam ivāprakāśam . gataśriyaṃ kṛttakirīṭakūṭam uvāca rāmō yudhi rākṣasēndram ।।
sa sarvān sāntvayāmāsa nairṛtān nairṛtarṣabhaḥ . bōdhanād vismitaś cāpi rākṣasān idam abravīt ।।
brahmaśāpābhibhūtō ‘tha nipapātāgrataḥ prabhōḥ . tataḥ paramasaṃbhrāntō rāvaṇō vākyam abravīt ।।
hanumān śailaśṛṅgāṇi śilāś ca vividhān drumān vavarṣa kumbhakarṇasya śirasy ambaram āsthitaḥ ।।
sa kumbhakarṇasya vacō niśamya vyāvidhya śailaṃ sahasā mumōca . tēnājaghānōrasi kumbhakarṇaṃ śailēna vajrāśanisaṃnibhēna ।।
tasmin kālē sumitrāyāḥ putraḥ parabalārdanaḥ . cakāra lakṣmaṇaḥ kruddhō yuddhaṃ parapuraṃjayaḥ ।।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśrēṣṭhaṃ pradīptānalavarcasam . visphārayāmāsa tadā kārmukaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।।
sa kumbhakarṇō ‘stranikṛttabāhur mahāsikṛttāgra ivācalēndraḥ . utpāṭayāmāsa karēṇa vṛkṣaṃ tatō ‘bhidudrāva raṇē narēndram ।।
sa tasya bāhuṃ sahatālavṛkṣaṃ samudyataṃ pannagabhōgakalpam . aindrāstrayuktēna jaghāna rāmō bāṇēna jāmbhūnadacitritēna ।।
rājan sa kālasaṃkāśaḥ saṃyuktaḥ kālakarmaṇā . vidrāvya vānarīṃ sēnāṃ bhakṣayitvā ca vānarān ।।
variants.b_text: राजन् स कालसङ्काशस्संयुक्तःकालकर्मणा । विद्राव्यवानरींसेनांभक्षयित्वा च वानरान् ।।6.68.2।।

variants.a_text: dhruvam adyaiva saṃhṛṣṭā labdhalakṣāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ . ārōkṣyantīha durgāṇi laṅkādvārāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।।
vidrutāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā sa dadarśa narāntakam . gṛhītaprāsamāyāntaṃ hayapṛṣṭhapratiṣṭhitam ।।
gajēna samabhidrutya vāliputraṃ mahōdaraḥ . jaghānōrasi saṃkruddhas tōmarair vajrasaṃnibhaiḥ ।।
dhanūṃṣi cāsya sajjāni hēmapṛṣṭhāni sarvaśaḥ . śōbhayanti rathaśrēṣṭhaṃ śakracāpam ivāmbaram ।।
athavā tvaṃ pratisṭabdhō na nivartitum icchasi . tiṣṭha prāṇān parityajya gamiṣyasi yamakṣayam ।।
tē bāṇāḥ kālasaṃkāśā rākṣasēndradhunuścyutāḥ hēmapuṅkhā raviprakhyāś cakrur dīptam ivāmbaram ।।
tē śakrajidbāṇaviśīrṇadēhā māyāhatā visvaram unnadantaḥ . raṇē nipētur harayō ‘drikalpā yathēndravajrābhihatā nagēndrāḥ ।।
pravāti pavanas tasmin sapāṅsuḥ kharadāruṇaḥ . niryāṇē tasya raudrasya makarākṣasya durmatēḥ ।।
tasya jyātalanirghoṣaṃ sa śrutvā rākṣasādhipaḥ vivarṇavadano bhūtvā lakṣmaṇaṃ samudaikṣata R_6,076.
ekam ekena bāṇena tribhis trīn daśabhir daśa lakṣmaṇasya praciccheda darśayan pāṇilāghavam R_6,087.
variants.b_text: एकमेकेनबाणेनत्रिभिस्त्रीन् दशभिर्दश । लक्ष्मणस्य प्रचिच्छेद दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम् ।।6.100.20।।

naiva rātriṃ na divasaṃ na muhūrtaṃ na ca kṣaṇam | rāmarāvaṇayor yuddhaṃ virāmam upagacchati

variants.a_text: brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ pūrvam indrārtham amitaujasā | dattaṃ surapateḥ pūrvaṃ trilokajayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
nandanaṃ vānarendrāṇāṃ rakṣasām avasādanam | vājitaṃ vividhair vājaiś cārucitrair garutmataḥ
saṃbhramaś ca na kartavyo vartantyā rāvaṇālaye | vibhīṣaṇavidheyaṃ hi laṅkaiśvaryam idaṃ kṛtam
priyam etad upaśrutya bhartur vijayasaṃśrayam | praharṣavaśam āpannā nirvākyāsmi kṣaṇāntaram
utsāryamāṇān dṛṣṭvātha jagatyāṃ jātasambhramān | dākṣiṇyāt tadamarṣāc ca vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
tasyām agniṃ viśantyāṃ tu hāheti vipulaḥ svanaḥ | rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca saṃbabhūvādbhutopamaḥ
Сто двадцатая песнь pratiprayāte kākutsthe mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | abravīt paramaprīto rāghavaṃ prāñjaliṃ sthitam
tataḥ śatrughnavacanāt sumantro nāma sārathiḥ | yojayitvābhicakrāma rathaṃ sarvāṅgaśobhanam
yan nivedayase laṅkāṃ purīṃ bhīmasya rakṣasaḥ kṣipram enāṃ vadhiṣyāmi satyam etad bravīmi te
variants.b_text: यां निवेदयसे लङ्कां पुरीं भीमस्य रक्षसः । क्षिप्रमेनां मथिष्यामि सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ।।6.4.2।।
