variants.b_text: अन्योन्यं सहसा दृप्ता निर्वहान्ति क्षिपन्ति च । पतन्तश्पोत्पत्नत्यन्ये पातयन्त्यपरे परान् ।।6.4.28।।

variants.a_text: meghāḥ kravyādasamkāśāḥ paruṣāḥ paruṣasvanāḥ | krūrāḥ krūram pravarṣanti miśram śoṇitabindubhiḥ ||
mohitām rākṣasendreṇa sītām paramaduḥkhitām | āśvāsayāmāsa tadā saramā mṛdubhāṣiṇī ||
kṛtvā niyuddhaṃ bhṛśamugravegau | kālaṃ ciraṃ gopuravedimadhye | utkṣipya cotkṣipya vinamya dehau | pādakramādgopuravedilagnau ||
sa lakṣmaṇaś cāpi śarāñ śitāgrān mahēndratulyō ‘śanitulyavēgān . saṃdhāya cape jvalanaprakāśān sasarja rakṣōdhipatēr vadhāya ।।
saśaṅkhabhērīpaṇavapraṇādam sāsphōṭitakṣēvaḷitasiṃhanādam . diśō dravantas tridivaṃ kīrantaḥ śrutvā vihaṃgāḥ sahasā nipētuḥ ।।
rāghavēṇa samādiṣṭō nīlō haricamūpatiḥ . śaśāsa vānarānīkaṃ yathāvat kapikuñjaraḥ ।।
dēśakālavihīnāni karmāṇi viparītavat . kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīṃṣy aprayatēṣv iva ।।
tad vākyaṃ harirājasya sattvadhairyasamanvitam . śrutvā rākṣasaśārdūlaḥ kumbhakarṇō ‘bravīd vacaḥ ।।
sa kumbhakarṇasya bhujō nikṛttaḥ papāta bhūmau girisaṃnikāśaḥ . vivēṣṭamānō nijāghana vṛkṣāñ śailāñ śilāvānararākṣasāṃś ca ।।
sa tribhir nairṛtaśrēṣṭhair yugatapat samabhidrutaḥ . na vivyathē mahātējā vāliputraḥ pratāpavān ।।
sa vēgavān vēgavad abhyupētya taṃ rākṣasaṃ vānaravīramukhyaḥ . samvartya muṣṭiṃ sahasā jaghāna bāhvantarē śailanikāśarūpaḥ ।।
kāñcanāṅgadanaddhābhyāṃ bhūjābhyām ēṣa śōbatē . śṛṅgābhyām iva tuṅgābhyāṃ himavān parvatōttamaḥ ।।
[tē ‘nyōnyam abhisarpantō ninadantaś ca visvaram . rākṣasēndrāstranirbhinnā nipētur vānararṣabhāḥ ।।
sa tasya śṛṅgaṃ sanagaṃ sanāgaṃ sakāñcanaṃ dhātusahasrajuṣṭam vikīrṇakūṭaṃ jvalitāgrasānuṃ pragṛhya vegāt sahasonmamātha ||
trayāṇāṃ vānarēndrāṇāṃ tribhī rākṣasapuṃgavaiḥ . saṃsaktānāṃ mahad yuddham abhavad rōmaharṣaṇam ।।
nairṛtaḥ krōdhaśōkābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tu parimūrchitaḥ . kharaputraṃ viśālākṣaṃ makarākṣam acōdayat ।।
vaidehyai māṃ kuśalinaṃ sugrīvaṃ ca salakṣmaṇam | acakṣva vadatāṃ śreṣṭha rāvaṇaṃ ca hataṃ raṇe
variants.b_text: वैदेह्यैमांकुशलिनंसुग्रीवं च सलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.115.25।। आचक्ष्ववदतांश्रेष्ठरावणं च हतंरणे ।

variants.a_text: Сто двадцать третья песнь anujñātaṃ tu rāmeṇa tadvimānamanuttamam | haṃsayuktaṃ mahānādam utpapāta vihāyasam
enam śatasahasrāṇi saptatiḥ paryupāsate | eṣaivāśaṃsate laṅkām svenānīkena marditum ||
śilāprahārabhihatō vidyunmālī niśācaraḥ . niṣpiṣṭahṛdayō bhūmau gatāsur nipapāta ha ||
gajēndraiḥ parvatākāraiḥ parvatāgrair vanaukasām . mathitair vājibhiḥ kīrṇaṃ sārōhair vasudhātalam ||
pītvā ghaṭasahasrē dvē gamanāyōpacakramē . īṣat samutkaṭō mattas tējōbalasamanvitaḥ ।।
tēṣu vānaramukhyēṣu pātitēṣu mahātmasu . vānarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi kumbakarṇaṃ pradadruvuḥ ।।
utpatya cainaṃ tarasā talēnōrasya tāḍayat . sa tēnābhihataḥ kōpāt pramumōhācalōpamaḥ ।।
tam āpatantaṃ samprēkṣya kumbhakarṇaḥ plavaṅgamam . tasthau vivṛtasarvāṅgō vānarēndrasya saṃmukhaḥ ।।
tatas tu dēvarṣimaharṣipannagāḥ surāś ca bhūtāni suparṇaguhyakāḥ . sayakṣagandharvagaṇā nabhōgatāḥ praharṣitā rāmaparākramēṇa ।।
patatāṃ harivīrāṇāṃ rūpāṇi pracakāśirē . vajrabhinnāgrakūṭānāṃ śailānāṃ patatām iva ।।
atha śaktiṃ samādāya kālarātrim ivāntakaḥ . cikṣēpānilaputrāya triśirā rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।।
amṛṣyamāṇas taṃ ghōṣam utpapāta niśācaraḥ . utpatya ca hanūmantaṃ tāḍayāmāsa muṣṭinā ।।
tēna sugrīvavākyēna sāvamānēna mānitaḥ . agnēr ājyāhutasyēva tējas tasyābhyavardhata ।।
nagaryā viṭapāvatyā gandharvabhavanōttamaiḥ . satāragaṇanakṣatraṃ sacandrasamahāgraham nikumbhaparighāghūrṇaṃ bhramatīva nabhasthalam ।।
tam udyamya mahātējā nikumbhōrasi vīryavān abhicikṣēpa vēgēna vēgavān vāyuvikramaḥ ।।
akṣaraṃ brahmasatyaṃ ca madhye cānte ca rāghava | lokānāṃ tvaṃ paro dharmo viṣvaksenaś caturbhujaḥ
variants.b_text: अक्षरंब्रह्मसत्यं च मध्येचान्ते च राघव ।।6.120.14।। लोकानांत्वंपरोधर्मोविष्वक्सेनश्चतुर्भुजः ।

variants.a_text: tataḥ śikharam āruhya rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ kūrmamīnasamākīrṇam apaśyat salilākulam
ataḥ paramatīro 'yaṃ sāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ na cāyam anupāyena śakyas taritum arṇavaḥ
variants.b_text: अतः परमतीरोऽयं सागर स्सरितां पतिः । न चायमनुपायेन शक्यस्तरितुमर्णवः ।।6.4.101।।

variants.a_text: tadviyogendhanavatā taccintāvipulārciṣā rātriṃ divaṃ śarīraṃ me dahyate madanāgninā
pītāmahaniyogāc ca muktaḥ śambaravṛtrahā gatas triviṣṭapaṃ rājan sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ
tam mahābhram ivādityas tejovistṛtaraśmimān agrajasyālayam vīraḥ praviveśa mahādyutiḥ
sugrīva sattvasampanna mahābalaparākrama | kim mayā khalu vaktavyo rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ ||
raktacandanasamkāśā saṃdhyā paramadāruṇā | jvalataḥ prapataty etad ādityād agnimaṇḍalam ||
rajanyām aprakāśas tu samtāpayati candramāḥ | kṛṣṇaraktāṃśuparyanto lokakṣaya ivoditaḥ ||
daśanāgabalāḥ kēcit kēcid dhaśaguṇōttarāḥ kēcin nāgasahasrasya babhūvus tulyavikramāḥ ||
vinēduś ca mahāghōṣāḥ śaṅkhāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ . rākṣasānāṃ sughōrāṇāṃ mukhamārutapūritāḥ ||
sa samprahāras tumulō māṃsaśōṇitakardamaḥ rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca saṃbabhūvādbhutōpamāḥ ||
tasya jājṛmbhamāṇasya vaktraṃ pātālasannibham . dadṛśē mēruśṛṅgāgrē divākara ivōditaḥ ।।
satōyāmbudasaṃkāśaṃ kāñcanāṅgadabhūṣaṇam . dṛṣṭvā punaḥ pradudrāva vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūḥ ।।
rāmavākyam upaśrutya harayō jitakāśinaḥ . pādapair ardayavan vīrā vānarāḥ paravāhinīm ।।
sa tu rākṣasaśārdūlō nidrāmadasamākulaḥ . rājamārgaṃ śriyā juṣṭaṃ yayau vipulavikramaḥ ।।
tasya rākṣasarājasya niśamya paridēvitam . kumbhakarṇō babhāṣēdaṃ vacanaṃ prajahāsa ca ।।
śatakratuṃ vadhiṣyāmi pāsyāmi varuṇālayam parvatāṃś cūrṇayiṣyāmi dārayiṣyāmi mēdinīm ।।
acintayan mahōtpātān uditān rōmaharṣaṇān . niryayau kumbhakarṇas tu kṛtāntabalacōditaḥ ।।
tasmin plavagaśārdūlē visaṃjñē patitē bhuvi . tacchūlaṃ samupādāya sugrīvam abhidudruvē ।।
sa rarāja rathē tasmin rājasūnur mahābalaḥ . vṛtō nairṛtaśārdūlair vajrapāṇir ivāmaraiḥ ।।
athāṅgadō mṛtyusamānavēgaṃ saṃvartya muṣṭiṃ giriśṛṅgakalpam . nipātayāmāsa tadā mahātmā narāntakasyōrasi vāliputraḥ ।।
ārūḍhō mēghasaṅkāśaṃ vāraṇēndraṃ mahōdaraḥ . vāliputraṃ mahāvīryam abhidudrāva vīryavān ।।
na vākyamātrēṇa bhavān pradhānō na katthanāt satpuruṣā bhavanti . mayi sthitē dhanvini bāṇapāṇau nidarśaya svātmabalaṃ durātman ।।
sa śaṅkhaśaśivarṇēna chatrēṇa ripusūdanaḥ . rarāja pratipūrṇēna nabhaś candramasā yathā ।।
haripādavinirbhagnō niṣasāda sa parvataḥ . na śaśāka tadātmānaṃ vōḍhuṃ bhṛśanipīḍitaḥ ।।
sa yojanasahasrāṇi samatītya mahākapiḥ divyauṣadhidharaṃ śailaṃ vyacaran mārutātmajaḥ ||
samīkṣyāpatatas tāṃs tu vānarēndrān mahābalān āvavāra śaraughēṇa nagēnēva jalāśayam ।।
vibhīṣaṇamukhānāṃ ca suhṛdāṃ rāghavājñayā sarvavānaramukhyānāṃ cikitsāṃ akarot tadā R_6,079.
evamādivilāpārtaṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam āviveśa mahān kopaḥ putravyasanasaṃbhavaḥ R_6,080.
bhūmau sthitasya rāmasya rathasthasya ca rakṣasaḥ | na samaṃ yuddham ity āhur devagandharvakiṃnarāḥ
tad rāvanakarān muktaṃ vidyunmālāsamāvṛtam aṣṭaghaṇṭaṃ mahānādaṃ viyadgatam aśobhata ||
sa rāmabāṇair atividdhagātro niśācarendraḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ jagāma khedaṃ ca samājamadhye krodhaṃ ca cakre subhṛśaṃ tadānīm R_6,091.
variants.b_text: स रामबाणैरतिविद्धगात्रोनिशाचरेन्द्रःक्षतजार्द्रगात्रः । जगामखेदं च समाजमध्येक्रोधं च चक्रेसुभृशंतदानीम् ।।6.104.32।।

variants.a_text: ko brahmadaṇḍapratimaprakāśān | arciṣmataḥ kālanikāśarūpān | saheta bāṇān yamadaṇḍakalpān | samakṣamuktān yudhi rāghaveṇa ||
dēvadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvōragarakṣasām . śatrum adyōddhariṣyāmi tvām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca kaṇṭakam ||
tasmin mahābhīṣaṇakē pravṛttē kōlāhalē rākṣasarājadhānyām . pragṛhya rakṣāṃsi mahāyudhāni yugāntavātā iva saṃvicēruḥ ||
harirākṣasadēhēbhyaḥ prabhūtāḥ kēśaśādvalāḥ śarīrasaṃghāṭāvahāḥ prasusruḥ śōṇitāpagāḥ ||
ajaghānēndrajit kruddhō vajrēṇēva śatakratuḥ aṅgadaṃ gadayā vīraṃ śatrusainyavidāraṇam ||
gōlāṅgūlā mahākāyās tamasā tulyavarcasaḥ sampariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ bhakṣayan rajanīcarān ||
sabhāgyaś cāsi dharmajña rāma satyaparākrama . lakṣmaṇēna saha bhrātrā samare ripughātinā ||
patākālaṅkṛtaṃ dīptaṃ taptakāñcanabhūṣitam rathaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā samārōhac camūpatiḥ ||
balavantō ‘straviduṣō nānāpraharaṇā raṇē . jaghnur vānarasainyāni rākṣasāḥ krōdhamūrchitāḥ ||
tatō nānāpraharaṇā bhīmākṣā bhīmadarśanāḥ . niṣpētū rākṣasā mukhyā balādhyakṣapracōditāḥ ||
asau kirīṭī calakuṇḍalāsyō nagēndravindhyōpamabhīmakāyaḥ . mahēndravaivasvatadarpahantā rakṣōdhipaḥ sūrya ivāvabhāti ।।
rākṣasēnāhavē tasya tāḍitasyāpi sāyakaiḥ . svabhāvatējōyuktasya bhūyas tējō ‘bhyavardhata ।।
sa parvatāgram utkṣipya samāvidhya mahābalaḥ . abhidudrāva vēgēna kumbhakarṇaṃ mahābalam ।।
sucakrākṣaṃ susaṃyuktaṃ sānukarṣaṃ sukūbaram . tūṇībāṇāsanair dīptaṃ prāsāsiparighākulam ।।
siṃhanādān vinēduś ca raṇē rākṣasavānarāḥ . śilābhiś cūrṇayāmāsur yātudhānān plavaṅgamāḥ ।।
sa tasya dadṛśē mārgō māṃsaśōṇitakardamaḥ . patitaiḥ parvatākārair vānarair abhisaṃvṛtaḥ ।।
tatō ‘bravīn mahātējā hanūmantaṃ sa jāmbavān . āgaccha hariśārdūla vānarāṃs trātum arhasi ।।
nārījanasya dhūmēna vyāptasyōccair vinēduṣaḥ . svanō jvalanataptasya śuśruvē śatayōjanam ।।
bāhuṃ cāsya sanistriṃśam ājaghāna sa muṣṭinā . vāliputrasya ghātēna sa papāta kṣitāv asiḥ ।।

eṣa supteṣu jāgarti bhūteṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ | eṣa caivāgnihotraṃ ca phalaṃ caivāgnihotriṇām
kṣubdhānāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca pātālatalavāsinaḥ | vyathitā dānavāḥ sarve pannagāśca sahasraśaḥ
jājvalyamānaṃ vapuṣā supuṅkhaṃ hemabhūṣitam | tejasā sarvabhūtānāṃ kṛtaṃ bhāskaravarcasam
tataḥ sakāmaṃ sugrīvamaṅgadaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam | cakāra rāghavaḥ prīto hatvā rākṣasapuṃgavam
vadantaṃ hetumadvākyaṃ paridṛṣṭārthaniścayam | rāmaḥ śokasamāviṣṭam ity uvāca vibhīṣaṇam

lōkakṣayakaraṃ bhīmaṃ bhayaṃ paśyāmy upasthitam . nibarhaṇaṃ pravīrāṇām ṛkṣavānararakṣasām ||
visṛjantō mahānādāṃs trāsayantō niśācarān . laṅkādvārāṇy upājagmur yuddhakāmāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ||
taccailavēgābhihataṃ hatāśvaṃ hatasārathim rakṣasāṃ rudhiraklinnaṃ babhūvāyōdhanaṃ mahat ।।
tadāpatantaṃ samprēkṣya muṣṭinābhijaghāna ha . muṣṭiprahārābhihataṃ tac chailāgraṃ vyaśīryata savisphuliṅgaṃ sajvālaṃ nipapāta mahētalē ।।
sa cāpam ādāya bhujaṃgakalpaṃ dhṛḍhajyam ugraṃ tapanīyacitram . harīn samāśvāsya samutpapāta rāmō nibaddhōttamatūṇabāṇaḥ ।।
dadṛśuś ca mahātmānaṃ hayapṛṣṭhē pratiṣṭhitam . carantaṃ harisainyēṣu vidyādharamaharṣayaḥ ।।
sa rāghavaṃ samāsādya krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ vyasṛjac charavarṣāni rāvaṇo rakṣaseṣvaraḥ R_6,087.

variants.a_text: sauvarṇas tu mahāṃs tasyāḥ prākāro duṣpradharṣaṇaḥ maṇividrumavaidūryamuktāvicracitāntaraḥ

sa hemajālavitatam maṇividrumabhūṣitam upagamya vinītāśvam āruroha mahāratham
tataḥ paryantaraktākṣō bhinnāñjanacayōpamaḥ . rāvaṇir bhrātarau vākyam antardhānagatō ‘bravīt ||
śīghram ētān susaṃtrastān bahudhā vipradhāvitān . paryavasthāpayākhyā hi vibhīṣaṇam upasthitam ||
dēvadānavagandharvair yakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ . avadhyatvaṃ mayā prāptaṃ mānuṣēbhyō na yācitam ।।
tasmin kālē sa dharmātmā lakṣmaṇō rāmam abravīt kumbhakarṇavadhē yuktō yōgān parimṛśan bahūn ।।

variants.a_text: tataḥ kṛcchrāt samāsādya saṃjñāṃ rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ . kumbhakarṇavadhād dīnō vilalāpākulēndriyaḥ ।।
parighāgrēṇa tān vṛkṣān babhañja ca mahōdaraḥ . triśirāś cāṅgadaṃ vīram abhidudrāva sāyakaiḥ ।।

sa brahmakōśaṃ rajatālayaṃ ca śakrālayaṃ rudraśarapramōkṣam . hayānanaṃ brahmaśiraś ca dīptaṃ dadarśa vaivasvatakiṅkarāṃś ca ।।
sa dhanur dhanvināṃ śrēṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya susamāhitaḥ . mumōcāśīviṣaprakhyān śarān dēhavidāraṇān ।।

variants.a_text: tāny anīkāny anekāni rāvaṇasya śarottamaiḥ dṛṣṭvā bhagnāni śataśo rāghavaḥ paryavasthitaḥ R_6,087.
