a_only.text: yat tu kāryaṃ manuṣyeṇa śauṭīryam avalambyatāṃ tad alaṃkaraṇāyaiva kartur bhavati satvaram
yathāsukhaṃ yathāvac ca laṅkāyām asi dṛṣṭavān sarvam ācakṣva tattvena sarvathā kuśalo hy asi
vibhāgaṃ ca balaughasya nirdeśaṃ vāhanasya ca evamuktvā kapiśreṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa tattvavit
plavamānā hi gatvā tāṃ rāvaṇasya mahāpurīm saparvatavanāṃ bhitvā sakhātāṃ ca satoraṇām saprākārāṃ sabhavanām ānayiṣyanti rāghava
sarāṃsi ca suphullāni taṭākāni varāṇi ca rāmasya śāsanaṃ jñātvā bhīmakopasya bhītavat
niḥsasarpa mahāghoraṃ bhīmaghoṣam ivārṇavam tasya dāśaratheḥ pārśve śūrās te kapikuñjarāḥ
mahadbhyām iva saṃspṛṣṭau grāhābhyāṃ candrabhāskarau tato vānararājena lakṣmaṇena supūjitaḥ
samṛddhārthaḥ samṛddhārthām ayodhyāṃ pratiyāsyasi mahānti ca nimittāni divi bhūmau ca rāghava
ṛkṣavānaraśārdūlair nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhair api karāgraiś caraṇāgraiś ca vānarair uddhataṃ rajaḥ
chādayantī yayau bhīmā dyām ivāmbudasaṃtati uttarantyāśca senāyāḥ satatam bahuyojanam
kecit kilakilāṃ cakrur vānarā vanagocarāḥ prāsphoṭayaṃś ca pucchāni samnijaghnuḥ padāny api
jṛmbhamāṇāś ca vikrāntā vicikrīḍuḥ śilādrumaiḥ tataḥ śatasahasraiś ca koṭibhiś ca sahasraśaḥ
sumahadvānarānīkam cādayāmāsa sarvataḥ giriprastheṣu ramyeṣu sarvataḥ samprapuṣpitāḥ
ketakyaḥ sinduvārāś ca vāsantyaśca manoramāḥ mādhavyo gandhapūrṇāś ca kundagulmāśca puṣpitāḥ
ciribilvā madhūkāśca vañjulā vakulās tathā rañjakās tilakāś caiva nāgavṛkṣaśca puṣpitāḥ
cūtāḥ pāṭalikāś caiva kovidārāś ca puṣpitāḥ muculindārjunāś caiva śiṃśapāḥ kuṭajās tathā
hintālās tiniśāś caiva cūrṇakā nīpakās tathā nīlāśokāś ca saralā aṅkolāḥ padmakās tathā
prīyamāṇaiḥ plavamgais tu sarve paryākulīkṛtāḥ vāpyas tasmin girau ramyāḥ palvalāni tathaiva ca
cakravākānucaritāḥ kāraṇḍavaniṣevitāḥ plavaiḥ krauñcaiś ca saṃkīrṇā varāhamṛgasevitāḥ
ṛkṣais tarakṣubhiḥ siṃhaiḥ śārdūlaiś ca bhayāvahaiḥ vyālaiś ca bahubhir bhīmaiḥ sevyamānāḥ samantataḥ
padmaiḥ saugandhikaiḥ phullaiḥ kusumais cotpalais tathā vārijair vividhaiḥ puṣpai ramyās tatra jalāśayāḥ
babhuñjur vānarās tatra pādapānāṃ madotkaṭāḥ droṇamātrapramāṇāni lambamānāni vānarāḥ
dadṛśus te mahātmāno vātāhatajalāśayam aniloddhūtam ākāśe pravalgatam ivormibhiḥ
sahito mantrayitvā yaḥ karmārambhān pravartayet daive ca kurute yatnaṃ tam āhuḥ puruṣottamam
mahājvareṇa durdharṣam yamalokamahārṇavam avagāhya tvayā rājan yamasya balasāgaram
jayaś ca viplulaḥ prāpto mṛtyuś ca pratiṣedhitaḥ suyuddhena ca te sarve lokās tatra sutoṣitāḥ
rudrādityamahāgrāhaṃ marudvasumahoragam rathāśvagajatoyaughaṃ padātipulinam mahat
anena hi samāsādya devānām balasāgaram gṛhīto daivatapatir laṅkām cāpi praveśitaḥ
kākutstham upasamgamya vivṛtaṃ mānuṣam vapuḥ sarve hy asambhramā bhūtvā bruvantu raghusattamam
kruddhaḥ parilihan sṛkkāṃ jihvayā vākyam abravīt svairaṃ kurvantu kāryāṇi bhavanto vigatajvarāḥ
tato nikumbho rabhasaḥ sūryaśatrur mahābalaḥ suptaghno yajñakopaś ca mahāpārśvamahodarau
agniketuś ca durdharṣo raśmiketuś ca rākṣasaḥ indraśatruś ca balavāṃs tato rāvaṇātmajaḥ
prahasto 'tha virūpākṣo vajradaṃṣṭro mahābalaḥ dhūmrākṣo ‘tha nikumbhaś ca durmukhaś caiva rākṣasaḥ
parighān paṭṭiśāñcchūlān prāsāj śaktiparaśvadhān cāpāni ca subāṇāni khaḍgāṃś ca vipulāmbubhān
pragṛhya paramakruddhāḥ samutpatya ca rākṣasāḥ abruvan rāvaṇaṃ sarve pradīptā iva tejasā
rākṣasā rākṣasaśreṣṭham śirobhistam vavandire rākṣasaiḥ stūyamānaḥ sañ jayāśīrbhir ariṃdamaḥ
virājamāno vapuṣā rukmapaṭṭottaraccadām tām piśācaśataiḥ ṣaḍbhir abhiguptām sadāprabhām
mahat sopāśrayam bheje rāvaṇaḥ paramāsanam tataḥ śaśāseśvaravad dūtāl laghuparākramān
samīyus tatra śataśaḥ śūrāś ca bahavas tathā sabhāyām hemavarṇāyām sarvārthasya sukhāya vai
śokasamtāpanityena kāmena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ | sā tu samvatsaram kālam mām ayācata bhāminī ||
bahusattvajhaṣākīrṇam tau vā daśarathātmajau | athavā kapinaikena kṛtam naḥ kadanam mahat ||
pare pāre samudrasya puraskṛtya nṛpātmajau | sītāyāḥ padavīm prāpya samprāptau varuṇālayam ||
rājyam prārthayamānas tu buddhipūrvam ihāgataḥ | etāvat tu puraskṛtya vidyate tasya samgrahaḥ ||
ko nāma sa bhavet tasya yam eṣa na parityajet | vānarādhipater vākyam śrutvā sarvān udīksya tu ||
rākṣaso jihmayā buddhyā saṃdiṣṭo ‘yam ihāgataḥ | prahartum tvayi viśvaste viśvaste mayi vā ‘nagha ||
lakṣmaṇe vā mahābāho sa badhyaḥ sacivaiḥ saha | rāvaṇasya nṛśaṃsasya bhrātā hy eṣa vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
dharmayuktam ca yuktam ca sāmpratam sampraharṣaṇam | anujo rāvaṇasyāham tena cāsmy avamānitaḥ ||
bhavadgatam hi me rājyam ca jīvitam ca sukhāni ca | tasya tad vacanam śrutvā rāmo vacanam abravīt ||
satkriyārtham kriyādakṣaṃ smitapūrvam abhāṣata | vibhīṣaṇasya mantro ‘yam mama lakṣmaṇa rocate ||
agādhaś cāprameyaś ca dvitīya iva sāgaraḥ | putrau daśarathasyemau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ||
prāpadyanta tadā kṣipram loptum hantum ca muṣṭibhiḥ | sarvaiḥ plavaṇgaiḥ prasabham nigṛhīto niśācarah ||
gaganād bhūtale cāśu pratigṛhyāvatāritaḥ | vānaraiḥ pīḍyamānas tu śuko vacanam abravīt ||
bāhum bhujaṅgabhogābham upadhāyārisūdanaḥ | jātarūpamayaiś caiva bhūṣanāir uṣitaṃ sadā ||
asyatā ca punaḥ savyam jyāghātavihatatvacam | dakṣiṇo dakṣiṇam bahum mahāparighasaṃnibham ||
gosahasrapradātāram hy upadhāya bhujam mahat | adya me taraṇam vātha maraṇam sāgarasya vā ||
iti rāmo dhṛtim kṛtvā mahābāhur mahodadhim | adhiśiśye ca vidhivat prayato ‘tra sthito muniḥ ||
asāmarthyaphalā hy ete nirguṇeṣu satām guṇāḥ | ātmapraśaṃsinam duṣṭam dhṛṣṭam viparidhāvakam ||
nirmaryādam kariṣyāmi sāyakair varuṇālayam | mahārṇavam kṣobhayiṣye mahādānavasaṃkulam ||
etadvināpi hy udadhes tavārya | sampatsyate vīratamasya kāryam | bhavadvidhāḥ krodhavaśam na yānti | dīrgham bhavān paśyatu sādhuvṛttam ||
antarhitaiś cāpi tathāntarikṣe | brahmarṣibhiś caiva surarṣibhiś ca | śabdaḥ kṛtaḥ kaṣṭamiti bruvadbhir | mā meti coktvā mahatā svareṇa ||
pracakāśe tadākāśam ulkāśatavidīpitam | antarikṣācca nirghātā nirjagmur atulasvanāḥ ||
ārujaṃś caiva śailāgrān śikharāṇi babhañja ca | divi ca sma mahāvegāḥ saṃhatāḥ samahāsvanāḥ ||
mumucur vaidyutān agnīṃs te mahāśanayas tadā | yāni bhūtāni dṛśyāni cukruśuś cāśaneḥ samam ||
saṃpravivyathire cāpi na ca paspandire bhayāt | saha bhūtaiḥ satoyormiḥ sanāgaḥ saharākṣasaḥ ||
ratnamālyāmbaradharaḥ padmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ | sarvapuṣpamayīm divyām śirasā dhārayan srajam ||
jātarūpamayaiś caiva tapanīyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | ātmajānām ca ratnānām bhūṣito bhūṣaṇottamaiḥ ||
dhātubhir maṇḍitaḥ śailo vividhair himavān iva | ekāvalīmadhyagatam taralam pāṇḍaraprabham ||
evam etaiś ca saṃyukto bahubhiḥ saṃyuto maruḥ | rāmasya varadānāc ca śivaḥ panthā babhūva ha ||
daṇḍa eva paro loke puruṣasyeti me matiḥ dhik kṣamām akṛtajñeṣu sāntvaṃ dānam athāpi vā ||
mama mātur varo datto mandare viśvakarmaṇā | mayā tu sadṛśaḥ putras tava devi bhaviṣyati ||
samarthś cāpy aham setum kartum vai varuṇālaye | tasmād adyaiva badhnantu setum vānarapuṃgavāḥ ||
bilvakaiḥ saptaparṇaiś ca karṇikāraiś ca puṣpitaiḥ | cūtaiś ca aśokavṛkṣaiś ca sāgaram samapūrayan ||
meghābhaiḥ parvatābhaiś ca tṛṇaiḥ kāṣṭhair babandhare | puṣpitāgraiś ca tarubhiḥ setum badhnanti vānarāḥ ||
badhnantaḥ sāgare setum jagmuḥ pāram mahāudadheḥ | viśālaḥ sukṛtaḥ śrīmān subhūmiḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
pareṣām abhiyānārtham atiṣṭhat sacivaiḥ saha | sugrīvas tu tataḥ prāha rāmam satyaparākramam ||
jagāma dhanvī dharmātmā sugrīveṇa samanvitaḥ | anye madhyena gaccanti pārśvato ‘nye plavaṃgamāḥ ||
kaccin nānekacittānām teṣām tvam vaśamāgataḥ | tataḥ sa bhayasamvignas tadā rājñābhicoditaḥ ||
vacanam pratyuvācedam rākṣasādhipam uttamam ||
jyāśabdatumulām ghorām ārtagītamahāsvanām | nārācatalasaṃnādām nadīm āhitavāhinīm || avagāhya maharaṅgam vādayiṣyāmy ahaṃ raṇe ||
mantriṇo ye ca rāmasya sugrīvasya ca saṃgatāḥ | ye pūrvam abhivartante ye ca śūrāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ ||
sa ca setur yathā baddhaḥ sāgare salilārṇave | niveśaṃ ca yathā teṣām vānarāṇām mahātmanām ||
rāmasya vyavasāyam ca vīryam praharaṇāni ca | lakṣmaṇasya ca vīrasya tattvato jñātum arhatha ||
niviṣṭam niviśac caiva bhīmanādam mahābalam | tadbalārṇavam akṣobhyam dadṛśāte niśācarau ||
āgamya nagarīm laṅkām abrūtām rākṣasādhipam | vibhīṣaṇagṛhītau tu vadhārhaṃ rākṣaseśvara ||
lokapālasamāḥ śūrāḥ kṛtāstrā dṛḍhavikramāḥ | rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmāml lakṣmaṇaḥ ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
utpāṭya saṃkrāmayitum sarve tiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ | yādṛśam taddhi rāmasya rūpam praharaṇāni ca ||
āruroha tataḥ śrīmān prāsādam himapāṇḍuram | bahutālasamutsedham rāvaṇo atha didṛkṣayā ||
dadarśa pṛthivīdeśam susaṃpūrṇam plavaṃgamaiḥ | tad apāram asahyaṃ ca vānarāṇām mahābalam ||
ābabhaṣe ‘tha mukhyajño mukhyāṃs tatra vanaukasaḥ | eṣa yo ‘bhimukho laṅkām nardaṃs tiṣṭhati vānaraḥ ||
balāgre tiṣṭhate vīro nīlo nāmaiṣa yūthapaḥ | bāhū pragṛhya yaḥ padbhyām mahīm gacchati vīryavān ||
laṅkām abhimukhaḥ kopād abhīkṣṇam ca vijṛmbhate | giriśṛngapratīkāśaḥ padmakiñjalkasamnibhaḥ ||
sphoṭayaty abhisaṃrabdho lāngūlam ca punaḥ punaḥ | yasya lāngūlaśabdena svananti pradiśo daśa ||
eṣa vānararājena surgrīveṇābhiṣecitaḥ | yauvarājye ‘ngado nāma tvām āhvayati samyuge ||

ete duṣprasahā ghorāś caṇḍāś caṇḍaparākramāḥ | aṣṭau śatasahasrāṇi daśakoṭiśatāni ca || ya enam anugaccanti vīrāś candanavāsinaḥ || eṣaivāśaṃsate laṅkām svenānīkena marditum | śveto rajatasamkāśaś capalo bhīmavikramaḥ ||
vibhajan vānarīm senām anīkāni praharṣayan | yaḥ purā gomatī tīre ramyam paryeti parvatam ||
nāmnā saṃrocano nāma nānānagayuto giriḥ | tatra rājyam praśāsty eṣa kumudo nāma yūthapaḥ ||
yo ‘sau śatasahasrāṇi saharṣam parikarṣati | yasya vālā bahuvyāmā dīrghalāngūlam āśritāḥ ||
tāmrāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śvetāḥ prakīrṇā ghoradarśanāḥ | adīno vānaraś caṇḍaḥ saṅgāmam abhikānkṣati || eṣaivāṃśasate laṅkām svenānīkena marditum ||
yas tv eṣa siṃhasamkāśaḥ kapilo dīrghakesaraḥ | nibhṛtaḥ prekṣate laṅkām didhakṣann iva cakṣuṣā ||
yam yāntam vānarā ghorāś caṇḍāś caṇḍparākramāḥ | parivāryānugacchanti laṅkām marditum ojasā ||
yas tu karṇau vivṛṇute jṛmbhate ca punaḥ punaḥ | na ca saṃvijate mṛtyor na senāṃ pradhāvati ||
prakampate ca roṣena tiryakca punarīkṣate | paśya lāṅgūlavikṣepaṃ ksveḍaty eṣa mahābalaḥ ||
mahaujasā vītabhayo ramyam sālveyaparvatam | rājan satatam adhyāste śarabho nāma yūthapaḥ ||
bherīṇām iva saṃnādo yasyaiṣa śrūyate mahān | ghoṣaḥ śākhāmṛgendrāṇām saṅgāmam abhikānkṣatām ||
eṣa parvatam adhyāste pāriyātram anuttamam | yuddhe duṣprasaho nityam panaso nāma yūthapaḥ ||
eṣa dardurasaṃkāśo vinato nāma yūthapaḥ | pibamś carati yau veṇāṃ nadīnām uttamām nadīm ||
vikrāntā balavantaśca yathā yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ | yas tu gairikavarṇābham vapuḥ puṣyati vānaraḥ ||
pragṛhītāḥ prakāśante sūryasyeva marīcayaḥ | pṛthivyām cānukṛṣyante haro nāmaiṣa yūthapaḥ ||
yūthapā harirājasya kiṃkarāḥ samupasthitāḥ | nīlān iva mahāmeghāṃs tiṣṭhato yāṃs tu paśyasi ||
parvateṣu ca ye kecid viṣayeṣu nadīṣu ca | ete tvām abhivartante rājann ṛṣkāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ||
ṛkṣavantam giriśreṣṭham adhyāste narmadām piban | sarvarkṣāṇām adhipatir dhūmro nāmaiṣa yūthapaḥ ||
sa eṣa jāmbavān nāma mahāyūthapa yūthapaḥ | praśānto guruvartī ca saṃprahāreṣv amarṣaṇaḥ ||
rākṣasānām ca sadṛśāḥ piśācānām ca romaśāḥ | etasya sainye bahavo vicaranty agnitejasaḥ ||
eṣa rājan sahasrākṣam paryupāste harīśvaraḥ | balena balasaṃyukto rambho nāmaiṣa yūthapaḥ ||
yasmān tu paramam rūpam catuṣpātsu na vidyate | śrutaḥ saṃnādano nāma vānarāṇām pitāmahaḥ ||
yena yuddham tadā dattam raṇe śakrasya dhīmatā | parājayaś ca na prāptaḥ so ‘yam yūthapayūthapaḥ ||
tadā devāsure yuddhe sāhyārtham tridivaukasām | yatra vaiśravaṇo rājā jambūm upaniṣevate ||
tatraiṣa ramate śrīmān balavān vānarottamaḥ | yuddheṣv akatthano nityam krathano nāma yūthapaḥ ||
eṣa yūthapatir netā garjan giriguhāśayaḥ | gajān rodhayate vanyān ārujaṃśca mahīruhān ||
ramate vānaraśreṣṭho divi śakra iva svayam | enam śatasahasrāṇām sahasram abhivartate ||
sa eṣa durdharo rājan pramāthī nāma yūthapaḥ | vātenevoddhatam megham yam enam anupaśyasi ||
vivartamānam bahuśo yatra tadbahulam rajaḥ | ete sitamukhā ghorā golāngūlā mahābalāḥ ||
parivāryābhinardante laṅkām marditum ojasā | bhramarācaritā yatra sarvakālaphaladrumāḥ ||
yam sūryatulyavarṇābham anuparyeti parvatam | yasya bhāsā sadā bhānti tadvarṇā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ||
yasya prastham mahātmāno na tyajanti maharṣayaḥ | sarvakāmaphalā vṛkṣāḥ sarve phalasamanvitāḥ ||
madhūni ca mahārhāṇi yasmin parvatasattame | tatraiṣa ramate rājan ramye kāncanaparvate ||
mukhyo vānaramukhyānām kesarī nāma yūthapaḥ | ṣaṣṭir girisahasrāṇi ramyāḥ kāncanaparvatāḥ ||
teṣām madhye girivaras tvam ivānagha rakṣasām | tatraike kapilāḥ śvetās tāmrāsyā madhupingalāḥ ||
nivasanty uttamagirau tīkṣṇadamṣṭrā nakhāyudhāḥ | simha iva caturdamṣṭrā vyāghrā iva durāsadāḥ ||
sarve vaiśvānarasamā jvaladāśīviṣopamāḥ | sudīrghāñcitalāngūlā mattamātamgasamnibhāḥ ||
mahāparvatasaṃkāśā mahājīmūtaniḥsvanāḥ | vṛttapiṅgalanetrā hi mahābhīmagatisvanāḥ ||
mardayantīva te sarve tasthur laṅkām samīkṣya te | eṣa caiṣām adhipatir madhye tiṣṭhati vīryavān ||
ete duṣprasahā rājan balinaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ | daityadānavasamkāśā yuddhe devaparākramāḥ ||
eṣo ‘bhigantā laṃkāyā vaidehyās tava ca prabho | enam paśya purā dṛṣṭam vānaram punar āgatam ||
ādityam āhariṣyāmi na me kṣut pratiyāsyati | iti niścitya manasā pupluve baladarpitaḥ ||
yasyaiṣo ‘nantaraḥ śūraḥ śyāmaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ | ikṣvākūṇām atiratho loke viśrutapauruṣaḥ ||
yasmin na calate dharmo yo dharmam nātivartate | yo brāhmam astram vedāmś ca veda vedavidām varaḥ ||
yo bhindyād gaganam bāṇair medinīṃ vāpi dārayet | yasya mṛtyor iva krodhaḥ śakrasyeva parākramaḥ ||
yasya bhāryā jansthānāt sītā cāpi hṛtā tvayā | sa eṣa rāmas tvām rājan yoddhum samabhivartate ||
eṣo hi lakṣmaṇo nāma bhrātuḥ priyahite rataḥ | naye yuddhe ca kuśalaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtām varaḥ||
yam tu paśyasi tiṣṭhantam madhye girim ivācalam | sarvaśākhāmṛgendrāṇām bhartāram amitaujasam ||
tejasā yaśasā buddhyā balenābhijanena ca | yaḥ kapīn atibabhrāja himavān iva parvataḥ ||
kiṣkindhām yaḥ samadhyāste durgām sagahanadrumām | durgām parvatadurgamyām pradhānaiḥ saha yūthapaiḥ ||
yasyaiṣā kāncanī mālā śobhate śatapuṣkarā | kāntā devamanuṣyāṇām yasyām lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā ||
etām mālām ca tārām ca kapirājyam ca śāśvatam | sugrīvo vālinam hatvā rāmeṇa pratipāditaḥ ||
śatam śaṅkusahasrāṇām mahāśaṅkuriti smṛtaḥ | mahāśaṅkysahasrāṇām śatam vṛndamihocyate ||
śatam padmasahasrāṇām mahāpadmamiti smṛtam | mahāpadmasahasrāṇām śatam kharvamihocyate ||
śatam kharvasahasrāṇām mahākharvamiti smṛtam | mahākharvasahasrāṇām samudramabhidhīyate || śatam samudrasāhasrāṇām mahaugham iti viśrutam||
evam koṭi sahasreṇa śankūnām ca śatena ca | mahāśaṅkusahasreṇa tathā vṛndaśatena ca ||
mahāvṛndasahasreṇa tathā padmaśatena ca | mahāpadmasahasreṇa tathā kharvaśatena ca ||
samudreṇa ca tenaiva mahaughena tathaiva ca | eṣa koṭimahaughena samudrasadṛśena ca ||
śukena tu samādiṣṭān dṛṣṭvā sa hariyūthapān | lakṣmaṇam ca mahāvīryam bhujam rāmasya dakṣiṇam ||
samīpastham ca rāmasya bhrātaram svam vibhīṣaṇam | sarvavānararājam ca sugrīvam bhīmavikramam ||
aṅgadam cāpi balinam vajrahastātmajātmajam | hanūmantam ca vikrāntam jāmbavantam ca durjayam ||
suṣeṇam kumudam nīlam nalam ca plavagarṣabham | gajam gavākṣam śarabham maindam ca dvividam tathā ||
kiṃcidāvignahṛdayo jātakrodhaś ca rāvaṇaḥ | bhartsayām āsa tau vīrau kathā ante śukasāraṇau ||
daśa vānarakoṭyaśca śūrāṇām yuddhakāṅgkṣiṇām | śrīmatām devaputrāṇām śeṣam nākhyātum utsahe ||
viśvakarmasuto vīro nalaḥ plavagasattamaḥ | vikrānto vegavān atra vasuputraḥ sa durdharaḥ ||
tasya tuṣṭo ‘bhavad rājā pradadau ca vibhūṣaṇam | aśokavanikāyām ca sītādarśanalālasaḥ ||
idam ca vacanam dhṛṣṭam uvāca janakātmajām | sāntvyamānā mayā bhadre yam āśritya vimanyase ||
kharahantā sa te bhartā rāghavaḥ samare hataḥ | chinnam te sarvathā mūlam darpaśca vihato mayā ||
yaṣṭīśca tomarān prāsāṃścakrāṇi musalāni ca | udyamyodyamya rakṣobhir vānareṣu nipātitāḥ ||
asinā vyāyatau chinnau madhye hy ariniṣūdanau | anuṣvanati medinyām panasaḥ panaso yathā ||
sā sītā tacciro dṛṣṭvā tac ca kārmukam uttamam | sugrīvapratisaṃsargam ākhyātam ca hanūmatā ||
etaih sarvair abhijnānair abhijnāya suduhkhitā | vijagarhe ‘tra kaikeyīm krośantī kurarī yathā ||
vikrānto rakṣitā nityam ātmanaśca parasya ca | lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā kulīno nayaśāstravit ||
hantā parabalaughānām acintyabalapauruṣaḥ | na hato rāghavaḥ śrīmān sīte śatrunibarhaṇaḥ ||
vegavadbhir nadadbhiśca toyaughair iva sāgaraḥ | śāstrāṇām ca prasannānām carmaṇām varmaṇām tathā ||
jagatsaṃtāpanaḥ krūro ‘garhayan rākṣaseśvaraḥ | taraṇam sāgarasyāsya vikramam balapauruṣam ||
mukhyair yajñair yajanty ete tais tair yat te dvijātayaḥ | juhvaty agnīṃś ca vidhivad vedāṃś coccair adhīyate | abhibhūya ca rakṣāṃsi brahmaghoṣān udairayan ||
āvṛtya rakṣasām tejo dhūmo vyāpya diśo daśa | teṣu teṣu ca deśeṣu puṇyeṣṭyavadhṛtavrataiḥ ||
paścimāyām atha dvāri putram indrajitam tadā | vyādideśa mahāmāyam rākṣasair bahubhir vṛtam ||
naravānararājanau sa ca vāyusutaḥ kapiḥ | jāmbavān ṛkṣarājaś ca rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
gajo gavākṣo kumudo nalo ‘tha panasas tathā | amitraviṣayam prāptāḥ samavetāḥ samarthayan ||
nānāpraharaṇaiḥ śūrair āvṛto rāvaṇātmajaḥ | rākṣasānām sahasrais tu bahubhiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ ||
gajānāṃ daśasahasram rathānām ayutam tathā | hayānām ayute dve ca sāgraṃ koṭīṃ ca rakṣasām ||
rāvaṇāvarajaḥ śrīmān rāmapriyacikīrṣayā | kuberam tu yadā rāma rāvaṇaḥ pratiyuddhyati ||
parikrāmati yaḥ sarvāṃl lokān samtāpayan prajāḥ | tasyāham rākṣasendrasya svayam eva vadhe dhṛtaḥ ||
uttaram nagaradvāram aham saumitriṇā saha | nipīḍyabhipravekṣyāmi sabalo yatra rāvaṇaḥ ||
aham eva saha bhrātrā lakṣmaṇena mahaujasā | ātmanā pañcamaś cāyam sakhā mama vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
vibhīṣaṇam ca dharmajñam anuraktam niśācaram | mantrajññam ca vidhijñam ca ślakṣṇayā parayā girā ||
yena dharmo na vijñāto na vṛttam na kulam tathā | rākṣasyā nīcayā buddhyā yena tad garhitam kṛtam ||
dadṛśuḥ śikhare tasya viṣaktām iva khe purīm | tām śubhām pravaradvārām prākāravaraśobhitām ||
campakāśokabakulaśālatālasamākulā | tamālavanasaṃcannā nāgamālāsamāvṛtā ||
hintālair arjunair nīpaiḥ saptaparṇaiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ | tilakaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca paṭālaiś ca samantataḥ ||
śuśubhe puṣpitāgraiś ca latāparigatair drumaiḥ | lankāṃ bahuvidhair dṛśyair yathendrasyāmarāvatī ||
vicitrakusumopetai raktakomalapallavaiḥ | śādvalaiś ca tathā nīlaiś citrābhir vanarājibhiḥ ||
bhṛngarājābhigītāni bhramaracaritāni ca | koṇālakavighuṣṭāni sārasābhirutāni ca || viviśus te tatas tāni vanāny upavanāni ca ||
śatayojanavistīrṇam vimalam cārudarśanam | ślakṣṇam śrīman mahac caiva duṣprāpam śakunair api ||
caityaḥ sa rākṣasendrasya babhūva purabhūṣaṇam | śatena rakṣasām nityam yaḥ samagreṇa rakṣyate ||
nānāvihagasaṃghuṣṭām nānāmṛganiṣevitām | nānākusumasaṃpannām nānārākṣasasevitām ||
dadarśa laṅkāṃ sunyastāṃ ramyakānanaśobhitām | tasya gopuraśṛṅgasthaṃ rākṣasendraṃ durāsadam ||
śvetacāmaraparyantaṃ vijayaccatraśobhitam | raktacandanasaṃliptaṃ raktābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
śaśalohitarāgeṇa saṃvītaṃ raktavāsasā | saṃdhyātapena saṃchannaṃ megharāśim ivāmbare ||
muṣṭiprahāraiśca talaprahārair | aratnighātaiśca karāgraghātaiḥ | tau cakraturyuddhamasahyarūpaṃ | mahābalau rākṣasavānarendrau ||
maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi sthānāni vividhāni ca | gomūtrakāṇi citrāṇi gatapratyāgatāni ca ||
tīraścīnagatānyeva tathā vakragatāni ca | parimokṣaṃ prahārāṇāṃ varjanaṃ paridhāvanam ||
abhidravaṇam āplāvam avasthānaṃ savigraham | parāvṛttam apāvṛttam apadrutam avaplutam ||
upanyastam apanyastaṃ yuddhamārgaviśāradau | tau viceratur anyonyaṃ vānarendraśca rāvaṇaḥ ||
utpapāta tadākāśaṃ jitakāśī jitaklamaḥ | rāvaṇaḥ sthita evātra harirājena vañcitaḥ ||
bharatēna mahābāhō lakṣmaṇēna yavīyasā śatrughnena ca śatrughna svaśarīrēṇa vā punaḥ ||
hatvā’haṃ rāvaṇaṃ yuddhe saputrabalavāhanam abhiṣicya ca laṅkāyāṃ vibhīṣaṇam athāpi ca ||
bharate rājyam āropya tyakṣye dehaṃ mahābala tam ēvaṃ vādinaṃ rāmaṃ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata ||
tāṃ surair api durdharṣāṃ rāmavākyapracōditāḥ . yathā nideśaṃ sampīḍya nyaviśanta vanaukasaḥ ||
uttaradvāram āsādya yatra tiṣṭhati rāvaṇaḥ . nānyo rāmād dhi tad dvāraṃ samarthaḥ parirakṣitum ||
rāvanādhiṣthitaṃ bhīmaṃ varuṇeneva sāgaram sāyudhai rākṣasair bhīmair abhiguptaṃ samantataḥ . ||
prajaṅghatarasābhyām ca vīrair anyaiś ca saṃgataḥ madhyamē ca svayaṃ gulmē sugrīvaḥ samatiṣṭhata ||
saha sarvair hariśrēṣṭhaiḥ suvarṇapavanōpamaiḥ vānarāṇāṃ tu ṣaṭtriṃśatkōṭyaḥ prakhyātayūthapāḥ ||
tēna śabdēna mahatā saprākārā satōraṇā laṅkā pracalitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā ||
ānantaryam abhiprepsuḥ kramayogārthatattvavit vibhīṣaṇasyānumate rājadharmam anusmaran ||
aṅgadaṃ vālitanayaṃ samāhūyēdam abravīt gatvā saumya daśagrīvaṃ brūhi madvacanāt kape ||
yac ca pāpaṃ kṛta mōhād avaliptēna rākṣasa nūnaṃ tē vigato darpaḥ svayambhuvaradānajaḥ ||
rākṣasā vismayaṃ jagmus trāsaṃ jagmus tathāparē . aparē samare harṣād dharṣam ēvopapēdirē ||
gajō gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gandhamādanaḥ . samantāt paridhāvantō rarakṣur harivāhinīm ||
niryayū rākṣasā vīrā nādayantō diśō daśa . rākṣasā bhīmakarmāṇō rāvaṇasya jayaiṣiṇaḥ ||
vānarāś cāparē bhīmā rākṣasair aparaiḥ saha dvandvaṃ samīyuḥ sahasā yuddhvā ca bahubhiḥ saha ||
sugrīvaḥ saptaparṇēna nijaghāna javena ca. prapīḍya śaravarṣeṇa rakṣasaṃ bhīmadarśanam ||
bhallaiś cānyair gadābhiś ca śaktitōmarasāyakaiḥ apaviddhaiś cāpi rathais tathā sāṃgrāmikair hayaiḥ ||
kālāḥ kāñcanasaṃnāhās tasmiṃs tamasi rākṣasāḥ . sampradṛśyanta śailēndrā dīptauṣadhivanā iva ||
śastrapuṣpōpahārā ca tatrāsīd yuddhamēdinī durjñēyā durnivēśā ca śōṇitāsrāvakardamā ||
tēṣāṃ rāmaḥ śaraiḥ ṣaḍibhiḥ ṣaḍ jaghāna niśācarān nimēṣāntaramātrēṇa śitair agniśikhōpamaiḥ ||
tē tu rāmēṇa bāṇaughaiḥ sarvē marmasu tāḍitāḥ yuddhād apasṛtās tatra sāvaśēṣāyuṣō ‘bhavan ||
sō ‘ntardhānagataḥ pāpō rāvaṇī raṇakarṣitaḥ brahmadattavaro vīro rāvaṇiḥ kroddhamūrcchitaḥ ||
bibhēda samare kruddhaḥ sarvagātrēṣu rāghavau māyayā samvṛtas tatra mōhayan rāghavau yudhi ||
dvivindam ca hanūmantaṃ sānuprasthaṃ mahābalam . ṛṣabhaṃ ca rṣabhaskandham ādidēśa paraṃtapaḥ ||
tau saṃpracalitau vīrau marmabhēdēna karśitau . nipētatur mahēṣvāsau jagatyāṃ jagatīpatī ||
acēṣṭau mandaniḥśvāsau śōṇitena pariplutau . śarajālācitau stabdau śayānau śaratalpagau ||
niḥśvasantau yathā sarpau niścēṣṭau dīnavikramau rudhirasrāvavigdhāṅgau tāpanīyāv iva dhvajau ||
tau vīraśayanē vīrau śayānau mandacēṣṭitau . yūthapaiḥ svaiḥ parivṛtau bāṣpavyākulalōcanaiḥ ||
rāghavau patitau dṛṣṭvā śarajālasamanvitau . babhūvur vyathitāḥ sarvē vānarāḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ ||
krtsnēyaṃ yatkṛtē laṅkā nadī varṣāsv ivākulā sō ‘yaṃ mūlaharo ‘narthaḥ sarvēṣāṃ śamito mayā ||
tam uvāca paritrastaṃ vānarendraṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ sabāṣpavadanaṃ dīnaṃ krodhavyākulalocanaṃ alaṃ trāsena sugrīva bāṣpavego nigṛhyatām ||
evaṃ prāyāni yuddhāni vijayo nāsti naiṣṭhikaḥ sabhāgyaśeṣatāsmākaṃ yadi vīra bhaviṣyati ||
hanumān aṇgadō nīlaḥ suṣēṇaḥ kumudō nalaḥ . gajō gavākṣaḥ panasaḥ sānuprasthō mahāhariḥ ||
vīkṣamāṇā diśaḥ sarvās tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca vānarāḥ . tṛṇēṣv api ca cēṣṭatsu rākṣasā iti mēnirē ||
vidhvastakavacau vīrau vipraviddhaśarāsanau . sāyakaiś channasarvāṅgau śarastambamayau kṣitau ||
śaratalpagatau vīrau tathābhūtau nararṣabhau . duḥkhārtā karuṇaṃ sītā subhṛśaṃ vilalāpa ha ||
sarvē tē vānaraśrēṣṭhāḥ sasugrīvamahābalāḥ . parivārya mahātmānau tasthuḥ śōkapariplutāḥ ||
śarajālacitau vīrāv ubhau daśarathātmajau . śaratalpē mahātmānau śayānau rudhirōkṣitau ||
nēmaṃ mōkṣayituṃ śaktāḥ śarabandhaṃ sudāruṇam . māyābalād indrajitā nirmitaṃ krūrakarmaṇā ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pariṣvajya ca vīryavān . jagāmākāśam āviśya suparṇaḥ pavanō yathā ||
vyaktaṃ sumahatī prītir ētēṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ . tathā hi vipulair nādaiś cukṣubhē lavaṇarṇavaḥ ||
tau ca muktau sughōrēṇa śarabandhēna rāghavau . samutthitau mahābhāgau viṣēduḥ sarvarākṣasāḥ ||
vimuktau śarabandhēna dṛśyētē tau raṇājirē . pāśān iva gajau chitvā gajēndrasamavikramau ||
tad astrabandham āsādya yadi muktau ripū mama . saṃśayastham idaṃ sarvam anupaśyāmy ahaṃ balam ||
parighair bhiṇḍipālaiś ca bhallaiḥ pāśaiḥ paraśvaghaiḥ . niryayū rākṣasā ghorā nardantō jaladā yathā ||
hayaiḥ paramaśīghraiś ca gajaiś caiva madōtkaṭaiḥ . niryayur nairṛtavyāghrā vyāghrā iva durāsadāḥ ||
dhvajāgrē grathitāś caiva nipētuḥ kuṇapāśanāḥ rudhirārdrō mahāñ śvētaḥ kabandhaḥ patitō bhuvi ||
vidāryamāṇā rakṣōbhir vānarās tē mahābalāḥ . amarṣajanitōddharṣāś cakruḥ karmāṇy abhītavat ||
dīrgham uṣṇaṃ viniḥśvasya krōdhēna kaluṣīkṛtaḥ . abravīd rākṣasaṃ krūraṃ vajradaṃṣṭraṃ mahābalam ||
nāgair aśvaiḥ kharair uṣṭraiḥ saṃyuktaḥ susamāhitaḥ . patākādhvajacitraiś ca bahubhiḥ samalaṅkṛtaḥ ||
ṛṣṭibhis tōmaraiś citraiḥ ślakṣṇaiś ca musalair api . bhiṇḍipālaiś ca cāpaiś ca śaktibhiḥ paṭṭisair api ||
niḥsṛtā dakṣiṇadvārād aṅgadō yatra yūthapaḥ tēṣāṃ niṣkramamāṇānām aśubhaṃ samajāyata ||
śrūyatē sumahāṃs tatra ghōrō hṛdayabhēdanaḥ rathanēmisvanas tatra dhanuṣaś cāpi ghoravat ||
jānubhiś ca hatāḥ kēcid bhagnadēhāś ca rākṣasāḥ . śilābhiś cūrṇitāḥ kēcid vānarair yuddhadurmadaiḥ ||
vibhinnaśirasaḥ pētur nikṛttā iva pādapāḥ rathaiś citrair dhvajair aśvaiḥ śarīrair harirakṣasām ||
harayō rākṣasaiś caiva śēratē gāṃ samāśritāḥ . kaṅkagṛdhrabalāḍhyāś ca gōmāyukulasaṃkulāḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā sa rōṣatāmrākṣō vajradaṅṣṭraḥ pratāpavān . pravivēśa dhanuṣpāṇis trāsayan harivāhinīm ||
ūcuḥ khagamṛgāḥ sarvē vācaḥ krūrābhayāvahāḥ sasiṃhopacitkandhaḥ śārdūlasamavikramaḥ ||
uddhataṃ harirakṣōbhiḥ saṃrurōdha diśō daśa anyōnyaṃ rajasā tēna kauśēyōddhatapāṇḍunā ||
śarīraśavasaṃkīrṇā babhūva ca vasuṃdharā drumaśaktigadāprāsaih śilāparighatōmaraiḥ ||
kapīn nijaghnirē tatra śastraiḥ paramadāruṇaiḥ akampanaḥ susaṃkruddhō rākṣasānāṃ camūpatiḥ ||
vidārayanty abhikramya śastrāṇy ācchidya vīryataḥ ētasminn antarē vīrā harayaḥ kumudō nalaḥ ||
adya tṛpyantu māṃsādāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kānanaukasaḥ tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā balādhyakṣāḥ mahābalāḥ ||
mahājaladanirghōṣaṃ sākṣāccandrārkabhāsvaram uragdhvajadurdharṣaṃ suvarūthaṃ svapaskaram ||
śuśruvē śaṅkhaśabdaś ca prayātē vāhinīpatau ninadantaḥ svarān ghōrān rākṣasā jagmur agrataḥ ||
vavṛṣū rudhiraṃ cāsya siṣicuś ca puraḥsarān kētur mūrdhani gṛdhras tu vilīnō dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
nadann ubhayataḥ pārśvaṃ samagrām śriyām āharat sārathēr bhahuśaś cātra saṅgāmam anivartinaḥ ||
vēgitānāṃ samarthānām anyōnyavadhakāṅkṣiṇām . parasparaṃ cāhvayatāṃ ninādaḥ śrūyatē mahān ||
ka ēṣa sumahākāyō balēna mahatā vṛtaḥ . āgacchati mahāvegaḥ kiṃrūpabalapauruṣaḥ ||
dadarśa mahatī sēnā vānarāṇāṃ balīyasām abhisañjātaghōṣāṇāṃ prahastam abhigarjatām ||
dhanūṃṣi ca vicitrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ jayaiṣiṇām pragṛhītāny arājanta vānarān abhidhāvatām ||
hatavīraughavaprāṃ tu bhagnāyuddhamahādrumām śōṇitaughamahātōyāṃ yamasāgaragāminīm ||
yakṛtplīhamahāpaṅkān vikīrṇāntraśaivalām bhinnakāyaśirōmīnām aṅgāvayavaśādvalām ||
gṛdhrahaṃsavarākīrṇāṃ kaṅkasārasasēvitām mēdaḥphēnasamākīrṇām ārtasvananiḥsvanām ||
tāṃ kāpuruṣadustārāṃ yuddhabhūmimayīṃ nadīm nadīm iva ghanāpāyē haṃsasārasasēvitām ||
rākṣasāḥ kapimukhyās te tērus tāṃ dustarāṃ nadīm yathā padmarajōdhvastāṃ naḷinīṃ gajayūthapāḥ ||
nīlāya vyasṛjad bāṇān prahastō vāhinīpatiḥ tē pretya viśikhā nīlaṃ vinirbhidya samāhitāḥ ||
mahīṃ jagmur mahāvēgā roṣitā iva pannagāḥ nīlaḥ śarair abhihatō niśitair jvalanōpamaiḥ ||
vikrāntavijayau vīrau samarēṣv anivartinau . kāṅkṣamāṇau yaśaḥ prāptuṃ vṛtravāsavayōr iva ||
yatraitad indupratimaṃ vibhāticchatraṃ sitaṃ sūkṣmaśalākam agryam . atraiṣa rakṣōdhipatir mahātmā bhūtair vṛtō rudra ivāvabhāti ।।
rathēnātirathaḥ śīghraṃ nīlaṃ pratisamabhyagāt rākṣasānām adhipatir daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān ।।
nīlēna saha saṃyuktaṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasēśvaram . anyēna yudhyamānasya na yuktam abhidhāvanam ।।
ṛṣayō vānarāś caiva nēdur devāś ca sasurāḥ hanūmān atha tējasvī lakṣmaṇaṃ rāvaṇārditam ।।
athārurōha sahasā hanūmantaṃ mahākapim rathasthaṃ rāvaṇaṃ saṃkhyē dadarśa manujādhipaḥ ।।
rōṣēṇa mahatāviṣṭaḥ pūrvavairam anusmaran . ājaghāna śarair dīptaiḥ kālānalaśikhōpamaiḥ ।।
utpatsyati hi madvaṃśo puruṣō rākṣasādhama . yas tvāṃ saputraṃ sāmātyaṃ sabalaṃ sāśvasārathim ।।
nihaniṣyati saṃgrāmē tvāṃ kulādhama durmatē śaptō ‘haṃ vēdavatyā ca yathā sā dharṣitā purā ।।
yathōktās tan mayā prāptaṃ na mithyā ṛṣibhāṣitam ētad ēva samāgamya yatnaṃ kartum ihārhatha ।।
nava sapta daśāṣṭau ca māsān svapiti rākṣasaḥ mantraṃ kṛtvā prasuptō ‘yam itas tu navamē ‘hani ।।
te rāvaṇasamādiṣṭā māmsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ gandhaṃ mālyaṃ mahad bhakṣyam ādāya sahasā yayuḥ ।।
tāṃ praviśya mahādvāraṃ sarvatō yōjanāyatām ।।
kumbhakarṇaguhāṃ ramyāṃ puṣpagandhapravāhinīm ।।
ūrdhvalōmāñcitatanuṃ śvasantam iva pannagam . bhrāmayantam viniḥśvasaiḥ śayānam bhīmavikramam ।।
kāñcanāṅgadanaddhāṇgaṃ kirīṭenārkavarcasam dadṛśur nairṛtavyāghraṃ kumbhakarṇam ariṃdamam ।।
kālē dharmārthakāmānyaḥ saṃmantṟya sacivaiḥ saha . niṣēvēt ātmavāṃl lōkē na sa vyasanam āpnuyāt ।।
tān ahaṃ yōdhayiṣyāmi kubēravaruṇāv api girimātraśarīrasya śitaśūladharasya mē ।।
na mē pratimukhaḥ kaścit sthātuṃ śaktō jijīviṣuḥ naiva śaktyā na gadayā nāsinā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
tataḥ pāsyanti bāṇaughā rudhiraṃ rāghavasya me cintayā tapyasē rājan kimarthaṃ mayi tiṣṭhati ।।
sō ‘haṃ śatruvināśāya tava niryātum udyataḥ muñca rāmād bhayaṃ ghoraṃ nihaniṣyāmi samyugē ।।
na hi rājā na jānīte kumbhakarṇa nayānayau tvaṃ tu kaiśorakād dhṛṣtaḥ kevalaṃ vaktum icchasi ।।
praviśyāśvāsya cāpi tvaṃ sītāṃ rahasi sāntvayan . dhanadhānyaiś ca kāmaiś ca ratnaiś caināṃ pralōbhaya ।।
raktamālyamahādāmaṃ svataś cōdgatapāvakam . ādāya niśitaṃ śūlaṃ śatruśōṇitarañjitam ।।
adya tān kṣudhitaḥ kruddhō bhakṣayiṣyāmi vānarān kumbhakarṇavacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇō vākyam abravīt ।।
bhrātaraṃ saṃpariṣvajya kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam . praṇamya śirasā tasmai pratasthē sa mahābalaḥ ।।
bhindipālāṃś ca parighān gadāś ca musalāni ca . tālskandhāṃś ca vipulān kṣēpaṇīyān durāsadān ।।
dhanuḥśataparīṇāhaḥ sa ṣaṭśatasamucchritaḥ . raudraḥ śakaṭacakrākṣō mahāparvatasannibhaḥ ।।
prayātāś ca gatā harṣaṃ maraṇē kṛtaniścayāḥ . cakruḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ vānarās tyaktajīvitāḥ ।।
kumbhakarṇaḥ prajajvāla krōdhēna mahatā tadā sō ‘bhyadhāvata vēgēna vāliputram amarṣaṇam ।।
pātitaś ca tvayā vīrāḥ kṛtaṃ karma suduṣkaram bhakṣitāni ca sainyāni prāptaṃ te paramaṃ yaśaḥ ||
hanumāṃś cintayām āsa matimān mārutātmajaḥ ēvaṃ gṛhītē sugrīvē kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā bhavēt ।।
nīlāñjanacayaprakhyaḥ sasaṃdhya iva tōyadaḥ . yuddhāyābhimukhō bhīmō manaś cakrē niśācaraḥ ।।
ēṣa dāśarathī rāmas tiṣṭhaty adrir ivācalaḥ iti śrutvā hy anādṛtya lakṣmaṇaṃ sa niśācaraḥ ।।
nikṛttanāsākarṇena vikṣaradrudhireṇa ca . ruddhvā dvāraṃ śarīrēṇa laṅkāyāḥ parvatōpamaḥ ।।
kumbhakarṇas tava bhrātā kākutsthaśarapīḍitaḥ . agaṇḍabhūtō vivṛtō dāvadagdha iva drumaḥ ।।
anūtpētur mahātmānō rākṣasāḥ pravarāyudhāḥ tē virējur mahātmānaḥ kumārāḥ sūryavarcasaḥ ।।
śāradābhrapratīkāśā haṃsāvalir ivāmbarē maraṇaṃ vāpi niścitya śatrūṇāṃ vā parājayam ।।
iti kṛtvā matiṃ vīrā nirjagmuḥ saṃyugārthinaḥ jagarjuś ca praṇēduś ca cikṣipuś cāpi sāyakān ।।
jagṛhuś ca mahātmānō niryātā yuddhadurmadāḥ kṣvēḍitāsphōṭitānāṃ vai saṃcacāleva medinī ।।
dadṛśur vānarānīkaṃ samudyataśilānagam harayō’pi mahātmānō dadṛśu rākṣasaṃ balam ।।
dīptānalaraviprakhyair nairṛtaiḥ sarvatō vṛtam tad dṛṣṭvā balam āyāntaṃ labdhalakṣāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।।
śūlamudgarakhaḍagaiś ca jaghnuḥ prāsaiś ca śaktibhiḥ anyōnyaṃ pātayāmāsuḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ ।।
tāvat prāsahatāḥ pētur vajrakṛttā ivācalāḥ jvalantam prāsam udyamya saṅgrāmāntē narāntakaḥ ।।
sa prāsam āvidhya tadāṅgadāya samujjvalantaṃ sahasōtsasarja . sa vāliputrōrasi vajrakalpē babhūva bhagnō nyapatac ca bhūmau ।।
savisphuliṅgaṃ sajvālaṃ nipapāta girēḥ śiraḥ sa vijṛmbhitam ālōkya harṣād dēvāntako balī ।।
tatō bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ nīlasyōparyapātayat . girau varṣaṃ taḍiccakraṃ sa garjann iva tōyadaḥ ।।
cukōpa paramāmarṣī mattō rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ jagrāhārciṣmatīṃ cāpi gadāṃ sarvāyasīṃ śubhāṃ ।।
hēmapaṭṭaparikṣiptāṃ māṃsaśōṇitaphēnilām . virājamānāṃ vipulāṃ śatruśōṇitatarpitām ।।
pitṛvyau cāpi saṃdṛśya samare saṃnipātitau . yuddhōnmattaṃ ca mattaṃ ca bhrātarau rākṣasarṣabhau ।।
cukōpa ca mahātējā brahmadattavarō yudhi . atikāyō ‘drisaṃkāśō dēvadānavadarpahā ।।
dhvajaśṛṅgapratiṣṭhēna rāhuṇābhivirājatē . sūryaraśmiprabhair bāṇair diśō daśa virājayan ।।
kuṇḍalābhyām ubhābhyām ca bhāti vaktraṃ subhīṣaṇam. punarvasvantaragataṃ paripūrṇo niśākaraḥ ।।
ēṣō ‘tikāyō balavān rākṣasānām atha rṣabhaḥ . sa rāvaṇasutō dhīmān dēvadānavadarpahā ।।
muhūrtamātraṃ niḥsaṃjñō hy abhavac chatrutāpanaḥ tataḥ saṃjñām upālabhya caturbhiḥ sāyakōttamaiḥ ।।
ētē mahābalā vīrā rākṣasā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ jētāraḥ parasainyānāṃ parair nityāparājitāḥ ।।
sasainyās te hatā vīrā rāmēṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā . rākṣasāḥ sumahākāyā nānāśastraviśāradāḥ ।।
tau bhrātarau tadā baddhau ghorair dattavaraiḥ śaraiḥ yan na śakyaṃ suraiḥ sarvair asurair vā mahābalaiḥ ।।
śarabandhād vimuktau tau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau yē yōdhā nirgatāḥ śūrā rākṣasā mama śāsanāt ।।
taṃ prasthitaṃ mahātmānam anujagmur mahābalāḥ . samharṣamāṇā bahavō dhanuḥpravarapāṇayaḥ ।।
gajaskandhagatāḥ kēcit kēcit paramavājibhiḥ vyāghravṛścikamārjārakharōrōṣṭraiś ca bhujaṅgamaiḥ ।।
ghōrair dattavarais tīkṣṇair niṣprāṇān akarōt tadā anyān api tadā mukhyān vānarān bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
hṛṣṭaḥ sa parayā prītyā dadarśa kṣatajōkṣitām punarēva mahātējā rākṣasēndrātmajō balī ।।
hanūmantaṃ ca sugrīvam aṅgadaṃ gandhamādanam . jāmbavantaṃ suṣēṇaṃ ca vēgadarśinam ēva ca ।।
maindaṃ ca dvividaṃ nīlaṃ gavākṣaṃ gavayaṃ tathā . kēsariṃ harilōmānaṃ vidyuddaṃṣṭraṃ ca vānaram ।।
sūryānanaṃ jyōtimukhaṃ tathā dadhimukhaṃ harim . pāvakākṣaṃ nalaṃ caiva kumudaṃ caiva vānaram ।।
prasaiḥ śūlaiḥ śitair bāṇair indrajin mantrasaṃhitaiḥ . vivyādha hariśārdūlān sarvāṃs tān rākṣasōttamaḥ ।।
patitaiḥ parvatākārair vānarair abhisaṃvṛtām . śastraiś ca patitair dīptair dadṛśātē vasundharām ।।
maindaṃ nalaṃ jyōtimukhaṃ dvividaṃ cāpi vānaram . vibhīṣaṇō hanūmāṃś ca dadṛśātē hatān raṇē ।।
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā jāmbavān ṛkṣapuṃgavaḥ . kṛcchrād abhyudgiran vākyam idaṃ vacanam abravīt ।।
[ārurōha tadā tasmād dharir malayaparvatam . mērumandarasaṃkāśaṃ nānāprasravaṇākulam ।।
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ vikāsikamalōtpalam . sēvitaṃ dēvagandharvaiḥ ṣaṣṭiyōjanam ucchritam ।।
vidyādharair munigaṇair apsarōbhir niṣēvitam . nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ bahukandaraśōbhitam ।।
sarvān ākulayaṃs tatra yakṣagandharvakinnarān . hanumān mēghasaṃkāśō vavṛdhē mārutātmajaḥ ।।
yē hanyantē raṇē tatra rākṣasāḥ kapikuñjaraiḥ . hatā hatās tu kṣipyantē sarva ēva tu sāgarē ।।
vividhān astrasaṃghātān agnir dahati tatra vai nānāvidhān gṛhāṃś citrān dadāha hutabhuk tadā ।।
āvāsān rākṣasānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gṛhagṛdhnunām hemacitratanutrāṇāṃ sragbhāṇḍāmbaradhāriṇām || R_6,062.
sīdhupānacalākṣāṇāṃ madavihvalagāminām kāntālambitavastrāṇāṃ śatrusaṃjātamanyunām R_6,062.
gadāśūlāsihastānāṃ khādatāṃ pibatām api śayaneṣu mahārheṣu prasuptānāṃ priyaiḥ saha R_6,062.
trastānāṃ gacchatāṃ tūrṇaṃ putrān ādāya sarvataḥ teṣāṃ śatasahasrāṇi tadā laṅkānivāsinām R_6,062.
adahat pāvakas tatra jajvāla ca punaḥ punaḥ sāravanti mahārhāṇi gambhīraguṇavanti ca R_6,062.
hemacandrārdhacandrāṇi candraśālottamāṇi ca tatra citragavākṣāṇi sādhiṣṭhānāni sarvaśaḥ R_6,062.
nāditāny acalābhāni veśmāny agnir dadāha saḥ jvalanēna parītāni tōraṇāni cakāśirē ।।
davāgnidīptāni yathā śikharāṇi mahāgirēḥ vimānēṣu prasuptāś ca dahyamānā varāṅganāḥ ।।
yaś ca vō vitathaṃ kurvāt tatra tatra apy upasthitaḥ . sa hantavyō ‘bhisaṃplutya rājaśāsanadūṣakaḥ ।।
patākādhvajasaṃyuktam uttamāsiparaśvadham . bhīmāśvarathamātaṅgaṃ nānāpattisamākulam ।।
dīptaśūlagadākhaḍagaprāsatōmarakārmukam . tad rākṣasabalaṃ bhīmaṃ ghōravikramapauruṣam ।।
dadṛśē jvalitaprāsaṃ kiṅkiṇīśatanāditam . hēmajālācitabhujaṃ vyāvēṣṭitaparaśvadham ।।
vyāghūrṇitamahāśastraṃ bāṇasaṃsaktakārmukam . gandhamālyamadhūtsēkasaṃmōditamahānilam ।।
taruśailair abhighnantō muṣṭibhiś ca niśācarān tathaivāpatatāṃ tēṣāṃ kapīnām niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
kṣurakṣurapranārācair vatsadantaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ . karṇiśalyavipāṭhaiś ca bahubhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
prajaṅghas tu mahāvīro yūpākṣasahitō balī . gadayābhiyayau kruddō vāliputraṃ mahābalam ।।
nipātitamahāvīrāṃ dṛṣṭvā rakṣaścamūṃ tadā . kumbhaḥ pracakrē tējasvī raṇē karma suduṣkaram ।।
śilāpādapavarṣāṇi tasya mūrdhni vavarṣa ha sa pracicchēda tān sarvān bibhēda ca punaḥ śilāḥ ।।
bhruvau vivyādha bāṇābhyām ulkābhyām iva kuñjaram tasya susrāva rudhiraṃ pihitē cāsya lōcanē ।।
abhidudrāva sugrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇātmajaṃ raṇe śailasānucaraṃ nāgaṃ vēgavān iva kēsarī ।।
vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmān mahāsattvō na vivyathē sa vidhyamānaḥ sahasā sahamānas tu tāñ charān ।।
ēkas tvam anujātō ‘si pitaraṃ balavattaram tvām ēvaikaṃ mahābāhuṃ śūlahastam ariṃdamam ।।
dhanuṣīndrajitas tulyaḥ pratāpe rāvanasya ca tvam adya rakṣasāṃ loke ṣṛeṣṭho’si balavīryataḥ ।।
anyōnyagātragrathitau gharṣantāv itarētaram . sadhūmāṃ mukhatō jvālāṃ visṛjantau pariśramāt ।।
nikumbhō bhūṣaṇair bhāti tēna sma parighēṇa ca . yathēndradhanuṣā mēghaḥ savidyutstanayitnumān ।।
parivārya mahākāyā mahākāyaṃ kharātmajam . abhijaghnus tatō hṛṣṭāś cālayantō nabhastalām ।।
pāśamudgaradaṇḍaiś ca nirghātaiś cāparais tathā kadanaṃ kapisiṃhānāṃ cakrus te rajanīcarāḥ R_6,066.
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ sarvā bhayārtā vidrutā diśaḥ vibhrāmya ca mahac chūlaṃ prajvalantaṃ niśācaraḥ R_6,066.
kupitaś ca tadā tatra kiṃ karyam iti cintayan ādideśātha saṃkruddho raṇāyendrajitaṃ sutam R_6,067.
parikliṣṭaikavasanām amṛjāṃ rāghavapriyām rajomalābhyām āliptaiḥ sarvagātrair varastriyam R_6,068.
kiṃ samarthitam asyeti cintayan sa mahākapiḥ saha tair vānaraśreṣṭhair abhyadhāvata rāvaṇim R_6,068.
śatrūṇāṃ kadanam cakrur neduś ca vividhaiḥ svanaiḥ vānarais tair mahābhīmair ghorarūpā niśācarāḥ R_6,069.
na dharmeṇa viyujyeran nādharmarucayo janāḥ dharmeṇa caratāṃ teṣaṃ tathā dharmaphalaṃ bhavet R_6,070.
so 'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ rāghavaṃ śokalālasaṃ vānarāṃś cāpi dadṛśe bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇān R_6,071.
nikumbhilāyāṃ saṃprāptaṃ hantuṃ rāvaṇim āhave dhanurmaṇḍalanirmuktair āśīviṣaviṣopamaiḥ R_6,072.
varo datto mahābāho sarvalokeśvareṇa vai ity evaṃ vihito rājan vadhas tasyaiṣa dhīmataḥ R_6,072.
jāmbavenarkṣapatinā saha sainyena saṃvṛtaḥ jahi taṃ rākṣasasutaṃ māyābalasamanvitam R_6,072.
sa rākṣasānāṃ tat sainyaṃ kālāgnir iva nirdahan cakāra bahubhir vṛkṣair niḥsaṃjñaṃ yudhi vānaraḥ R_6,073.
śitaśūladharāḥ śūlair asibhiś cāsipāṇayaḥ śaktihastāś ca śaktibhiḥ paṭṭasaiḥ paṭṭasāyudhāḥ R_6,073.
parighaiś ca gadābhiś ca kuntaiś ca śubhadarśanaiḥ śataśaś ca śataghnībhir āyasair api mudgaraiḥ R_6,073.
ghoraiḥ paraśubhiś caiva bhiṇḍipālaiś ca rākṣasāḥ muṣṭibhir vajravegaiś ca talair aśanisaṃnibhaiḥ R_6,073.
abhijaghnuḥ samāsādya samantāt parvatopamam teṣām api ca saṃkruddhaś cakāra kadanaṃ mahat R_6,073.
ete doṣā mama bhrātur jīvitaiśvaryanāśanāḥ guṇān pracchādayāmāsuḥ parvatān iva toyadāḥ R_6,074.
mahāpramāṇam udyamya vipulaṃ vegavad dṛḍham dhanur bhīmabalo bhīmaṃ śarāṃś cāmitranāśanān R_6,075.
mumoca ca śarān ghorān saṃgṛhya narapuṃgavaḥ abhītavadanaḥ kruddho rāvaṇiṃ lakṣmaṇo yudhi R_6,076.
tatakṣatur mahātmānau raṇakarmaviśaradau babhūvatuś cātmajaye yat tau bhīmaparākramau R_6,076.
tayor atha mahān kālo vyatīyād yudhyamānayoḥ na ca tau yuddhavaimukhyaṃ śramaṃ vāpy upajagmatuḥ R_6,076.
tayor yuddhaṃ draṣṭakāmo varacāpadharo balī śūraḥ sa rāvaṇabhrātā tasthau saṃgrāmamūrdhani R_6,077.
jambumalī mahāmalī tīkṣṇavego ‘śaniprabhaḥ suptaghno yajñakopaś ca vajradaṃṣtraś ca rākṣasaḥ R_6,077.
saṃhrādī vikaṭo ‘righnas tapano manda eva ca praghāsaḥ praghasaś caiva prajaṅgho jaṅgha eva ca R_6,077.
agniketuś ca durdharśo raśmiketuś ca vīryavān vidyujjihvo dvijihvaś ca sūryaśatruś ca rākṣasaḥ R_6,077.
akampanaḥ supārśvaś ca cakramālī ca rākṣasaḥ kampanaḥ sattvavantaś ca devāntakanarāntakau R_6,077.
rakṣasāṃ kadanaṃ cakre durāsādaḥ sahasraśaḥ R_ sa dattvā tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ pitṛvyasyendrajid balī R_6,077.
antarikṣe 'bhisaṃpanne na rūpāṇi cakāśire lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇiṃ prāpya rāvaṇiś cāpi lakṣmaṇam R_6,077.
mahendrāśanikalpena sūtasya vicariṣyataḥ sa tena bāṇāśaninā talaśabdānunādinā R_6,077.
lāghavād rāghavaḥ śrīmāñ śiraḥ kāyād apāharat sa yantari mahātejā hate mandodarīsutaḥ R_6,077.
svayaṃ sārathyam akarot punaś ca dhanur aspṛśat tad adbhutam abhūt tatra sārathyaṃ paśyatāṃ yudhi R_6,077.
adhiṣṭhitaṃ hayajñēna sūtēnāptōpadēśinā . ārurōha mahātējā rāvaṇiḥ samatiñjayaḥ ।।
pātayāmāsa bāṇaughaiḥ śataśō ‘tha sahasaraśaḥ sa maṇḍalīkṛtadhanū rāvaṇiḥ samitiṃjayaḥ ।।
śirō jahāra dharmātmā bhallēnānataparvaṇā asūtās tē hayās tatra ratham ūhur avikalavāḥ ।।
maṇḍalāny abhidhāvanti tad adbhutam ivābhavat amarṣavaśam āpannaḥ saumitrir dṛḍhavikaramaḥ ।।
raṇāgre samaraślāghī triśṛṅga iva parvataḥ sa tathāpy ardito bāṇai rākṣasena tadā mṛdhe R_6,078.
śūlāni ca bhuśuṇḍyaś ca gadāḥ khaḍgāḥ paraśvadhāḥ tad dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaḥ saṃkhye ghoram astraṃ pratyavārayat R_6,078.
durāvāraṃ durviṣamaṃ rākṣasānāṃ bhayāvaham āśīviṣaviṣaprakhyaṃ devasaṃghaiḥ samarcitam R_6,078.

[saṃdhāyāmitradalanaṃ vicakarṣa śarāsanam sajyam āyamya durdharśaḥ kālo lokakṣaye yathā saṃdhāya dhanuṣi śreṣṭhe vikarṣann idam abravīt] lakṣmīvāṃl lakṣmaṇo vākyam arthasādhakam ātmanaḥ dharmātmā satyasaṃdhaś ca rāmo dāśarathir yadi pauruṣe cāpratidvandvas tadainaṃ jahi rāvaṇim R_6,078.
ājagāma tataḥ śīghraṃ yatra sugrīvarāghavau vibhīṣaṇam avaṣṭabhya hanūmantaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaḥ R_6,079.
upaveśya tam utsaṅge pariṣvajyāvapīḍitam bhrātaraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ snigdhaṃ punaḥ punar udaikṣata R_6,079.
mūrdhni cainam upāghrāya bhūyaḥ saṃspṛśya ca tvaran uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyam āśvāsya puruṣarṣabhaḥ R_6,079.
chinno hi dakṣiṇo bāhuḥ sa hi tasya vyapāśrayaḥ vibhīṣaṇahanūmadbhyāṃ kṛtaṃ karma mahad raṇe R_6,079.
balavyūhena mahatā niryāsyati hi rāvaṇaḥ balavyūhena mahatā śrutvā putraṃ nipātitam R_6,079.
ye cāpy anyo 'tra yudhyanti saśalyā vraṇinas tathā te 'pi sarve prayatnena kriyatāṃ sukhinas tathā R_6,079.
putraśokaṇkulo dīno vilalāpākulendriyaḥ hā rākṣasacamūmukhya mama vatsa mahābala R_6,080.
mandarasyāpi śṛṅgāṇi kiṃ punar lakṣmaṇaṃ yudhi adya vaivasvato rājā bhūyo bahumato mama R_6,080.
adya tūryaśatair bhīmaṃ dhanur utthāpyatāṃ mama rāmalakṣmaṇayor eva vadhāya paramāhave R_6,080.
rāvaṇaḥ putraśokena bhṛśam ākulacetanaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ khaḍgam ādāya sahasā yatra maithilī R_6,080.
taṃ niśāmya sanistriṃśaṃ vyathitā janakātmajā nivāryamāṇaṃ bahuśaḥ suhṛdbhir anivartinam R_6,080.
so 'yaṃ mām anupasthāne vyaktaṃ nairāśyam āgataḥ krodhamohasamāviṣṭo vyaktaṃ māṃ hantum udyataḥ R_6,080.
vidhamiṣyati māṃ raudro rākṣasaḥ pāpaniścayaḥ hanūmatas tu tadvākyaṃ na kṛtaṃ kṣudrayā mayā R_6,080.
etasminn antare tasya amātyaḥ śīlavāñ chuciḥ supārśvo nāma medhāvī rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasāṃ varam nivāryamāṇaḥ sacivair idaṃ vacanam abravīt R_6,080.
iti te rākṣasāḥ sarve rāmasya sadṛśān raṇe anyonyaṃ kupitā jaghnuḥ sādṛśyād rāghavasya tu R_6,081.
divyāstraguṇaparyantaṃ nighnantaṃ yudhi rākṣasān dadṛśū rāmacakraṃ tat kālacakram iva prajāḥ R_6,081.
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi sārohāṇāṃ ca vājinām pūrṇe śatasahasre dve rākṣasānāṃ padātinām R_6,081.
divasasyāṣṭabhāgena śarair agniśikhopamaiḥ hatāny ekena rāmeṇa rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpiṇām R_6,081.
jāmbavantaṃ hariśreṣṭhaṃ maindaṃ dvividam eva ca etad astrabalaṃ bhīmaṃ mama vā tryambakasya vā R_6,081.
tāni nāgasahasrāṇi sārohāṇi ca vājinām rathānāṃ tv agnivarṇānāṃ sadhvajānāṃ sahasraśaḥ R_6,082.
nihatāni śarair dīpais taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ rāvaṇena prayuktāni rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā R_6,082.
vidhavā hataputrāś ca krośantyo hatabāndhavāḥ rākṣasyaḥ saha saṃgamya duḥkhārtāḥ paryadevayan R_6,082.
rākṣasānāṃ vināśāya dūṣaṇasya kharasya ca cakārāpratirūpā sā rāghavasya pradharṣaṇam R_6,082.
mahodaraṃ mahāpārśvaṃ virūpākṣaṃ ca rākṣasaṃ śīghraṃ vadata sainyāni niryāteti mamājñayā R_6,083.
asibhiḥ paṭṭasaiḥ śūlair gadābhir musalair halaiḥ śaktibhis tīkṣṇadhārābhir mahadbhiḥ kūṭamudgaraiḥ R_6,083.
yaṣṭibhir vividhaiś cakrair niśitaiś ca paraśvadhaiḥ bhiṇḍipālaiḥ śataghnībhir anyaiś cāpi varāyudhaiḥ R_6,083.
athānayan balādhyakṣāś catvāro rāvaṇājñayā rathānām niyutaṃ sāgraṃ nāgānāṃ niyutatrayam R_6,083.
aśvānāṃ ṣaṣṭikotyas tu kharoṣṭrāṇaṃ tathaiva ca padātayas tv asaṃkhyātā jagmus te rājaśāsanāt R_6,083.
balādhyakṣāś ca saṃstāpya rājñaḥ senāṃ purasthitām etasminn antare sūtaḥ sthāpayāmāsa taṃ ratham R_6,083.
divyāstravarasaṃpannaṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitam nānāyudhasamākīrṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālasaṃyutam R_6,083.
nānāratnaparikṣiptaṃ ratnastambhair virājitaṃ jambūnadamayaiś caiva sahasrakalaśair vṛtam R_6,083.
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasāḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ R_6,083.
tataś cāsīn mahānādas tūryāṇāṃ ca tatas tataḥ mṛdaṅgaiḥ paṭahaiḥ śaṅkhaiḥ kalahaiḥ saha rākṣasām R_6,083.
āgato rākṣasāṃ rājā chatracāmarasaṃyutaḥ sītāpaharī durvṛtto brahmaghno devakaṇṭakaḥ yoddhuṃ raghuvareṇeti śuśruve kalahadhvaniḥ R_6,083.
tena nādena mahatā pṛthivī samakampata taṃ śabdaṃ sahasā śrutvā vānarā dudruvur bhayāt R_6,083.
rāvaṇas tu mahābāhuḥ sacivaiḥ parivāritaḥ ājagāma mahātejā jayāya vijayaṃ prati R_6,083.
virūpākṣaḥ svakaṃ nāma dhanvī viśrāvya rākṣasaḥ rathād āplutya durdharṣo gajaskandham upāruhat R_6,084.
ārṣabhaṃ carma khaḍgaṃ ca pragṛhya laghuvikramaḥ bhartsayann iva sugrīvam āsasāda vyavasthitam R_6,084.
naipuṇyān mocayitvainaṃ muṣṭinorasi tāḍayat tatas tu saṃkruddhataraḥ sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ R_6,084.
tato ‘nyaṃ pātayat krodhāc chaṅkhadeśe mahātalam mahendrāśanikalpena talenābhihataḥ kṣitau R_6,084.
ājaghāna gadāṃ tasya parigheṇa harīśvaraḥ papāta tarasā bhinnaḥ parighas tasya bhūtale R_6,085.
aṅgadasya camūṃ bhīmāṃ kṣobhayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ sa vānarāṇāṃ mukhyānām uttamāṅgāni rākṣasaḥ R_6,086.
pātayām āsa kāyebhyaḥ phalaṃ vṛntād ivānilaḥ keṣāṃ cid iṣubhir bāhūṃś cichedātha sa rākṣasaḥ R_6,086.
viṣādavimukhāḥ sarve babhūvur gatacetasaḥ niśamya balam udvignam aṅgado rākṣasārditam R_6,086.
pragṛhya giriśṛṅgābhāṃ kruddhaḥ sa vipulāṃ śilām aśvāñ jaghāna tarasā babhañja syandanaṃ ca tam R_6,086.
dvābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ saṃgṛhya bhrāmayitvā ca vegavān mahāpārśvāya cikṣepa vadhārthaṃ vālinaḥ sutaḥ R_6,086.
āviveśa mahān krodho rāvaṇaṃ tu mahāmṛdhe sūtaṃ saṃcodayām āsa vākyaṃ cedam uvāca ha R_6,087.
dvividaś caiva maindaś ca aṅgado gandhamādanaḥ hanūmāṃś ca suṣeṇaś ca sarve ca hariyūthapāḥ R_6,087.
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā viṣṇunā vāsavaṃ yathā ālikhantam ivākāśam avaṣṭabhya mahad dhanuḥ R_6,087.
padmapatraviśālākṣaṃ dīrghabāhum ariṃdamam tato rāmo mahātejāḥ saumitrisahito balī R_6,087.
mumoca ca mahātejāś cāpam āyamya vīryavān tāñ śarān rākṣasendrāya cikṣepācchinnasāyakaḥ R_6,087.
īhāmṛgamukhāṃś cāpi vyāditāsyān bhayāvahān pañcāsyāṃl lelihānāṃś ca sasarja niśitāñ śarān R_6,087.
etāṃś cānyāṃś ca māyābhiḥ sasarja niśitāñ śarān rāmaṃ prati mahātejāḥ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan R_6,087.
vidyujjihvopamāṃś cāpi sasarja vividhāñ śarān te rāvaṇaśarā ghorā rāghavāstrasamāhatāḥ R_6,087.
lakṣmaṇāya samuddiśya jvalantīm iva tejasā rāvaṇaḥ paramakruddhaś cikṣepa ca nanāda ca R_6,088.
arditāś caiva bāṇaughais te pravekeṇa rakṣasām saumitreḥ sā vinirbhidya praviṣṭā dharaṇītalam R_6,088.
pāpātmāyaṃ daśagrīvo vadhyatāṃ pāpaniścayaḥ kāṅkṣitaṃ catakasyeva gharmānte meghadarśanam R_6,088.
so 'yam adya raṇe pāpaś cakṣurviṣayam āgataḥ cakṣurviṣayam āgatya nāyaṃ jīvitum arhati R_6,088.
sa dattvā tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ visṛjann eva bāṇaughān suṣeṇaṃ vākyam abravīt R_6,089.
upālambhaṃ na śakṣyāmi soḍhuṃ dattaṃ sumitrayā | kiṃ nu vakṣyāmi kausalyāṃ mātaraṃ kiṃ nu kaikayīm ||
bharataṃ kiṃ nu vakṣyāmi śatrughnaṃ ca mahābalam | saha tena vanaṃ yāto vinā tenāgataḥ katham ||
ihaiva maraṇaṃ śreyo na tu bandhuvigarhaṇam | kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ karma kṛtam anyatra janmani ||
yena me dhārmiko bhrātā nihataś cāgrataḥ sthitaḥ hā bhrātar manujaśreṣṭha śūrāṇām pravara prabho ||
ekākī kiṃ nu māṃ tyaktvā paralokāya gacchasi vilapantaṃ ca māṃ bhrātaḥ kimarthaṃ nāvabhāṣase ||
uttiṣṭha paśya kiṃ śeṣe dīnaṃ māṃ paśya cakṣuṣā śokārtasya pramattasya parvateṣu vaneṣu ca ||
viṣaṇṇasya mahābāho samāśvāsayitā mama rāmam evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ tu śokavyākulitendriyam ||
āśvāsayann uvācedaṃ suṣeṇaḥ paramaṃ vacaḥ tyajemāṃ naraśārdūla buddhiṃ vaiklavyakāriṇīm ||
śokasaṃjananīṃ cintāṃ tulyāṃ bāṇaiś camūmukhe | naiva pañcatvamāpanno lakṣmaṇo lakṣmivardhanaḥ ||
na hysya vikṛtaṃ vaktraṃ na ca śyāmatvam āgatam | suprabhan ca prasannaṃ ca mukham asyābhilakṣyatām ||
padmaraktatalau hastau suprasanne ca locane | nedṛśaṃ dṛśyate rūpaṃ gatāsūnāṃ viśāṃ pate ||
samīpastham uvācedaṃ hanūmantaṃ mahākapim | saumya śīghram ito gatvā parvataṃ hi mahodayam ||
pūrvaṃ hi kathito yo ‘sau vīra jāmbavatā tava | dakṣiṇe śikhare jātām mahauṣadhim ihānaya ||
plullanānātarugaṇaṃ samutpāṭya mahābalaḥ | gṛhītvā hariśārdūlo hastābhyāṃ samatolayat
taruṇādityasaṅkāśo vaidūryamayakūbaraḥ | sadaśvaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍair yuktaḥ śvetaprakīrṇakaiḥ
haribhiḥ sūryasaṅkāśair hemajālavibhūṣitaiḥ | rukmaveṇudhvajaḥ śrīmān devarājaratho varaḥ
devarājena saṃdiṣṭo ratham āruhya mātaliḥ | abhyavartata kākutstham avatīrya triviṣṭapāt
aindrān api jaghānāśvāñ śarajālena rāvaṇaḥ viṣedur devagandharvacāraṇā dānavaiḥ saha R_6,090.
rāmacandramasaṃ dṛṣṭvā grastaṃ rāvaṇarāhuṇā prājāpatyaṃ ca nakṣatraṃ rohiṇīṃ śaśinaḥ priyām R_6,090.
utpapāta tadā kruddhaḥ spṛśann iva divākaram śastravarṇaḥ suparuṣo mandaraśmir divākaraḥ R_6,090.
dadṛśus te tadā yuddhaṃ lokasaṃvartasaṃsthitam nānāpraharaṇair bhīmaiḥ śūrayoḥ saṃprayudhyatoḥ R_6,091.
etasminn antare krodhād rāghavasya сa rāvaṇaḥ prahartukāmo duṣṭātmā spṛśan praharaṇaṃ mahat R_6,091.
vajrasāraṃ mahānādaṃ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam śailaśṛṅganibhaiḥ kūṭaiś cittadṛṣṭibhayāvaham R_6,091.
sadhūmam iva tīkṣṇāgraṃ yugāntāgnicayopamam atiraudram anāsādyaṃ kālenāpi durāsadam R_6,091.
trāsanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dāraṇaṃ bhedanaṃ tathā pradīpta iva roṣeṇa śūlaṃ jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ R_6,091.
bāṇadhārāsahasrais tu sa toyada ivāmbarāt rāghavaṃ rāvaṇo bāṇais taṭākam iva pūrayan R_6,092.
vimuktam iva māyābhir astrair iva bahiṣkṛtam mām avajñāya durbuddhe svayā buddhyā viceṣṭase R_6,093.
daivataiś ca samāgamya draṣṭum abhyāgato raṇam | upagamyābravīd rāmam agastyo bhagavāṃs tadā
sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | cintāśokapraśamanam āyurvardhanam uttamam
rāvaṇaṃ prekṣya hṛṣṭātmā jayārthaṃ samupāgamat | sarvayatnena mahatā vṛtas tasya vadhe ‘bhavat
sārathiḥ sa ratham hṛṣṭaḥ parasainyapradharṣaṇam | gandharvanagarākāraṃ samucchritapātākinam
grasantam iva cākāśaṃ nādayantaṃ vasuṃdharām | praṇāśaṃ parasainyānāṃ svasainyasya praharṣaṇam
rāvaṇasya rathaṃ kṣipraṃ codayāmāsa sārathiḥ | tam āpatantaṃ sahasā svanavantaṃ mahādhvajam
dīpyamānam ivākāśe vimānaṃ sūryavarcasaṃ | taḍitpatākāgahanaṃ darśitendrāyudhaprabham
girer vajrābhimṛṣṭasya dīryataḥ sadṛśasvanam | vispārayan vai vegena bālacandrānataṃ dhanuḥ
uvāca mātaliṃ rāmaḥ sahasrākṣasya sārathim | mātale paśya saṃrabdham āpatantaṃ rathaṃ ripoḥ
parasparābhimukhayor dṛptayor iva siṃhayoḥ
samutpetur athotpātā dāruṇā lomaharṣaṇāḥ
rāvaṇasya vināśāya rāghavasyodāyāya ca
saṃpradīpto bhavat krodhād amarśāt pradahann iva | sa roṣavaśamāpannaḥ śaravarṣaṃ vavarṣa ha
babhūvuḥ svasthahṛdayāḥ padmanālair ivāhatāḥ | teṣām asambhramaṃ dṛṣṭvā vājināṃ rāvaṇas tadā
prahasanniva kākutsthaḥ saṃdadhe niśitān śarān | sa mumoca tato bāṇān śataśo ‘tha sahasraśaḥ
śarabaddham ivābhāti dvitīyaṃ bhāsvad ambaram | nānimitto ‘bhavad bāṇo nānirbhettā na niṣphalaḥ
darśayantau bahuvidhāṃ sūtau sārathyajāṃ gatim | ardayan rāvaṇaṃ rāmo rāghavaṃ cāpi rāvaṇaḥ
patākāśca patākābhiḥ samīyuḥ sthitayos tadā | rāvaṇasya tato rāmo dhanurmukaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
jagāma na vikāram ca na cāpi vyathito ‘bhavat | cikṣepa ca punar bāṇān vajrasārasamasvanān
sārathiṃ vajrahastasya samādiśya daśānanaḥ | mātales tu mahāvegāḥ sarīre patitāḥ śarāḥ
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ | cintām āpedire sarve sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ
evaṃ japanto ‘paśyaṃs te devāḥ sarṣigaṇās tadā | rāmarāvaṇayor yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam
rāmarāvaṇayor yuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayor iva | evaṃ bruvanto dadṛśus tad yuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇam
rāvaṇasya śiro ‘cchindac chrīmaj jvalitakuṇḍalam | tac chiraḥ patitaṃ bhūmau dṛṣṭaṃ lokais tribhis tadā
mārgaṇair bahubhir yuktaś cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ | mārīco nihato yais tu kharo yaistu sadūṣaṇaḥ
na ime sāyakāḥ sarve yuddhe prātyayikā mama | kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ yena rāvaṇe mandatejasaḥ
rāvaṇo ‘pi tataḥ kruddho rathastho rākṣaseśvaraḥ | gadāmusalavarṣeṇa rāmaṃ pratyardayad raṇe
yaṃ tasmai prathamaṃ prādād agastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ | brahmadattaṃ mahābāṇam amoghaṃ yudhi vīryavān
abhimantrya tato rāmas taṃ maheṣuṃ mahābalaḥ | vedaproktena vidhinā saṃdadhe kārmuke balī
gataḥ setuḥ sunītānāṃ gato dharmasya vigrahaḥ | gataḥ sattvasya saṃkṣepah suhastānāṃ gatir gatā
sa tasya vākyaiḥ karuṇair mahātmā | saṃbodhitaḥ sādhu vibhīṣaṇena | ājñāpayāmāsa narendrasūnuḥ | svargīyam ādhānam adīnasattvaḥ
āryaputreti vādinyo hā nātheti ca sarvaśaḥ | paripetuḥ kabandhāṅkāṃ mahīṃ śoṇitakardamām
gandharvāṇām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām | bhayaṃ yena raṇe dattaṃ so ‘yaṃ śete raṇe hataḥ
mahābalaṃ mahāvīryaṃ devaśatruṃ mahaujasam | vyaktam eṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātanaḥ
anādimadhyanidhano mahataḥ paramo mahān | tamasaḥ paramo dhātā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīr ajayaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ | mānuṣaṃ rūpam āsthāya viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ
sarvaiḥ parivṛto devair vānaratvam upāgataiḥ | sarvalokeśvaraḥ śrīmāṃl lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
smaradbhir iva tadvairam indriyair eva nirjitaḥ | yadaiva hi janasthāne rākṣasair bahubhir vṛtaḥ
sītāṃ dharṣayatā mānyāṃ tvayā hy asadṛśaṃ kṛtam | vasudhāyā hi vasudhāṃ śriyaḥ śrīṃ bhartṛvatsalām
aprāpya taṃ caiva kāmaṃ maithilīsaṃgame kṛtam | pativratāyās tapasā nūnaṃ dagdho ‘si me prabho
śubhakṛc chubham āpnoti pāpakṛt pāpam aśnute | vibhīṣaṇaḥ sukhaṃ prāptas tvaṃ prāptaḥ pāpam īdṛśam
santy anyāḥ pramadās tubhyaṃ rūpeṇābhyadhikās tataḥ | anaṅgavaśam āpannas tvaṃ tu mohān na budhyase
alpapuṇyā tv ahaṃ ghore patitā śokasāgare | kailāse mandare merau tathā caitrarathe vane
devodyāneṣu sarveṣu vihṛtya sahitā tvayā | vimānenānurūpeṇa yā yāmy atulayā śriyā
saivānyevāsmi saṃvṛttā dhig rāñjāṃ cañcalām śriyam hā rājan sukumāraṃ te subhru sutvaksamunnasam
kāntiśrīdyutibhis tulyam indupadmadivākaraiḥ | kirīṭakūṭojjvalitaṃ tāmrāsyaṃ dīptakuṇḍalam
madavyākulalolākṣaṃ bhūtvā yat pānabhūmiṣu | vividhasragdharaṃ cāru valgusmitakathaṃ śubham
tadevādya tavaivaṃ hi vaktraṃ na bhrājate prabho | rāmasāyakanirbhinnaṃ raktaṃ rudhiravisravaiḥ
yā mayāsīn na saṃbuddhā kadācid api mandayā | pitā dānavarājo me bhartā me rākṣaseśvaraḥ
kathaṃ bhayam asaṃbuddhaṃ mānuṣād idam āgatam | snigdendranīlanīlaṃ tu prāṃśuśailopamaṃ mahat
keyūrāṅgadavaidūryamuktāhārasragujjvalam | kāntaṃ vihāreṣv adhikaṃ dīptaṃ saṃgrāmabhūmiṣu
bhāty ābharaṇabhābhir yad vidyudbhir iva toyadaḥ | tadevādya śarīraṃ te tīkṣṇair naikaśaraiś citam
punar durlabhasaṃsparśaṃ pariṣvaktuṃ na śakyate | śvāvidhaḥ śalalair yuktaṃ lagnair bāṇair nirantaram
svarpitair marmasu bhṛśaṃ saṃchinnasnāyubandhanam | kṣitau nipatitaṃ rājan śyāmaṃ vai rudhiracchavi
iha kasmāt prāsupto ‘si dharaṇyāṃ reṇuguṇṭhitaḥ | yadā te tanayaḥ śasto lakṣmaṇenendrajid yudhi
dīnāṃ vilapatīṃ mandāṃ kiṃ vā māṃ nābhibhāṣase | dṛṣṭvā na khalv abhikruddho mām ihānavaguṇṭhitām
na cainam āśvāsayasi kiṃ vā na bahumanyase | yās tvayā vidhavā rājan kṛtā naikāḥ kulastriyaḥ
tvayā viprakṛtābhiś ca tadā śaptas tadāgatam | pravādaḥ satyam evāyaṃ tvāṃ prati prāyaśo nṛpa
tat tu bhāgyaviparyāsān nūnaṃ te pakvalakṣaṇam | atītānāgatārthajño vartamānavicakṣaṇaḥ
ayaṃ rākṣasamukhyānāṃ vināśaḥ paryupasthitaḥ | kāmakrodhasamutthena vyasanena prasaṅginā
yātudhānasya dauhitrīṃ kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase | uttiṣṭhottiṣṭa kiṃ śeṣe nave paribhave kṛte
paryavasthāpayāmāsū rudantyo rudatīṃ bhṛśam | kiṃ te na viditā devi lokānāṃ sthitir adhruvā
vimṛśya buddhyā praśritaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam | tyaktadharmavrataṃ krūraṃ nṛśaṃsam anṛtaṃ tathā
nāham arhāmi saṃskartuṃ paradārābhimarśanam | bhrātṛrūpo hi me śatrur eṣa sarvāhite rataḥ
avaśyaṃ tu kṣamaṃ vācyo mayā tvaṃ rākṣaseśvara | adharmānṛtasaṃyuktaḥ kāmam eṣa niśācaraḥ
mahātmā balasampanno rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ | maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṃ naḥ prayojanam
rāvanasyāgnihotraṃ tu niryāpayati satvaram | śakaṭān dārurūpāṇi agnīn vai yājakāṃs tathā
tato mālyavatā sārdhaṃ kriyām eva cakāra saḥ | sauvarṇīṃ śibikāṃ divyām āropya kṣaumavāsasam
patākābhiś ca citrābhiḥ sumanobhiś ca citritām | utkṣipya śibikāṃ tāṃ tu vibhīṣaṇapurogamāḥ
pṛṣṭhato ‘nuyayus tāni plavamānāni sarvataḥ | rāvaṇam prayate deśe sthāpya te bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ
paristaraṇīkāṃ rājño ghṛtāktāṃ samaveśayan | gandhair mālyair alaṃkṛtya rāvaṇaṃ dīnāmānasāḥ
udakena ca saṃmiśrān pradāya vidhipūrvakam | tāḥ striyo ‘nunayāmāsa sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ
anurāgaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca saumitrer lakṣmaṇasya ca | pativratātvam sītāyā hanūmati parākramam
anujñāya mahābāhur mātaliṃ pratyapūjayat | rāghaveṇābhyanujñāto mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ
divyaṃ taṃ ratham āsthāya divam evotpapāta ha | tasmiṃs tu divam āruḍhe sarathe rathināṃ varaḥ
pūjyamāno harigaṇair ājagāma balālayam | athovāca sa kākutsthaḥ samīpaparivartinam
ājahrur atha saṃtuṣṭāḥ paurās tasmai niśācarāḥ | sa tān gṛhītvā durdharṣo rāghavāya nyavedayat
praviśya ca purīṃ laṅkām anujñāpya vibhīṣaṇam | tatas tenābhyanujñāto hanūmān vṛkṣavāṭikām
saṃpraviśya yathānyāyam sītāyā vidito hariḥ | dadarśa mṛjayā hīnāṃ sātaṅkām rohiṇīm iva
vaidehi kuśalī rāmaḥ sasugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ | kuśalaṃ tvāha siddhārtho hataśatrur ariṃdamaḥ
labdho ‘yaṃ vijayaḥ sīte svasthā bhava gatajvarā | rāvaṇaś ca hataḥ śatrur laṅkā caiva vaśīkṛtā
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ sthairyaṃ vinītatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | ete cānye ca bahavo guṇās tvyayyeva śobhanāḥ
iha śrutā mayā devi rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ | asakṛt paruṣair vākyair vadantyo rāvaṇājñayā
rākṣasyo dāruṇakathā varam etaṃ prayaccha me | muṣṭibhiḥ pārṣṇighātaiś ca viśālaiś caiva bāhubhiḥ
nipātya hantum icchāmi tava vipriyakāriṇīḥ | evaṃ prahārair bahubhir saṃprahārya yaśasvini
vidheyānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ kaḥ kupyed vānarottama | bhāgyavaiṣamyadoṣeṇa purastād duśkṛtena ca
mayaitet prāpyate sarvaṃ svakṛtaṃ hy upabhujyate | maiva vada mahābāho daivī hy eṣā parā gatiḥ
āropya śibikāṃ sītāṃ rākṣasair vahanocitaiḥ | rakṣasair bahubhir guptām ājahāra vibhīṣaṇaḥ
rakṣatā tu mayā vṛttam apavādam ca sarvataḥ | prakhyātasyātmavaṃśasya nyaṅgaṃ ca parimārjatā
ṣaḍardhanayanaḥ śrīmān mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ | kartā sarvasya lokasya brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ
ete sarve samāgamya vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ | āgamya nagarīṃ laṅkām abhijagmuś ca rāghavam
dikṣu sarvāsu gagane parvateṣu nadīṣu ca | sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmān śataśīrṣaḥ sahasradṛk
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma amoghas tava saṃstavaḥ | amoghās te bhaviṣyanti bhaktimanto narā bhuvi
tad idaṃ nas tvayā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
nihato rāvaṇo rāma prahṛṣṭo divam ākrama | amoghaṃ deva vīryaṃ te na te moghāḥ parākramāḥ
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma amoghas tava saṃstavaḥ | amoghās te bhaviṣyanti bhaktimanto narā bhuvi
ye tvāṃ devam dhruvaṃ bhaktāḥ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam | prāpnuvanti tathā kāmān iha loke paratra ca
akliṣṭamālyābharaṇāṃ tathārūpām aninditām | dadau rāmāya vaidehīm aṅke kṛtvā vibhāvasuḥ
prāpya rājyam ayodhyāṃ ca nandayitvā suhṛjjanam | ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule vaṃśaṃ sthāpayitvā mahābala
iṣṭvā turagamedhena prāpya cānuttamaṃ yaśaḥ | brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā tridivaṃ gantum arhasi
mahādevavacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ | vimānaśikharasthasya praṇāmam akarot pituḥ
āropyāṅke mahābāhur varāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ | bāhubhyāṃ sampariṣvajya tato vākyaṃ samādade
babhūvur vānarāḥ sarve kiṃ tv etad iti vismitāḥ | kākutthsaṃ paripūrṇārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve surottamāḥ
maithilīṃ sāntvayasvainām anuraktāṃ yaśasvinīm | bhrātaraṃ bharataṃ paśya tvacchokād vratacāriṇam
alaṃkāravidaś caitā nāryaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇāḥ | upasthitās tvāṃ vidhivat snāpayiṣyanti rāghava
hṛtaṃ nirjitya samgrāme kāmagaṃ divyam uttamam | tvadarthaṃ pālitaṃ cedaṃ tiṣṭhaty atulavikrama
kausalyāṃ ca sumitrām ca kaikeyīṃ ca yaśasvinīm | guham ca suhṛdaṃ caiva paurān janapadaiḥ saha
evamuktastu rāmeṇa rākṣasendro vibhīṣanaḥ | vimānaṃ sūryasamkāśamājuhāva tvarānvitaḥ
tataḥ kāñcanacitrāṅgaṃ vaidūryamaṇivedikam | kūṭāgāraiḥ parikṣiptaṃ  sarvato rajataprabham
pāṇḍurābhih patākābhir dhvajaiśca samalaṃkṛtam | kāñcanaṃ kāñcanair harmyair hemapadmavibhūṣitaiḥ
prakīrṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālair muktāmaṇigavākṣakam | ghaṇṭājālaiḥ parikṣiptam sarvato madhurasvanam
taṃ meruśikharākāraṃ nirmitam viśvakarmaṇā | bṛhadbirbhūṣitaṃ harmyair muktārajataśobhitaiḥ
talaih sphaṭikacitrāṅgair vaidūryaiś ca varāsanaiḥ | mahārhastaraṇopetair upapannaṃ mahādhanaiḥ
kumbhakarṇo ‘tra nihataḥ prahastaś ca niśācaraḥ | dhūmrākṣaś cātra nihato vānareṇa hanūmatā
akampanaśca nihato balino ‘nye ca rākṣasāḥ | triśirāś cātikāyaś ca devāntakanarāntakau
vajradaṃṣṭraś ca daṃṣṭraś ca bahavo rākṣasā hatāḥ | makarākṣaś ca durdharṣo mayā yudhi nipātitaḥ
yatra sāgaram uttīrya tāṃ rātrim uṣitā vayam | eṣa setur mayā baddhaḥ sāgare lavaṇārṇave
atra pūrvaṃ mahādevaḥ prasādam akarot prabhuḥ | etat tu dṛśyate tīrthaṃ sāgarasya mahātmanaḥ
abravīt praśritaṃ vākyaṃ rāmaṃ praṇayasādhvasā | sugrīvapriyabhāryābhis tārāpramukhāto nṛpa
vimānaṃ prekṣya sugrīvaṃ vākyam etad uvāca ha | brūhi vānaraśārdūla sarvān vānarapuṅgavān
atra yojanabāhuś ca kabandho nihato mayā | dṛśyate ‘sau janasthāne sīte śrīmān vanaspatiḥ
yatra tvaṃ rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt | eṣā godāvarī ramyā prasannasalilā śubhā
upayātaḥ sahasrākṣo yatra śakraḥ puraṃdaraḥ | ete te tāpasā devi dṛśyante tanumadhyame
atra sīte tvayā dṛṣṭā tāpasī dharmacāriṇī | asau sutanu śailendraś citrakūṭaḥ prakāśate
padātiṃ tyaktasarvasvaṃ pitṛnirdeśakāriṇam | sarvabhogaiḥ parityaktaṃ svargacyutam ivāmaram
dṛṣṭvā tu karuṇā pūrvaṃ mamāsīt samitiṃjaya | kaikeyīvacane yuktaṃ vanyamūlaphalāśinam
mārīcadarśanaṃ caiva sītonmathanam eva ca | kabandhadarśanaṃ caiva pampābhigamanaṃ tathā
sugrīveṇa ca te sakhyaṃ yatra vālī hatas tvayā | mārgaṇaṃ caiva vaidehyāḥ karma vātātmajasya ca
viditāyāṃ ca vaidehyāṃ nalasetur yathā kṛtaḥ | yathā cādīpitā laṅkā prahṛṣṭair hariyūthapaiḥ
saputrabāndavāmātyaḥ sabalaḥ sahavāhanaḥ | yathā ca nihataḥ saṃkhye rāvaṇo baladarpitaḥ
yathā ca nihate tasmin rāvaṇe devakaṇṭake | samāgamaś ca tridaśair yathā dattaś ca te varaḥ
sarvam mamaitad viditaṃ tapasā dharmavatsala | saṃpatanti ca me śiṣyāḥ pravṛttyākhyāḥ purīm itaḥ
abhavan pādapās tatra svargapādapasaṃnibhāḥ | niṣphalāḥ phalinaś cāsan vipuṣpāḥ puṣpaśālinaḥ
śṛṅgaverapuraṃ prāpya guham āsādya vīryavān | sa vācā śubhayā hṛṣṭo hanūmān idam abravīt
prajāś ca bahusāhasrīḥ sphītān janapadān api | sa gatvā dūram adhvānaṃ tvaritaḥ kapikuñjaraḥ
strībhiḥ saputraiḥ paitraiś ca ramamāṇaiḥ svalaṃkṛtaiḥ | krośamātre tv ayodhyāyāś cīrakṛṣṇājināmbaram
dadarśa bharataṃ dīnaṃ kṛśam āśramavāsinam | jaṭilaṃ maladigdhāṅgaṃ bhrātṛvyasanakarśitam
phalamūlāśinaṃ dāntaṃ tāpasaṃ dharmacāriṇam | samunnatajaṭābhāraṃ valkalājinavāsasaṃ
niyataṃ bhāvitātmānaṃ brahmarṣisamatejasaṃ | pāduke te puraskṛtya praśāsantaṃ vasundharām
caturvarṇyasya lokasya trātāraṃ sarvato bhayāt | upasthitam amātyaiś ca śucibhiś ca purohitaiḥ
paribhoktuṃ vyavasyanti paurā vai dharmavatsalāḥ | taṃ dharmam iva dharmajñaṃ devabandham ivāparam
gavāṃ śatasahasraṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ ca śataṃ param | sakuṇḍalāḥ śubhācārā bhāryāḥ kanyās tu ṣoḍaśa
hemavarṇāḥ sunāsorūḥ śaśisaumyānanāḥ striyaḥ | sarvābharaṇasampannā sampannā kulajātibhiḥ
yathā pravrajito rāmo mātur dattau varau tava | yathā ca putraśokena rājā daśaratho mṛtaḥ
yathā dūtais tvam ānītas tūrṇaṃ rājagṛhāt prabho | tvayāyodhyāṃ praviṣṭena yathā rājyaṃ na cepsitam
citrakūṭagiriṃ gatvā rājyenāmitrakarśanaḥ | nimantritas tvayā bhrātā dharmamācaratā satām
sthitena rājño vacane yathā rājyaṃ visarjitam | āryasya pāduke gṛhya yathāsi punarāgataḥ
sarvam etan mahābāho yathāvad viditaṃ tava | tvayi pratiprayāte tu yad vṛttaṃ tan nibodha me
pragṛhya khaḍgaṃ ciccheda karṇanāse mahābalaḥ tatas tenārditā bālā rāvaṇaṃ samupāgatā
pragṛhya sahasā sītāṃ jagāmāśu sa rākṣasaḥ | tatas tv adbhutasaṅkāśāḥ sthitāḥ parvatamūrdhani
acintayantī vaidehī hyaśokavanikāṃ gatā | nyavartata tadā rāmo mṛgaṃ hatvā tadā vane
ṛśyamūkaṃ giriṃ gatvā sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ | tayoḥ samāgamaḥ pūrvaṃ prītyā hārdo vyajāyata
mayā ca punarāgamya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | abhijñānaṃ mayā dattam arciṣmān sa mahāmaṇiḥ
taiś ca dattavaraḥ śrīmān ṛṣibhiś ca samāgataiḥ | surarṣibhiśca kākutstho varāṃllebhe paraṃtapaḥ
rājadārās tathāmātyāḥ sainyāḥ senāgaṇāṅganāḥ | brāhmaṇāś ca sarājanyāḥ śreṇimukhyās tathā gaṇāḥ
abhiniryāntu rāmasya draṣṭuṃ śaśinibhaṃ mukham | bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā śatrughnaḥ paravīrahā
viṣṭīr anekasāhasrīś codayāmāsa bhāgaśaḥ | samīkuruta nimnāni viṣamāṇi samāni ca
rājamārgam asambādhaṃ kirantu śataśo narāḥ | tatas tacchāsanaṃ śrutvā śatrughnasya mudānvitāḥ
turagāṇāṃ sahasraiś ca mukhyair mukhyatarānvitaiḥ | padātīnāṃ sahastraiśca vīrāḥ parivṛtā yayuḥ
dvijātimukhyair dharmātmā śreṇīmukhyaiḥ sanaigamaiḥ | mālyamodakahastaiśca mantribhir bharato vṛtaḥ
śaṅkhabherīninādaiśca bandibhiś cābhivanditaḥ | āryapādau gṛhītvā tu śirasā dharmakovidaḥ
pāṇḍuraṃ chatram ādāya śuklamālyopaśobhitam | śukle ca vālavyajane rājārhe hemabhūṣite
upavāsakṛśo dīnaś cīrakṛṣṇājināmbaraḥ | bhrātur āgamanaṃ śrutvā tatpūrvaṃ harṣam āgataḥ
pratyudyayau tadā rāmaṃ mahātmā sacivaiḥ saha | aśvānāṃ kharaśabdaiś ca rathanemisvanena ca
arthyaṃ vijñāpayann eva bharataṃ satyavikramam | sadāphalān kusumitān vṛkṣān prāpya madhusravān
sasainyasya tadātithyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam | niḥsvanaḥ śrūyate bhīmaḥ prahṛṣṭānāṃ vanaukasām
taruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ vimānaṃ rāmavāhanam | dhanadasya prasādena divyam etan manojavam
yathā ca ropito vṛkṣo jātaś cāntarniveśane | mahān api durāroho mahāskandhaḥ praśākhavān
śīryeta puṣpito bhūtvā na phalāni pradarśayet | tasya nānubhaved arthaṃ yasya hetoḥ sa ropitaḥ
viśodhitajaṭaḥ snātaś citramālyānulepanaḥ | mahārhavasanopetas tasthau tatra śriyā jvalan
pitur bhavanam āsādya praveśya ca mahātmanaḥ | kausalyāṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca kaikeyīm abhivādya ca
nadīśatānāṃ pañcānāṃ jalaṃ kumbhair upāharan | pūrvāt samudrāt kalaśaṃ jalapūrṇam athānayat
ājahāra sa dharmātmānilaḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ | tatas tair vānaraśreṣṭhair ānītaṃ prekṣya taj jalam
abhyaṣiñcan naravyāghraṃ prasannena sugandhinā | salilena sahasrākṣaṃ vasavo vāsavaṃ yathā
sarvauṣadhirasaiś cāpi daivatair nabhasi sthitaiḥ | caturbhir lokapālaiś ca sarvair devaiś ca saṃgataiḥ
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ pūrvaṃ kirīṭaṃ ratnaśobhitam | abhiṣiktaḥ purā yena manus taṃ dīptatejasam
tasyānvavāye rājānaḥ kramād yenābhiṣecitāḥ | sabhāyāṃ hemaklṛptāyāṃ śobhitāyāṃ mahādhanaiḥ
ratnair nānāvidhaiś caiva citritāyāṃ suśobhanaiḥ | nānāratnamaye pīṭhe kalpayitvā yathāvidhi
kirīṭena tataḥ paścād vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā | ṛtvigbhir bhūṣaṇaiś caiva samayokṣyata rāghavaḥ
chatraṃ tasya ca jagrāha śatrughnaḥ pāṇḍuraṃ śubham | śvetaṃ ca vālavyajanaṃ sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ
sugrīvāya srajaṃ divyāṃ prāyacchan manujādhipaḥ | vaidūryamaṇicitre ca vajraratnavibhūṣite
avekṣamāṇā vaidehī pradadau vāyusūnave | avamucyānmanaḥ kaṇṭhād dhāraṃ janakanandinī
pradehi subhage hāraṃ yasya tuṣṭāsi bhāmini | atha sā vāyuputrāya taṃ hāram asitekṣaṇā
yathārhaṃ pūjitāḥ sarve kāmai ratnaiśca puṣkalaiḥ | prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve jagmur eva yathāgatam
tato dvividamaindābhyāṃ nīlāya ca paraṃtapaḥ | sarvān kāmaguṇān vīkṣya pradadau vasudhādhipaḥ
yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā loke naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate | putrakāmaś ca putrān vai dhanakāmo dhanāni ca
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta dīrgham ayur avapnuyāt praṇamya śirasā nityaṃ śrotavyaṃ kṣatriyair dvijāt

b_only.text: तस्यदाशरथे: पार्श्वे शूरास्ते कपिकुङजराः । तोर्णमापुप्लुवु स्सर्वे सदश्वा इव चोदिताः ।।6.4.41।।
तमङ्गदगतो रामं लक्ष्मणश्शुभया गिरा । उवाच परिपूर्णार्थ: स्मृतिमान् प्रतिभानवान् ।।6.4.44।।
प्रास्पोटयंश्च पुच्छानि सन्निजग्मु: पदान्यपि । भुजावनिक्षिप्य शैलांश्च द्रुमानन्ये बभञ्जिरे ।।6.4.66।।

गिरिप्रस्थेषु रम्येषु सर्वत सम्प्र पुष्पिताः । केतकस्सिन्दुवाराश्च वासन्त्यश्च मनोरमाः ।।6.4.79।। माधव्यो गन्धपूर्णाश्च कुन्दगुल्माश्च पुष्पिताः । चिरिबिल्वा मधूकाश्च वञ्जुला प्रियकास्तथा ।।6.4.80।। सुफूर्जकास्तिलकाश्चैव नागवृक्षाश्च पुष्पिताः । चूताः पाटलयकाश्चैव कोविदाराश्च पुष्पिताः ।।6.4.81।। मुचुलिन्दार्जुनाश्चैव शिंशुपाः कुटजास्तथा । धवा श्शाल्मलयश्चैव रक्ता: कुरवकास्तथा ।।6.4.82।। हिन्तालास्तिनिशाश्चैव चूर्णका नीपकास्तथा । नीलाशोकाश्च वरणा अङ्कोलाः पद्मकास्तथा ।।6.4.83।। प्लवमानै: प्लवंगैस्तु सर्वे पर्याकुलीकृतां ।।6.4.84।।

वाप्यस्तस्मिन् गिरौ शिता: पल्वलानि तथैव च । चक्रवाकानुचरिताः कारण्डवनिषेविताः ।।6.4.85।। प्लवैः क्रौञ्चेश्च सङ्कीर्णा वराहमृग सेविताः । ऋक्षैस्तरक्षुभिस्सिम्हैश्शार्दूलैश्च भयावहैः ।।6.4.86।। व्यालैश्च बहुभिर्भीमै स्सेव्यमाना स्समन्ततः । पद्मैस्सौगन्दिकैः पुल्लैः कुमुदैश्चोत्पलैस्तथा ।।6.4.87।। वारिजैर्विविधैः पुष्पै रम्यास्तत्र जलाशयाः ।
द्रोणमात्रप्रमाणानि लम्बमानानि वानराः । ययुः पिबन्त हृष्टास्ते मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः ।।6.4.91।।

ततोनिकुम्भोरभसस्सूर्यशत्रुर्महाबलः । सुप्तघ्नोयज्ञहारक्षोमहापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।।6.9.1।। अग्निकेतुश्चदुर्धर्षोरश्मिकेतुश्चराक्षस: । इन्द्रजिच्चमहातेजाबलवान्रावणात्मजः ।।6.9.2।। प्रहस्तोऽथविरूपाक्षोवज्रदंष्ट्रोमहाबलः । धूम्राक्षश्चातिकायश्चदुर्मुखश्चैवराक्षसः ।।6.9.3।। परिघान्पट्टिशान्प्रासान्शक्तिशूलपरश्वधान् । चापानिचसबाणानिखङ्गांश्चविपुलान्शितान् ।।6.9.4।। प्रगृह्यपरमक्रुद्धास्समुत्पत्यचराक्षसाः । अब्रुवन्रावणंसर्वेप्रदीप्ताइवतेजसा ।।6.9.5।।
न मृथोयंमहाबाहो लक्ष्मणोलक्षमिवर्धन: । न चास्यविक्रतंवक्त्रानापिशस्वासं न निष्प्रभं ।।6.102.18।।
सुप्रभंसुप्रसन्नं च मुखमस्यनिरीक्ष्यताम् ।।6.102.19।। पद्मपत्रतलौहस्तौसुप्रसन्ने च लोचने ।

ततःकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गःकिङ्किणीशतभूषितः ।।6.103.10।। तरुणादित्यसङ्काशोवैदूर्यमयकूबरः । सदश्वैःकाञ्चनापीडैर्युक्तश्श्वेतप्रकीर्णकैः ।।6.103.11।। हरिभिःसूर्यसङ्काशैर्हेमजालविभूषितैः । रुक्मवेणुध्वज्श्रीमन्देवराजरथोवरः ।।6.103.12।। देवराजेनन्दिष्टोरथमारुह्यमातलिः । अभ्यवर्ततकाकुत्स्थमवतीर्यत्रिवष्टपात् ।।6.103.13।।

एतस्मिन्नन्तरेक्रोधाद्राघवस्य स रावणः । प्रहर्तुकामोदुष्टात्मास्पृशन् प्रहरणंमहत् ।।6.104.9।। वज्रसारंमहानादंसर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् । शैलशृङ्गनिभैःकूटैश्चित्तदृष्टिभयावहम् ।।6.104.10।। सधूममिवतीक्ष्णाग्रंयुगान्ताग्निचमोपमम् । अतिरौद्रमनासाद्यंकालेनापिदुरासदम् ।।6.104.11।। त्रासनंसर्वभूतानांदारणंभेदनंतथा । प्रदीप्तमिवरोषेणशूलंजग्राहरावणः ।।6.104.12।।
प्रयुध्यमानौसमरेमहाबलौ शितैःशरैरावणलक्ष्मणाग्रजौ । ध्वजावपातेन स राक्षसाधिपो भृशंप्रचुक्रोधतदारघूत्तमे ।।6.109.29।।
यदैव च जनस्थानेराक्षसैर्भहुनिर्ववृतः । खरस्तवहतोभ्रातातदैवासौ न मानुषः ।।6.114.9।।

व्यक्तमेषमहायोगीपरमात्मासनातनः । अनादिमध्यनिधनोमहतंपरमोमहान् ।।6.114.14।। तमसःपरमोधाताशङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । श्रीवत्सवक्षानित्यश्रीरजय्यश्शाश्वतोध्रुवः ।।6.114.15।। मानुषंरूपमास्थायविष्णुस्सत्यपराक्रमः । सर्वैःपरिवृतोदेवैर्वानरत्वमुपागतैः ।।6.114.16।। सर्वलोकेश्वर्श्रीमान्लोकानांहितकाम्यया । सराक्षसरपरीवारंहतवांस्त्वांमहाद्युतिः ।।6.114.17।।

हाराजन् सुकुमारंतेसुभ्रुसुत्वक्समुन्नसम् ।।6.114.34।। कान्तिश्रीद्युतिभिस्तुल्यमिन्दुपद्मदिवाकरैः । किरीटकूटोज्ज्वलितंताम्रास्यंदीप्तकुण्डलम् ।।6.114.35।। मदव्याकुललोलाक्षंभूत्वायत्पानभूमिषु । विविधस्रग्धरंचारुवल्गुस्मितकथंशुभम् ।।6.114.36।। तदेवाद्यतवैवंहिवक्त्रं न भ्राजतेप्रभो । रामसायकनिर्भिन्नंरक्तंरुधिरविस्रवैः ।।6.114.37।। वीशीर्णमेदोमस्तिष्कंरूक्षस्यन्दनरेणुभिः ।

स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलंतुप्रांशुशैलोपमंमहत् ।।6.114.42।। केयूराङ्गदवैडूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम् । कान्तंविहारेष्वधिकंदीप्तांसङ्ग्रामभूमिषु ।।6.114.43।। भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिवतोयदः । तदेवाद्यशरीरंतेतीक्ष्णैर्नैकशरैश्चितम् ।।6.114.44।। पुनर्दुर्लभसम्पर्शंपरिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते । श्वाविधःशलकैर्यद्वद्भाणैर्लग्नैर्निरन्तरम् ।।6.114.45।। स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसुभृशंसञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् । क्षितौनिपतितंराजन् श्यामंवैरुधिरच्छवि ।।6.114.46।। वज्रप्रहाराभिहतोविकीर्णइवपर्वतः ।

एवमुक्तस्तुरामेणराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः । विमानसूर्यसङ्काशमाजुहावत्वरान्वितः ।।6.124.23।। ततःकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गंवैदूर्यमणिवेदिकम् । कूटागारैःपरिक्षिप्तंसर्वतोरजतप्रभम् ।।6.124.24।। पाण्डुराभिःपताकाभिर्ध्वजैश्चसमलङ्कृतम् । शोभितंकाञ्चनैर्हर्म्यैर्हेमपद्मविभूषितैः ।।6.124.25।। प्रकीर्णंकिङ्किणीजालैर्मुक्तामणिगवाक्षकम् । घण्टाजालैःपरिक्षिप्तंसर्वतोमधुरस्वनम् ।।6.124.26।। यन्मेरुशिखराकारंनिर्मितंविश्वकर्मणा । बृहभिर्भूषितंहर्म्यैर्मुक्तारजतशोभितैः ।।6.124.27।। तलैस्स्फटिकचित्राङ्गैदूर्यैश्चवरासनैः । महार्हास्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नंमहाधनैः ।।6.124.28।।

मारीचदर्शनंचैवसीतोन्मधनमेव च । कबन्धदर्शनंचैवसम्पाभिगमनंतथा ।।6.127.11।। सुग्रीवेण च तेसख्यंयथावालीहतस्त्वया । मार्गणंचैववैदेह्याःकर्मवातात्मजस्य च ।।6.127.12।। विदितायां च सीतायांनलसेतुर्यथाकृतः । यथाचादीपितालङ्काप्रहृष्टैर्हरियूथपैः ।।6.127.13।। सपुत्रबान्दवामात्यःसबलःसहावाहनः । यथा च निहतःसंख्येरावणोबलदर्पितः ।।6.127.14।। यथा च निहतेतस्मिन् रावणेदेवकण्टके । समागमश्चत्रिदशैर्यथादत्तश्चतेवरः ।।6.127.15।। सर्वंममैतद्विदितंतपसाधर्मवत्सल । सम्पतन्ति च मेशिष्याःप्रवृत्ताख्याःपुरीमितः ।।6.127.16।।

क्रोशमात्रेत्वयोध्यायाचशीरकृष्णाजिनम्बरम् ।।6.128.29।। ददर्शभरतंदीनंकृशमाश्रमवासिनम् । जटिलंमलदिग्धाङ्गंभ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितम् ।।6.128.30 । फलमूलाशिनंदान्तंतापसंधर्मचारिणम् । समुन्नतजटाभारंवल्कलाजिनवाससम् ।।6.128.31।। नियतंभावितात्मानंब्रह्मर्षिसमतेजसम् । पादुकेतेपुरस्कृत्यप्रशासन्तंवसुन्धराम् ।।6.128.32 । चातुर्वर्णस्यलोकस्यत्रातारंमहतोभयात् । उपस्थितममात्यैश्चशुचिभिश्चपुरोहितैः ।।6.128.33।। बलमुख्यैश्चयुक्तैश्चकाषायाम्बरदारिभिः ।

यथाप्रव्राजितोरामोमातुर्दत्तौवरौतव । यथापुत्रशोकेनराजादशरथोमृतः ।।6.129.5।। यथादूतैस्त्वमानीतस्तूर्णंराजगृहात्प्रभो । त्वयायोध्यांप्रविष्टेनयथाराज्यं न चेप्सितम् ।।6.129.6।। चित्रकूटगिरिंगत्वाराज्येनामित्रकर्शनः । निमन्त्रितस्त्वयाभ्राताधर्ममाचरतासताम् ।।6.129.7।। स्थितेनराज्ञोवचनेयथाराज्यंविसर्जितम् । आर्यस्यमादुकेगृह्ययथासिपुनरागतः।।य6.129.8।। सर्वमेतन्महाबाहोयथावद्विदितंतव । त्वयिप्रतिप्रयातेतुयद्वृत्तंतन्निबोधमे ।।6.129.9।।

द्विजातिमुख्यैर्धर्मात्माश्रेणीमुख्यैस्सनैगमैः ।।6.130.16।। माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्चमन्त्रिभिर्भरतोवृतः । शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्चवन्दिभिश्चाभिवनन्दितः ।।6.130.17।। आर्यपादौगृहीत्वातौशिरसाधर्मकोविदः । पाण्डुरंछत्रमादायशुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम् ।।6.130.18।। शुक्ले च वालव्यजनेराजार्हेहेमभूषिते । उपवासकृशोदीनश्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः ।।6.130.19।। भ्रातुरागमनंश्रुत्वातत्पूर्वंहर्षमागतः । प्रत्युद्ययौतदारामंमहात्मासचिवैस्सह ।।6.130.20।।

ब्रह्मणानिर्मितंपूर्वंकिरीटंरत्नशोभितम् ।।6.131.64।। अभिषिक्तःपुरायेवमनुस्तंदीप्ततेजसम् । तस्यान्ववायेराजानःक्रमाद्येनाभिषेचिताः ।।6.131.65।। सभायांहेमक्लुप्तायांशोभितायांमहाधनैः । रत्नैर्नानाविधैश्चवचित्रितायांसुशोभनैः ।।6.131.66।। नानारत्नमयेपीठेकल्पयित्वायथाविधि । किरीटेनततःपश्चाद्वसिष्ठेनमहात्मना ।।6.131.67।। ऋत्विगिमभगिर्भूषणैश्चैवसमयोक्ष्यतराघवः ।

असत्याचपुनस्सव्यंज्याघातविगतत्वचम् । दक्षिणोदक्षिणंबाहुंमहापरिघसन्निभम् ।।6.21.7।। गोसहस्रप्रदारंमुपधायमहत्भुजम् । अद्यमेमरणंवादतरणंसागरस्यवा ।।6.21.8।। तिरामोमतिंकृत्वामहाबाहुर्महोदधिम् । अधिशिश्येचविधिवत्प्रयतोनियतोमुनिः ।।6.21.9।।

बाहूप्रगृह्ययःपद् भ्यांमहींगच्छतिवीर्यवान् । लङ्कामभिमुखःक्रोधादभीक्ष्णंचविजृम्भते ।।6.26.14।। गिरिशृङ्गप्रतीकाशःपद्मकिञ्जल्कसन्निभः । स्पोटयत्यभिसंरब्धोलाङ्गूलंचपुनःपुनः ।।6.26.15।। यस्यलाङ्गूलशब्देनस्वनन्तिप्रदिशोदश । एषवानरराजेनसुग्रीवेणाभिषेचितः ।।6.26.16।। यौवराज्येऽङ्गदोनामत्वामाह्वयतिसंयुगे ।।6.26.17।।

यःपुरागोमतीतीरेरम्यंपर्येतिपर्वतम् । नाम्नासङ्कोचनोनामनानानगयुतोगिरिः ।।6.26.27।। तत्रराज्यंप्रशास्त्येषकुमुदोनामयूथपः । योऽसौशतसहस्राणिसहस्रंपरिकर्षति ।।6.26.28।। यस्यवालाबहुव्यामादीर्घलाङ्गूलमाश्रिता । ताम्रापीतास्सीताश्श्वेताःप्रकीर्णाघोरदर्शना ।।6.26.29।। अदीनोरोषणश्चण्डस्सङ्ग्राममभिकाङ् क्षति । एषोऽप्याशंसतेलङ्कांस्वेनानीकेनमर्दितुम् ।।6.26.30।।

यस्तुकर्णौविवृणुतेजृम्बतेचपुनःपुनः । नचसंविजतेमृत्योर्नचयुद्धाद्विधावति ।।6.26.34।। प्रकम्पतेचरोषेणतिर्यक्चपुनरीक्षते । पश्यन् लाङ्गूलमपिचक्ष्वेळतेचमहाबलः ।।6.26.35।। महाजवोवीतभयोरम्यंसाल्वेयपर्वतम् । राजन्सततमध्यास्तेशरभोनामयूथपः ।।6.26.36।।

भ्रमराचरितायत्रसर्वकालफलद्रुमाः ।।6.27.34।। यंसूर्यस्तुल्यपर्णाभमनुपर्येतिपर्वतम् । यस्यभासासदाभान्तितद्वर्णामृगपक्षिणः ।।6.27.35।। यस्यप्रस्थंमहात्मानोनत्यजन्तिमहर्षयः । सर्वकालफलावृक्षास्सदाफलसमन्विताः ।।6.27.36।। मधूनिचमहार्हाणियस्मिन्पर्वतसत्तमे । तत्रैवरमतेराजन्रम्येकाञ्चनपर्वते ।।6.27.37।। मुख्योवानरमुख्यानांकेसरीनामयूथपः ।

षष्टिर्गिरिसहस्राणांरम्याःकाञ्चनपर्वता ।।6.27.38।। तेषांमध्येगिरिवरस्त्वमिवानघरक्षसाम् । तत्रैतेकपिलाश्श्वेतास्ताम्रास्यामधुपिङ्गलाः ।।6.27.39।। निवसन्त्युत्तमगिरौतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रानखायुधाः । सिंहाइवचतुर्दंष्ट्राव्याघ्राइवदुरासदाः ।।6.27.40।। सर्वेवैश्वानरसमाज्वलिताशीविषोपमाः । सुदीर्घाञ्चितलाङ्गूलामत्तमातङ्गसन्निभाः ।।6.27.41।। महापर्वतसङ्काशामहाजीमूतनिस्स्वनाः । वृत्तपिङ्गलरक्ताक्षाभीमाभीमगतिस्वराः ।।6.27.42।। मर्दयन्तीवतेसर्वेतस्थुर्लङकासमीक्ष्यते ।

यश्चैषोऽनन्तरश्शूरश्श्यामःपद्मनिभेक्षणः । इक्ष्वाकूणामतिरथोलोकेविख्यातपौरुष ।।6.28.18।। यस्मिन्नचलतेधर्मोयोधर्मंनातिवर्तते । योब्राह्ममस्त्रंवेदांश्चवेदवेदविदांवरः ।।6.28.19।। योभिन्द्याद्गगनंबाणैःपर्वतांश्चापिदारयेत् । यस्यमृत्योरिवक्रोधश्शक्रस्येवपराक्रमः ।।6.28.20।। यस्यभार्याजनस्थानात्सीताचापिहृतात्वया । सएषरामस्त्वांयोद्धुंराजन्समभिवर्तते ।।6.28.21।।

यंतुपस्यसितिष्ठन्तंमध्येगिरिमिवाचलम् । सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्राणांभर्तारममितौजसम् ।।6.28.28।। तेजयशसाबुद् ध्याज्ञानेनाभिजनेनच । यःकपीनतिबभ्राजहिमवानिवपर्वतान् ।।6.28.29।। किष्किन्धांयस्समध्यास्तेगुहांसगहनद्रुमाम् । दुर्गांपर्वतदुर्गस्तांप्रधानैस्सहयूथपैः ।।6.28.30।। यस्यैषाकाञ्चनीमालाशोभितेशतपुष्करा । कान्तादेवमनुष्याणांयस्यांलक्ष्मीप्रतिष्ठिता ।।6.28.31।। एतांचमालांतारांचकपिराज्यंचशाश्वतम् । सुग्रीवोवालिनंहत्वारामेणप्रतिपादितः ।।6.28.32।।

शुकेनतुसमाख्यातान्दृष्ट्वासहरियूथपान् । समीपस्थंचरामस्यभ्रातरंस्वंविभीषणम् ।।6.29.1।। लक्ष्मणंचमहावीर्यंभुजंरामस्यदक्षिणं । सर्ववानरराजंचसुग्रीवंभीमविक्रमम् ।।6.29.2।। अङ्गदंचापिबलिनंवज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् । हनूमन्तंचविक्रान्तंजाम्बवन्तंचदुर्जयम् ।।6.29.3।। सुषेणंकुमुदंनीलंनलंचप्लवगर्षभम् । गजंगवाक्षंशरभंमैन्दंचद्विविदंतथा ।।6.29.4।। किञ्चिदाविग्नहृदयोजातक्रोधश्चरावणः । भर्त्सयामासतौवीरौकथान्तेशुकसारणौ ।।6.29.5।।

चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला । तमालवनसञ्छन्नानागमालासमावृता ।।6.39.3।। हिन्तालैरर्जुनैर्नीपैस्सप्तपर्णैश्चपुष्पितैः । तिलकैःकर्णिकारैश्चपाटलैश्चसमन्ततः ।।6.39.4।। शुशुभेपुष्पिताग्रैश्चलतापरिगतैर्द्रुमैः । लङ्काबहुविधैर्दिव्यैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती ।।6.39.5।। विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैरक्तकोमलपल्लवैः । शाद्वलैश्चतथानीपैश्चित्राभिर्वनराजिभिः ।।6.39.6।।

मण्डलानिविचित्राणिस्थानानिविविधानिच । मूत्रकाणिचित्राणिगतप्रत्यागतानिच ।।6.40.23।। तिरच्शीनगतान्येवतथावक्रगतानिच । परिमोक्षंप्रहाराणांवर्जनंपरिधावनम् ।।6.40.24।। अभिद्रवणमाप्लावमावस्थानंसविग्रहम् । परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लुतम् ।।6.40.25।। उपन्यस्तपमन्यस्तंयुद्धमार्गविशारदौ । तौसञ्चेचेरतुरन्योन्यंवानरेन्द्रश्चरावणः ।।6.40.26।।

अचेष्टौमन्दनिश्श्वासौशोणितौघपरिप्लुतौ । शरजालाचितौस्तब्दौशयानौशरतल्पयोः ।।6.46.4।। निःश्वसन्तौयथासर्पौनिश्चेष्टौमन्दविक्रमौ । रुधिरस्राद्विग्धाङ्गौतापनीयाविवध्वजौ ।।6.46.5।। तौवीरशयनेवीरौशयानौमन्दचेष्टितौ । यूथपैस्तै: परिवृतौबाष्पव्याकुललोचनैः ।।6.46.6।। राघवौपतितौदृष्टवाशरजालसमावृतौ । बभूवुर्वेर्व्यथितास्सर्वेवानरास्सविभीषणाः ।।6.46.7।।

हतवीरौघवस्रांतुभग्नायुधमहाद्रुमाम् ।।6.58.29।। शोणितौघमहातोयांयमसागरगामिनीम् । यकृत् प्लीहमहापङ्कान्वििकीर्णान्त्रशैवलाम् ।।6.58.30।। भिन्नकायशिरोमीनामङ्गावयवशाद्वलाम् । गृध्रहंसगणाकीर्णांकङ्कसारससेविताम् ।।6.58.31।। मेदःफेनसमाकीर्णामार्तस्न्तितस्वनाम् । तांकापुरषुदुस्तारांयुद्धभूमिमयींनदीम् ।।6.58.32।। नदीमिवघनापायेहंससारससेविताम् । राक्षसाःकपिमुख्याश्चतेरुस्तांदुस्तरांनदीम् ।।6.58.33।। यथापद्मरजोध्वस्तांनळिनींगजयूथपाः ।

हनूमन्तं च सुग्रीवमङ्गदंगन्धमादनम् । जाम्बवन्तंसुषेणं च वेगदर्शिनमेव च ।।6.73.62।। मैन्दं च द्विविदंनीलंगवाक्षंगजगोमुभौ । केसरिंहरिलोमानंविद्युद्धंष्ट्रं च वानरम् ।।6.73.63।। सूर्याननंज्योतिमुखंतथादधिमुखंहरिम् । पावकाक्षनळंचैवकुमुदंचैववानरम् ।।6.73.64।। प्रसैश्शूलैश्शितैर्बाणैरिन्द्रजिन्मन्त्रसम्हितैः । विव्याधहरिशार्दूलान् सर्वांस्तान्राक्षसोत्तमः ।।6.73.65।।

आरुरोहतदातस्माद्धरिर्मलयपर्वतम् । मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशंनानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् ।।6.74.42।। नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णंविकासिकमलोत्पलम् । सेवितंदेवगन्धर्वैष्षष्टियोजनमुच्छ्रितम् ।।6.74.43।। विद्याधरैर्मुनिगणैरप्सरोभिर्निषेवितम् । नानामृगगणाकीर्णंबहुकन्दरशोभितम् ।।6.74.44।। सर्वानाकुलयंस्तत्रयक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् । हनुमान् मेघसङ्काशोववृधेमारुतात्मजः ।।6.74.45।।

नानाविधान्गृहच्छन्दान्धदाहहुतभुक्तदा । आवासान्राक्षसानां च सर्वेषांगृहगर्थिनाम् ।।6.75.14।। हेमचित्रतनुत्राणस्रग्दामाम्भरधारिणाम् । शीधुपानचलाक्षाणांमद्विह्वलगामिनाम् ।।6.75.15।। कान्तालम्बितवस्त्राणांशत्रुसञ्जातमन्युनाम् । गदाशूलासिहस्तानांखादतांपिबतामपि ।।6.75.16।। शयनेषुमहार्हेषुप्रसुप्तानांप्रियैस्सह । त्रस्तानांगच्छतांतूर्णंपुत्रानादायसर्वतः ।।6.75.17।। तेषांशतसहस्राणितदालङ्कानिवासिनाम् । अदहत्पावकस्तत्रजज्वाल च पुनःपुनः ।।6.75.18।।

पताकाध्वजसंसक्तमुत्तमासिपरश्वधम् । भीमाश्वरथमातङ्गंनानापततिसमाकुलम् ।।6.75.55।। दीप्तशूलगदाखडगप्रासतोमरकार्मुकम् । तद्राक्षसबलंघोरभीमंविक्रमपौरुषम् ।।6.75.56।। ददृशेज्वलितप्रासंकिङ्किणीशतनादितम् । हेमजालाचितभुजंव्यावेष्टितपरश्वथम् ।।6.75.57।। व्याघूर्णितमहाशस्त्रंबाणसंसक्तकार्मुकम् । गन्धमाल्यमधूत्सेकसम्मोदितमहानिलम् ।।6.75.58।।
स प्रचिच्छेदतान् सर्वान् बिभेद च पुनश्शिलाः । कुम्भकर्णात्मजश्रशीमान् वालिपुत्त्रसमीरितान् ।।6.76.50।।

शितशूलधराश्शूलैरसिभिश्चासिपाणयः । शक्तिहस्ताश्चभिश्शक्तिपट्टसै: पट्टसायुधाः ।।6.86.21।। परिघैश्चगदाभिश्चकुन्तैश्चशुभदर्शनैः । शतशश्चशतघ्नीभिरायसैरपिमुद्गरैः ।।6.86.22।। घोरैःपरशुभिश्चैवभिदनिपालैश्चराक्षसाः । मुष्टिभिर्वज्रकल्पैश्चतलैरशनिसन्निभैः ।।6.86.23।। अभिजघ्नुःसमासाद्यसमन्तात्पर्वतोपमम् । तेषामपि च सङ्ग्रुद्धश्चकारकदनंमहत् ।।6.86.24।।

प्रहस्तोनिहतोवीरोनिकुम्भश्चमहाबल. । कुम्भकर्णश्चकुम्भश्चधूम्राक्षश्चनिशाचरः ।।6.90.10।। जम्बुमालीमहामालीतीक्ष्णवेगोऽशनिप्रभः । सुप्तघ्नोयज्ञकोपश्चवज्रदंष्ट्रश्चराक्षसः ।।6.90.11।। सम्ह्रादीविकटोऽरिघ्नस्तपनोदमएव च । प्रघासःप्रघसश्चैवप्रजङ्घोजङ्घएव च ।।6.90.12।। अग्निकेतुश्चदुर्धर्षोरश्मिकेतुश्चवीर्यवान् । विद्युज्जिह्वाद्विजिह्वश्चसूर्यशत्रुश्चराक्षसः ।।6.90.13।। अकम्पनःसुपार्श्वश्चचक्रमाली च राक्षसः । कम्पनस्सत्त्ववन्तौतौदेवान्तकनरान्तकौ ।।6.90.14।।
